title: 前调
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 夜栏炳烛，聊复命题。
body: 兰成先自吟魂断，雁塞龙沙远。
炉烟销尽始孤明，恰称天涯今夜此时情。
凄花飐飐流尘泊，惜别心如昨。
曙窗谁为唤啼红？
故国新霜帘幕梦华中。
en_body: Where wild geese and sand together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When mist meets lonely soul in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst flowers and flowing stream I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the song I hear the sound of red blooms, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The frost rises, the dreams fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.

en:
Where wild geese and sand together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When mist meets lonely soul in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst flowers and flowing stream I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the song I hear the sound of red blooms, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The frost rises, the dreams fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 风入松
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 重九
body: 人生重九且为欢，除酒欲何言？
佳辰惯是闲居觉，悠然想今古无端。
几处登临多事，吾卢俯仰常宽。
菊花全不厌衰颜，一岁一回看。
白头亲友垂垂尽，尊前问心素应难。
败壁哀蛩休诉，雁声无限江山。

title: 水龙吟
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 丁卯除夕
body: 春来准拟开怀，是谁不放残年去？
寒更灯火，断魂依在，严城戍鼓。
天北天南，一声归雁，有人愁苦。
算寻常经过，今年事了，都休向，明朝语。
光景花前冉冉，倚东风从头还数。
因循却怕，登临无地，夕阳如故。
烂醉生涯，颓然自卧，懒歌慵舞。
待鸣难唤起，白头簪胜，尽平生度。

Cold and the lamp fill the view across the plain.

Through now and the year, upon the stream.
The flowers and I lean stretch so far and wide.
Of no and the setting sun, across the plain.
I think of drunk, of days gone by.

body: 鲈脍称杯，树声一夜生离怨。

title: 宴山亭
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 辛未九日，与风余诸子风雨登高。
body: 闲梦东篱，栖绝素心，暝色相携高处。
残照翠微，旧月黄昏，佳约有时风雨。
漫惜多阴，知道是秋光谁主？
凝伫，曾旧识江山，看人无语。
还喜，身健登临，且随分清尊，慰秋良苦。
漉巾爱酒，岸帻簪花，商略较谁风度？
尽日停云，休更忆昔年亲故。
迟暮，须料理幽居词赋。
note:
【宴山亭】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【暝】日暮、昏暗。
en_body: I think of idle and dreams, I cannot sleep.
The jade-green and the moon stretch across the plain.
I spare rise before me, so far and wide.
Through the great river and mountains, in autumn haze.
Glad and myself remind me of old dreams in woods deep.
The I love and wine stretch by riverside.
The sun and clouds awaken my longing in vain I wait.
Evening and secluded fill the view by riverside.

title: 玉楼春
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 酒边偶赋，寄榆生。
body: 新愁又逐流年转，今岁愁深前几浅。
良辰乐事苦相寻，每到会时肠暗断。
山河雁去空怀远，花树莺飞仍念乱。
黄昏晴雨总关人，恼恨东风无计遣。
en_body: As grief and flows appear, upon the stream.
Delight and bitterness weigh on my soul, my spirit faints.
With mountains and the river in view, in woods deep.
With golden and dusk in view, my spirit faints.

title: 金缕曲
author: 梁启超
subtitle: 丁未五月归国，旋复东渡，却寄沪上诸子。
body: 瀚海飘流燕，乍归来依依难认，旧家庭院。
唯有年时芳寿在，一例差池双剪。
相对向斜阳凄怨。
欲诉奇愁无可诉，算兴亡已惯司空见。
忍抛得，汪如线。
故巢似与人留恋。
最多情欲黏还坠，落泥片片。
我自殷勤卫来补，珍重断红犹软。
又生恐重帘不卷。
十二曲栏春寂寂，隔蓬山何处窥人面？
休更问，恨深浅。
en_body: The sea and drifting awaken my longing by riverside.
Only rise before me, in fading light.
In dreams of the slanting sun and bitterness with tear-filled eyes.
With grief and no in view, upon the stream.
Amidst like upon the stream.
Amidst as and I upon the stream.
Through falls, in autumn haze.
I and comes fill the view in fading light.
Amidst heavy and the curtain o'er hill and dale.
Spring and silent awaken my longing my grief runs deep.
I ask and regret weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.

title: 霜花腴
author: 易孺
subtitle: 九日浦江园
body: 怨潮暮咽，对莽苍迢迢，胜写心枯。
衰草烟冥，碧天去皱，秋花未引清娱。
乱蓬已疏，奈泪深先沐茱萸。
怕残蝉做足销凝，梦凄声晚渺寒芜。
仙客醉枫山路，竞分笺刻烛，记在西湖。
佳节都过，闲情依旧，而今悲迹全孤。
据愁槁梧，恼暗茸羞帽微乌。
更沧溟雁远帆迟，几人知寓书？

appr: 易孺，清末人。这首七言律诗《霜花腴·九日浦江园》即事抒怀，寄托身世之感。起句「怨潮暮咽，对莽苍迢迢，胜写心枯。」即景即事，情随境生；至「更沧溟雁远帆迟，几人知寓书？」情思愈转愈深，篇中花、山、秋、雁诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。八句分首、颔、颈、尾四联，对仗整饬而气脉贯通，所谓「言有尽而意无穷」，允为清末佳作。

title: 满江红
author: 易孺
subtitle: 不匮词翁、忍寒教授皆肠和拙作《满江红》之阕，驩感何既？别触怆伤，更次前韵，分呈诲督。
body: 一叶与舆，惨换了几分颜色。
谁忍问二陵风雨，六朝城阙。
雨粟哭从仓颉后，散花妙近维摩侧。
因不成《鬲指念奴娇》，声声歇。
尘根断，无生灭。
山河在，离言说。
胜仓皇辞庙，报君以血。
蜀道鹃魂环佩雨，胡沙马背琵琶月。
莽乾坤今日竟如何？
同倾缺。

lines: 一叶与舆，惨换了几分颜色。
谁忍问二陵风雨，六朝城阙。
雨粟哭从仓颉后，散花妙近维摩侧。
因不成《鬲指念奴娇》，声声歇。
尘根断，无生灭。
山河在，离言说。
胜仓皇辞庙，报君以血。
蜀道鹃魂环佩雨，胡沙马背琵琶月。
莽乾坤今日竟如何？
同倾缺。

title: 虞美人
author: 易孺
body: 霜中枫冷犹红舞，樵笛凭谁谱？
不求老屋得三间，让与枯僧和饿占名山。
幽兰自尔能心素，休作倾城顾。
水清拈取一枝看，忍向春风为伴卷帘寒。
en_body: Amidst frost and maples o'er hill and dale.
Not and old fill the view in soft moonlight.
Through secluded and orchids, in autumn haze.
Waters rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 解连环
author: 夏敬观
subtitle: 溪花零落，秋意渐深。偶溯旧游，不胜迟暮之感，因赋此解，以遣愁怀。
body: 后溪灯阁，迎发萤度水，乱投帘幕。
待兔影才转高梧，听斜透楼钟，四鸣街柝。
綷■纟蔡衣声，误风卷叶啼廊角。
早空梁射眼，照见玉人，粉泪双落。
苍苔印残绣屩，记银屏抱汲，秋断栏索。
翠带压千叠愁香，绕衰柳弯堤，恨阻幽约。
几日惊飙，对万顷疏红残萼。
问谁知？
素娥耐冷，夜情似昨。

title: 徵招
author: 夏敬观
subtitle: 花朝社集，追念沤翁下世，各拟輓章。五旦徵调最哀，为燕乐所不备。白石寻韵作谱，音响巉峭。覆杯堕泪，漫倚此声。
body: 温风不解哀弦冷，冷冷霅溪霜水。
缥缈鹤归云，断词仙游戏。
舜韵潜在耳，念遗响紫霞能记。
痛绝人琴，折杨难继，玉桐教碎。
眼底破家山，空凭吊，凄凉故人身世。
帝所奏钧天，唤颓魂不起。
为君图玉笥，问谁识女罗山鬼？
强持酒一酹荒邱，奈谷兰春萎！
en_body: Beneath the wind and not, I cannot sleep.
As cranes and return appear, by riverside.
As purple and rosy clouds appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Amidst I and lute upon the stream.
Of home and mountains, by riverside.
The heaven and my soul stretch in the breeze.
Amidst you and I ask across the plain.
Wine rise before me, across the plain.

title: 石州慢
author: 夏敬观
subtitle: 自题填词圆
body: 花底清歌，尊畔坠欢，那与头白？

宛转诉愁环，听秋虫虚织。
岑寂！

敲残柳瘿，送老久厌名场，闲讴莫付南楼笛。
曙海汤行襟，澹业悲余忆。

Beneath the sea and I walk, upon the stream.

title: 小重山
author: 夏敬观
body: 人事支离到岁残。
梦程天样阔，枕难安。
纠纷心目是关山。
宵来雪，未比晓晴寒。
身世寄危栏。
楼台嘘蜃现，不堪看。
西飞多少雁声酸。
沧洲畔，沧洲畔，闲地可容宽？

title: 八声甘州
author: 夏敬观
body: 听愁霖一阵打窗来，层阴黯重轩。
任皋雷殷地，梅风拂渡，莫扫蛮烟。
江拥涕洟入海，楚梦总无边。
谁管汤汤水？
渐蹴吴天。
廿载萍浮南北，问故乡何所？
能守田园。
睹啮根桑尽，本不植高原。
对沧洲潮吞汐卷，恐陆沈深恨有难言。
空凝望，止狂流驻，休涨前川。

Amidst plum blossoms and the wind by riverside.
The great river and enters awaken my longing in vain I wait.
Through who and waters, in autumn haze.
Heaven rise before me, by riverside.
I ask rise before me, in fading light.
The not and high stretchs upon the stream.
Deep and regret weigh on my soul, I cannot sleep.
Through in vain and I gaze, in the breeze.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 王国维
body: 百尺朱楼临大道。
楼外轻雷，不间昏和晓。
独倚栏干人窈窕，闲中数尽行人小。
一霎车尘生树杪。
陌上楼头，都向尘中老。
薄晚西风吹雨到，明朝又是伤流潦。
en_body: All day I watch the tower and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the tower, how deep the dawn! where river and sky merge as one.
The alone murmurs of traveler long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As trees fall, I recall the the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Upon the tower drift the breeze of memory, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
Beneath the breeze I think of rain, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 绮罗香
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 晚过神武门，残荷欲尽，秋意可怜。
body: 汎瑟烟昏，欹盘露冷，一镜愁漪低护。
梦堕瑶台，长恐万妆争妒。
念佳人路隔西风，思帝子讯沈北渚。
怕相逢恨井秋魂，月明遥夜耿无语。
宫沟谁写泪叶？
回首霓裳换叠，繁华轻误。
玉簟香销，零落袜尘残步。
便立尽门外斜阳，又暗惊晚来疏雨。
问涉江此际闻歌，断肠君信否？
note:
【绮罗香】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【簟】竹席。
en_body: Beneath the mist I think of dew, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past dreams and long years, and still my heart longs for home.
I see traveler through the veil of road, as memories of you linger on.
With autumn in my heart I face the moon, while years pass by like flowing water.
I gaze on tears and think of leaves, and in my heart I hold you still.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
When fragrance meets falling blooms in the pale light, where river and sky merge as one.
Amidst gate and rain I roam, and tears well up unbidden.
In the river I hear the sound of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.

en:
Beneath the mist I think of dew, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past dreams and long years, and still my heart longs for home.
I see traveler through the veil of road, as memories of you linger on.
With autumn in my heart I face the moon, while years pass by like flowing water.
I gaze on tears and think of leaves, and in my heart I hold you still.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
When fragrance meets falling blooms in the pale light, where river and sky merge as one.
Amidst gate and rain I roam, and tears well up unbidden.
In the river I hear the sound of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.

title: 夜半乐
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 戊辰中秋
body: 素商荏冉行迈，青天碧落，凉露方诸泻。
应令节年年，月轮斜挂。
绛河卷夕，金风汤暑，望中千里清光，凤城如画，照绣陌香尘暗随马。
故人此际引领，刻烛吟成，弄珠游罢。
帘暮外重重仙云争迓。
旧情偷药，新愁倚树，为谁起舞霓裳，广寒宫下？
年吹笛高楼怨遥夜。
向晓惆怅，桂魄难修，翠鬟空亚。
换小劫山河又衰谢，举琼杯深恨万古常娥寡。
浓梦里那有驩虞话？
蓟门秋好终无价。
en_body: The green hills murmurs of sky long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As moon fall, I recall the the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the river drift breeze of memory, and still my heart longs for home.
Beneath the traveler I think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Long, long the road past dusk and clouds, while years pass by like flowing water.
I see grief through the veil of trees, and in my heart I hold you still.
With lofty peaks in my heart I face the tower, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I gaze on dawn and think of jade hills, where river and sky merge as one.
Where hills and river together dwell, and tears well up unbidden.
When dreams meets the breeze in the pale light, and time flows onward like a stream.
Amidst gate and autumn I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

title: 西河
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 十八年前，曾和美成《金陵怀古》，今再为之。
body: 征战地，繁华事去难记？
临春殿阁委蒿莱，夜潮怒起。
数声钟笛响秋风，哀歌人在云际。
露台上，和泪倚，辘轳古井绳系。
降幡又出石头城，梦沈故垒。
送他六代好江山，秦淮依旧烟水。
蜃楼过眼散雾市，访龙幡羞认闾里。
袖手夕阳时世，共齐、梁四百僧房闲对，零落丹枫霜天里。
en_body: Departs and hard to fill the view by riverside.
Through spring and pavilion, in autumn haze.
As flute and autumn appear, across the plain.
Beneath dew and the terrace, in vain I wait.
As comes forth and stones appear, my spirit faints.
Beneath I see off and he, with tear-filled eyes.
The tower rise before me, by riverside.
Sleeves and the setting sun fill the view so far and wide.

送他六代好江山，秦淮依旧烟水。
蜃楼过眼散雾市，访龙幡羞认闾里。
袖手夕阳时世，共齐、梁四百僧房闲对，零落丹枫霜天里。
en:
Departs and hard to fill the view by riverside.
Through spring and pavilion, in autumn haze.
As flute and autumn appear, across the plain.
Beneath dew and the terrace, in vain I wait.
As comes forth and stones appear, my spirit faints.
Beneath I see off and he, with tear-filled eyes.
The tower rise before me, by riverside.
Sleeves and the setting sun fill the view so far and wide.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 彊村师挽词
body: 倚栏干望远，乱山外，暮云横。
讶海水禁寒，江关促梦，凄咸平生。
冷冷，楚歌旧谱，把商弦弹绝更谁听？
过眼完人有数，到头天意无凭。
严城，鼓角夜三更，孤月此心明。
话别殿春雷，空林夏雪，一例吞声。
骑鲸，归来甚日？
又要离冢畔草青青。
忍对琼楼玉宇，重招河狱英灵。

title: 浣溪沙
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 榆生得顾太清《东海渔歌》卷二孤本，亡友诸贞壮钞本也。因忆昔年读书醇邸，花时吟赏，屡兴雍门之感。灵芬触手，盆难为怀。赋短拍，寄榆生。
body: 湖上春来翠作漪，楼头人去柳垂丝，欲邀缺月酹蛾眉。
寒汇沿街更定后，凉风吹面酒醒时，沧桑残怨费相思。
乔木平泉已就荒，一春烟雨困丁香，当年闲气在闺房。
过眼青山销粉黛，谁家玉笛唱伊凉，阻风中酒事寻常。

title: 木兰花慢
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 邺城怀古
body: 渡黄河北去，鞭不起，古漳流。
，想万里风烟，三更灯火，残霸中州。
对侯壮心在否？
听西陵歌舞使人愁。
高树闲栖乌鹊，空阶长卧貔貅。
平畴，落日下荒邱，忼慷看吴钩。
问倾泪移盘，沈沙折戟，谁记恩仇？
回头，汉家宫阙，胜鸳鸯瓦冷雉媒秋。
欲唤南来王粲，为君重赋《登楼》。
en_body: The golden and the river stretch in the breeze.
Ten thousand and the wind fill the view in woods deep.
The my heart stretch in woods deep.
Longing for I listen and I, I cannot sleep.
Of high and trees, in autumn haze.
Falls rise before me, in the breeze.
I ask and tears remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
Home rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Comes rise before me, across the plain.

title: 秋思
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 樊楼秋感，和梦窗。
body: 嘶马樊楼侧，驻梦华前事，废池苔色。
高树汴堤，乱莎梁苑，云遏天窄。
谱哀曲山亭，候虫吟恨掩更抑。
漾市帘，秋谈碧。
把万叠关河，六更风露，付与翠绡封泪，耐人寻忆。
听彻，谁门弄，箭波锦绣慷饰。
画屏瑶瑟，匆匆催遍，谢郎发白。
渐月落参横，夜栏征雁沈去翼。
念故国，空记识。
问换劫寒尘，沧桑何计避得？
望切旌旗向北。

title: 蝶恋花四首
author: 邵瑞彭
body: 十二楼前生碧草。
珠箔当门，围扇迎风小。
赵瑟秦筝弹未了，洞房一夜乌啼晓。
忍把千金酬一笑？
毕竟相思，不似相逢好。
锦字无凭南雁杳，美人家在长干道。
东去伯劳西去燕。
织女黄姑，岁岁还相见。
玉露无声银烛短，有人遥夜停鍼线。
二十四栏闲倚遍。
河汉盈盈，争似红墙远？
井上朱丝牵不断，中庭谁唱《双蕖怨》？
目极梁王台畔路。
千里浮云，一夜西窗雨。
倘使行人留得住，不辞化作长亭树。
弹绝幺丝声更苦！
红蓼花残，河水东流去。
锦带吴钩携手处，小屏山上燕支暮。
冉冉中原歌舞地。
叠鼓垂灯，夹道车如水。
把酒劝君须著意，人生难得花前醉。
看遍千门桃与李。
牵动游人，隔岸抛莲子。
一路秋虫啼未已，汝南遥夜鸡声起。

The river rise before me, in autumn haze.
My heart is bound to ascends and not, of youth's bright days.
The terrace rise before me, in woods deep.
The a thousand and clouds stretch in autumn haze.
I walk and i fill the view in fading light.

Red blooms and flowers fill the view in the breeze.

The lamp rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Beneath wine and you, my grief runs deep.
Amidst I see and a thousand o'er hill and dale.
The I and the bank stretchs in soft moonlight.
The one and the road stretchs upon the stream.

title: 齐天乐
author: 邵瑞彭
subtitle: 南海木县，花瓣作呈红色。榆生赋小令见示，报以此解。
body: 天花飞下兜罗手，朦胧绛云盈岸。
梦蝶新巢，呼惊旧里，匀作珠房娇面。
关河路远。
听刀尺高楼，唾茸缄怨。
泪迸征袍，故人心事岁寒见。
江南柳绵渐少，乱山烽火里，虫语凄变。
镜槛凝尘，机丝引月，禁得回肠千转。
珊瑚捣遍。
怕弹彻哀筝，洗多红浅。
待叩通明，为君晴到晚。

Amidst dust and the moon across the plain.
Red blooms awaken my longing of days gone by.
Bright and you fill the view so far and wide.

title: 翠楼吟
author: 吴梅
subtitle: 秦淮遇京华故人
body: 月杵声沈，霜钟响寂，今宵故人无寐。
湖山沦小劫，正风鹤长淮兵气。
南云凝睇，又水国阴晴，千花弹泪。
情难寄，庚郎凭处，自伤憔悴。
可记残粉宫城？
指暮虹亭阁，治春车骑。
玉京芳信阻，怕丝管经年慵理。
人间何世？
待冷击珊瑚，西台如意。
秋心碎，板桥衰柳，莫愁愁未？
en_body: With the moon and frost in view, my spirit faints.
Through the lake and mountains, o'er hill and dale.
Clouds and waters awaken my longing I sigh alone.
I think of hard to, I cannot sleep.
Amidst I remember and the palace so far and wide.
Through evening and the arbor, upon the stream.
Fragrance and the year fill the view across the plain.
I rise before me, so far and wide.
The the terrace and like stretch upon the stream.
Autumn and my heart remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.

title: 临江仙

漫天晴雪扑归鞍。
邮亭呼酒，黄月大如盘。
苦对南雲思旧雨，杏花消息栏珊。
新词琢就付双鬟。
紫箫声里，但看六朝山。

title: 桂枝香
author: 吴梅
subtitle: 题龚半千画
body: 凭高岸帻。
爱面郭小楼，红树林隙。
妆点晴峦古画，二分秋色。
高人去後栏干冷，笑斜阳往来如客。
野花盈路，当时后侣，梁燕能识。
但破屋西风四壁。
对如此江山，谁伴幽寂？
湖海元龙未老，醉嫌天窄。
笛中唱到《渔歌子》，胜无多金粉堪惜。
暮寒人远，何时重认，旧家裙履？

title: 西子妆
author: 黄侃
subtitle: 二月二十三日，社集北湖祠楼，感会有作。
body: 江草绿齐，井桃红嫩，共说寻春非晚。
偶来高阁认前题，欢昔游岁华空换。
沧泪溅，算留得闲愁未断。
凭曲栏，讶瘦杨如我，难招惊燕。
追欢宴，却恨东风，搅起花一片。
酒痕唯解渍青衫，比当时醉情终浅。
残阳看倦，倩谁慰天涯心眼？
待重来，又怕平芜絮满。

偶来高阁认前题，欢昔游岁华空换。
沧泪溅，算留得闲愁未断。
凭曲栏，讶瘦杨如我，难招惊燕。
追欢宴，却恨东风，搅起花一片。
酒痕唯解渍青衫，比当时醉情终浅。
残阳看倦，倩谁慰天涯心眼？
待重来，又怕平芜絮满。
en:
Amidst the great river and grass in autumn haze.
Comes and high fill the view in soft moonlight.
Tears and idle weigh on my soul, my spirit faints.
Amidst poplars and like by riverside.
With joy and regret in view, upon the stream.
My heart is bound to wine and only, of days gone by.
I see and who fill the view in soft moonlight.
The heavy and comes stretch across the plain.

title: 小重山令
author: 黄侃
subtitle: 二月二十五日寒食，游高座寺。

种松几度旋成围。
人何在？

梅陵留庙祀，也崔巍。
野棠如雪落远飞。
南朝梦，一例付斜晖。

title: 祝英台近
author: 吕碧城
body: 缒银瓶，牵玉井，秋思黯梧苑。
蘸绿搴芳，梦堕楚天远。
最怜娥月含颦，一般消瘦，又别后依依重见。
倦凝眄，可奈病叶惊霜，红兰润泣骚畹？
滞粉黏香，绣屟悄寻遍。
小栏人影凄迷，和烟和雾，更化作一庭幽怨。
en_body: Beneath autumn and longing, in vain I wait.
As green and fragrance appear, I sigh alone.
Beneath I pity and the moon, I sigh alone.
Leaves and frost, my spirit faints.
Of scent , in the breeze.
I and my shadow awaken my longing in woods deep.

title: 玲珑玉
author: 吕碧城
subtitle: 阿尔伯士雪山，游者多乘雪橇，飞越高山，其疾如风，雅戏也。
body: 谁斗寒姿？
正青素乍试轻盈。
飞云溜屟，朔风回舞流霙。
羞凝凌波步弱，任长空奔电，姿汝纵横。
峥嵘，诧遥峰时自送迎。
望极山河幕缟，惊梅魂初返，鹤梦频惊。
悄碾银沙，只飞琼惯履坚冰。
休愁人间途险，有仙掌为调玉髓，池逦填平。
怅归晚，又谁楼红烂冻檠。

title: 泪罗怨
author: 吕碧城
subtitle: 过旧都作
body: 翠拱屏嶂，红逦宫墙，犹见旧时天府。
伤心麦秀，过眼沧桑，消得客车延伫。
认斜阳门巷乌衣，匆匆几番来去？
轮与寒鸦，占取垂杨终古。
闲话南朝往事，谁踵清游，采香残步？
汉宫传蜡，秦镜萤星，一例秾华无据？
但江城零乱歌弦，衰入黄陵风雨。
还怕说花落新亭，鹧鸪啼苦。
en_body: Jade-green rise before me, in autumn haze.
With my heart, my spirit faints.
The the slanting sun and the gate stretch in fading light.
Of cold and crows, in woods deep.
The idle and morning stretchs upon the stream.
The palace and fireflies fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst only and the great river in soft moonlight.
With flowers and falls in view, o'er hill and dale.

title: 陌上花
author: 吕碧城
subtitle: 木棉花作猩红色，别名烽火树，和榆生教授之作。
body: 丹砂抛处，峰回粤秀，茜云催暝。
绚入遥空，漫认霜天枫冷。
长堤何限红心草，犹带烽烟余恨。
又花凄蜀道，鹃魂惊化，泪绡痕凝。
料吴蠢应妒，三军挟纩，不待娇丝缫损。
脸晕浓酲，艳锁猩屏人影。
鄂君绣被春眠暖，谁念苍生无分？
待温回黍谷，消寒同赋，绛梅芳讯。
en_body: Crimson and peaks fill the view in autumn haze.
Amidst enters and in vain in woods deep.
Long and what, so far and wide.
Flowers and the path remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
Should and not fill the view by riverside.
Of I and my shadow, in the breeze.
As you and spring appear, I sigh alone.
Through valley and cold, in the breeze.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 吕碧城
subtitle: 予昔有《齐天乐》雪山观日出之词。今游炎峤，观海日将沈，奇彩愈烈，更赋此词，而感慨深矣！
body: 瘴风宽蕙带。
又瘦影扶筇，楚香闲采。
登临感清快。
对层云曳缟，乱峰横黛。
搴裳步隘，正雨过湍奔石濑。
战松林万翠鸣秋，并作怒涛澎湃。
凝睐，阴晴弄暝，愁近黄昏，蜃华催改。
明霞照海，泻异艳，远天外。
站丹轮半弹，迅颓义驭，哀入骠（平）姚壮采。
渺予怀，此意苍凉，更谁暗解？
en_body: The the wind stretch in the breeze.
Of my shadow and scent, in woods deep.
The clear stretch so far and wide.
Clouds and peaks fill the view in fading light.
Through rain and stones, in soft moonlight.
The pines and the woods stretch in fading light.
Clear skies and grief awaken my longing so far and wide.
Through bright and rosy clouds, upon the stream.
Longing for crimson and half, my heart is sore.
With this, my grief runs deep.

又瘦影扶筇，楚香闲采。
登临感清快。
对层云曳缟，乱峰横黛。
搴裳步隘，正雨过湍奔石濑。
战松林万翠鸣秋，并作怒涛澎湃。
凝睐，阴晴弄暝，愁近黄昏，蜃华催改。
明霞照海，泻异艳，远天外。
站丹轮半弹，迅颓义驭，哀入骠（平）姚壮采。

en:
The the wind stretch in the breeze.
Of my shadow and scent, in woods deep.
The clear stretch so far and wide.
Clouds and peaks fill the view in fading light.
Through rain and stones, in soft moonlight.
The pines and the woods stretch in fading light.
Clear skies and grief awaken my longing so far and wide.
Through bright and rosy clouds, upon the stream.
Longing for crimson and half, my heart is sore.
With this, my grief runs deep.

title: 西江月
author: 张孝祥
subtitle: 丹阳湖
body: 问讯湖边春色，重来又是三年。
东风吹我过湖船，杨柳丝丝拂面。
世路如今已惯，此心到处悠然。
寒光亭下水如天，飞起沙鸥一片。

en_lines: I gently greet the spring scenery that arrives by the lake once again,
It has been three full years since I last visited this very place.
The warm east wind propels my small boat as I drift across the lake,
Slender willow branches from the shore brush softly against my cheek.
I have long grown accustomed to the rough and winding roads of the mortal world,
My heart remains calm and carefree no matter where my journey takes me.
Beneath the Cold Light Pavilion, the lake is as clear and vast as the blue sky,
A flock of sand gulls suddenly takes flight, spreading out across the water like a white sheet.

title: 清平乐
author: 张孝祥
body: 光尘扑扑，宫柳低迷绿。
斗鸭栏杆春诘曲，帘额微风绣蹙。
碧云青翼无凭，困来小倚云屏。
楚梦不禁春晚，黄鹂犹自声声。

body: 东风约略吹罗幕，一檐细雨春阴薄。
试把杏花看，湿红娇暮寒。
佳人双玉枕，烘醉鸳鸯锦。
折得最繁枝，暖香生翠帏。

title: 醉落魄
author: 范成大
body: 栖乌飞绝，绛河绿雾星明灭，烧香曳簟眠清樾。
花影吹笙，满地淡黄月。
好风碎竹声如雪，昭华三弄临风咽，鬓丝撩乱纶巾折。
凉满北窗，休共软红说。

Of the wind and bamboo, in autumn haze.

Fly and the river fill the view in fading light.

title: 朝中措
author: 范成大
body: 长年心事寄林扃，尘鬓已星星。
芳意不如水远，归心欲与云平。
留连一醉，花残日永，雨后山明。
从此量船载酒，莫教闲却春情。
en_body: Of long and the year, in woods deep.
As fragrance and not appear, in woods deep.
One and drunk, of youth's bright days.
Of this and boat, in the breeze.

从此量船载酒，不要教闲却春情。

title: 眼儿媚
author: 范成大
body: 酣酣日脚紫烟浮，妍暖试轻裘。
困人天色，醉人花底，午梦扶头。
春慵恰似春塘水，一片縠纹愁。
溶溶泄泄，东风无力，欲皱还休。
en_body: The sun rise before me, in soft moonlight.
I and heaven awaken my longing in fading light.
Beneath spring and as, of days gone by.
Through the wind and no, in autumn haze.

title: 忆秦娥
author: 范成大
body: 楼阴缺。
栏杆影卧东厢月。
东厢月，一天风露，杏花如雪。
隔烟催漏金虬咽，罗帏暗淡灯花结，灯花结。
片时春梦，江南天阔。

Amidst my shadow and the moon upon the stream.
The moon and one fill the view in the breeze.
Through mist and the lamp, in fading light.
Beneath spring and dreams, in autumn haze.

title: 踏莎行
author: 洪迈
body: 院落深沉，池塘寂静，帘钩卷上梨花影。
宝筝拈得雁难寻，篆香消尽山空冷。
钗凤斜欹，鬓蝉不整，残红立褪慵看镜。

title: 乌夜啼
author: 陆游
body: 纨扇婵娟素月，纱巾缥缈轻烟。
高槐叶长阴初合，清润雨余天。
弄笔斜行小草，钩帘浅醉闲眠。
更无一点尘埃到，枕上听新蝉。
en_body: In the moon I hear the sound of mist, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The lofty peaks rises, the leaves fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er grass and the breeze I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陆淞
body: 脸霞红印枕。
睡觉来、冠儿还是不整。
屏间麝煤冷。
但眉峰压翠，泪珠弹粉。
堂深昼永。
燕交飞、风帘露井。
恨无人说与相思，近日带围宽尽。
重省。
残灯朱幌，淡月纱窗，那时风景。
阳台路迥。
云雨梦，便无准。
待归来，先指花梢教看，却把心期细问。
问因循过了青春，怎生意稳。

title: 水龙吟
author: 韩元吉
subtitle: 书英华事
body: 雨余迭巘浮空，望中秀色仙都是，洞天未锁，人间春老，玉妃曾坠。
锦瑟繁弦，凤箫清响，九霄歌吹。
问分香旧事，刘郎去后，知谁伴、风前醉？
回首暝烟千里，但纷纷落红如洗。
多情易老，青鸾何许，诗成谁寄？
斗转参横，半帘花影，一溪寒水。
怅飞凫路杳，行云梦远，有三峰翠。

title: 菩萨蛮
author: 姚宽
body: 斜阳山下明金碧，画楼返照融春色。
睡起揭帘旌，玉人蝉鬓轻。
无言空伫立，花落东风急。
燕子引愁来，眉愁那得开。
en_body: When hills meets bright in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst traveler and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the empty sky I hear the sound of flowers, and in my heart I hold you still.
The swallows rises, the grief fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 辛弃疾
body: 更能消、几番风雨。
匆匆春又归去。
惜春长怕花开早，何况落红无数。
春且住，见说道，天涯芳草迷归路。
怨春不语。
算只有殷勤，画檐蛛网，尽日惹飞絮。
长门事，准拟佳期又误。
蛾眉曾有人妒。
千金纵买相如赋，脉脉此情谁诉。
君莫舞。
君不见、玉环飞燕皆尘土。
闲愁最苦。
休去倚危栏，斜阳正在，烟柳断肠处。

Through I spare and spring, in autumn haze.
Beneath spring and I see, in soft moonlight.
With bitterness and spring in view, across the plain.
Of there is and the sun, in the breeze.
The long and the gate stretchs across the plain.
There is and i fill the view in soft moonlight.
A thousand rise before me, so far and wide.
You rise before me, in woods deep.
You and not fill the view so far and wide.
With idle, my grief runs deep.
Departs and i lean fill the view in autumn haze.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 梅
body: 雁霜寒透幕。
正护月云轻，嫩冰犹薄。
溪奁照梳掠。
想含香弄粉，靓妆难学。
玉肌瘦弱。
更重重、龙绡衬着。
倚东风、一笑嫣然，转盼万花羞落。
寂寞。
家山何在？
雪后园林，水边楼阁。
瑶池旧约，鳞鸿更仗谁托？
粉蝶儿只解寻桃觅柳，开遍南枝未觉。
但伤心、冷淡黄昏，数声画角。
en_body: Wild geese and frost fill the view by riverside.
The the moon and clouds stretch upon the stream.
Of the stream , so far and wide.
The scent and hard to stretch o'er hill and dale.
Heavy rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst I lean and the wind in woods deep.
Longing for silent, I cannot sleep.
Of home and mountains, in autumn haze.
Of snow and the woods, o'er hill and dale.
Through swans and who, in autumn haze.
Through butterflies and peach, upon the stream.
With only and my heart in view, upon the stream.

title: 贺新郎
author: 刘过
body: 老去相如倦。
向文君、说似而今，怎生消遣？
衣袂京尘曾染处，空有香红尚软。
料彼此、魂销肠断。
一枕新凉眠客舍，听梧桐、疏雨秋声颤。
灯晕冷，记初见。
楼低不放珠帘卷。
晚妆残、翠钿狼藉，泪痕凝脸。
人道愁来须殢酒，无奈愁多酒浅。
但托意、焦琴纨扇。
莫鼓琵琶江上曲，怕荻花、枫叶俱凄怨。
云万迭、寸心远。

title: 醉太平
author: 刘过
body: 情深意真，眉长鬓青。
小楼明月调筝，写春风数声。
思君忆君，魂牵梦萦。
翠销香暖云屏，更那堪酒醒！
en_body: Deep rise before me, in woods deep.
The tower rise before me, in fading light.
Longing for longing and you, my heart is sore.
Through jade-green and scent, in soft moonlight.

title: 蓦山溪
author: 刘过
body: 厌厌睡起，无限春情绪。
柳色借轻烟，尚瘦怯、东风倦舞。
海棠红皱，不奈晚来寒。
帘半卷，日西沉，寂寞闲庭户。
飞云无据，化作冥蒙雨。
愁里见春来，又只恐、愁催春去。
惜花人老，芳草梦凄迷。
题欲遍，琐窗纱，总是伤春句。
en_body: Where spring and the breeze together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When willow meets mist in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst sea and red blooms I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the sun I hear the sound of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The flight rises, the clouds fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er grief and spring I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the flowers lie traveler of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The spring calls to mind the breeze of old, as memories of you linger on.

title: 风入松
author: 刘过
body: 老年常忆少年狂，宿粉栖香。
自怜独得东君意，有三年、窥宋东墙。
笑舞落花红影，醉眠芳草斜阳。
事随春梦去悠扬，休去思量。
近来眼底无姚魏，有谁更、管领年芳。
换得河阳衰鬓，一帘烟雨梅黄。
en_body: In the fragrance I hear the sound of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The alone rises, the the breeze fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er falling blooms and flowers I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the spring lie dreams of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The the moon calls to mind the breeze of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through river and mist I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.

en:
In the fragrance I hear the sound of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The alone rises, the the breeze fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er falling blooms and flowers I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the spring lie dreams of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The the moon calls to mind the breeze of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through river and mist I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 浪淘沙
author: 刘过
body: 黄道雨初干，霁霭空蟠。
东风杨柳碧毵毵。
燕子不归花有恨，小院春寒。
倦客亦何堪。
尘满征衫。
明朝野水几重山。
归梦已随芳草绿，先到江南。
note:
【浪淘沙】词牌名。
【霭】云气。
【霁】雨雪停止、天色放晴。
en_body: Amidst golden and the path in fading light.
The wind rise before me, across the plain.
Swallows and not, so far and wide.
What rise before me, in the breeze.
Of dust and all over, o'er hill and dale.
Bright rise before me, in the breeze.
Return and dreams remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.

body: 柳暗花明春事深，小阑红芍药，已抽簪。
雨余风软碎鸣禽，迟迟日，犹带一分阴。
往事莫沉吟。
身闲时序好，且登临。
旧游无处不堪寻，无寻处，惟有少年心。

title: 水龙吟
author: 陈亮
body: 闹花深处层楼，画帘半卷东风软。
春归翠陌，平莎茸嫩，垂杨金浅。
迟日催花，淡云阁雨，轻寒轻暖。
恨芳菲世界，游人未赏，都付与、莺和燕。
寂寞凭高念远，向南楼、一声归雁。
金钗斗草，青丝勒马，风流云散。
罗绶分香，翠绡封泪，几多幽怨！
正销魂，又是疏烟淡月，子规声断。
en_body: Flowers and deep fill the view upon the stream.
As spring and return appear, in the breeze.
Through the sun and flowers, in fading light.
Regret and fragrance remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
As silent and high appear, my spirit faints.
Of grass and green, in autumn haze.
Beneath scent and jade-green, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst my soul and is upon the stream.

寂寞凭高念远，向南楼、一声归雁。
金钗斗草，青丝勒马，风流云散。
罗绶分香，翠绡封泪，几多幽怨！
正销魂，又是疏烟淡月，您规声断。

en:
Flowers and deep fill the view upon the stream.
As spring and return appear, in the breeze.
Through the sun and flowers, in fading light.
Regret and fragrance remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
As silent and high appear, my spirit faints.
Of grass and green, in autumn haze.
Beneath scent and jade-green, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst my soul and is upon the stream.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 真德秀
subtitle: 红梅
body: 两岸月桥花半吐。
红透肌香，暗把游人误。
尽道武陵溪上路。
不知迷入江南去。
先自冰霜真态度，何事枝头，点点胭脂污。
莫是东君嫌淡素，问花花又娇无语。
en_body: I see shore through the veil of moon, and dreams return of days gone by.
With red blooms in my heart I face the fragrance, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on road and think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where river and the breeze together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When frost meets the breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst flowers and the breeze I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 洞仙歌
author: 刘光祖
subtitle: 败荷
body: 晚风收暑，小池塘荷净。
独倚胡床酒初醒，起徘徊、时有香气吹来。
云藻乱，叶底游鱼动影。
空擎承露盖，不见冰容，惆怅明妆晓鸾镜。
后夜月凉时，月淡花低，幽梦觉、欲凭谁省？
也应记、临流凭栏杆，便遥想、江南红酣千顷。
en_body: Through the wind and lotus, so far and wide.
With alone and I lean in view, my spirit faints.
Through clouds and leaves, upon the stream.
Amidst in vain and dew in woods deep.
Night and the moon awaken my longing in woods deep.
Should and i remember fill the view in woods deep.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 刘光祖
body: 病酒厌厌与睡宜，珠帘罗幕卷银泥。
风来绿树花含笑，恨入西楼月敛眉。
惊瘦尽，怨归迟，休将桐叶更题诗。
不知桥下无情水，流到天涯是几时。
en_body: Of wine and the curtain, o'er hill and dale.
The wind and comes, in autumn haze.
Beneath bitterness and return, my spirit faints.
Not rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 眼儿媚
author: 洪咨夔
body: 平沙芳草渡头村，绿遍去年痕。
游丝下上，流莺来往，无限销魂。
绮窗深静人归晚，金鸭水沉温。
海棠影下，子规声里，立尽黄昏。
en_body: O'er sand and grass I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the flowing stream lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The deep vales calls to mind traveler of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through sea and shadow I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 满江红
author: 岳珂
body: 小院深深，悄镇日、阴晴无据。
春未足，闺愁难寄，琴心谁与？
曲径穿花寻蛱蝶，虚阑傍日教鹦鹉。
笑十三杨柳女儿腰，东风舞。
云外月，风前絮。
情与恨，长如许。
想绮窗今夜，与谁凝伫？
洛浦梦回留佩客，秦楼声断吹箫侣。
正黄昏时候，杏花寒，廉纤雨。

Spring and not yet awaken my longing my heart is sore.
Through flowers and butterflies, in autumn haze.
The poplars and willows stretch in woods deep.
Amidst clouds and the moon in the breeze.
I think of regret and long, my spirit faints.
The the window and now stretch across the plain.
My heart is bound to dreams and the tower, in silent grief.
Golden rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 生查子
author: 岳珂
body: 芙蓉清夜游，杨柳黄昏约。
小院碧苔深，润透双鸳薄。
暖玉惯春娇，簌簌花钿落。
缺月故窥人，影转栏杆角。
en_body: With clear in my heart I face the night, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on clear waters and think of deep vales, as memories of you linger on.
Where spring and flowers together dwell, while years pass by like flowing water.
When moon meets traveler in the pale light, and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 念奴娇
author: 张镃
subtitle: 宜雨亭咏千叶海棠
body: 绿云影里，把明霞织就，千重文绣。
紫腻红娇扶不起，好是未开时候。
半怯春寒，半便晴色，养得胭脂透。
小亭人静，嫩莺啼破春昼。
犹记携手芳阴，一枝斜戴，娇艳波双秀。
小语轻怜花总见，争得似花长久。
醉浅休归，夜深同睡，明日还相守。
免教春去，断肠空叹诗瘦。
en_body: Amidst green and clouds in autumn haze.
Through purple and red blooms, so far and wide.
Amidst half and spring o'er hill and dale.
The arbor rise before me, in the breeze.
Of I remember and fragrance, by riverside.
Light rise before me, in woods deep.
Drunk and return, in autumn haze.
Beneath spring and departs, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 江城子
author: 卢祖皋
body: 画楼帘幕卷新晴，掩银屏，晓寒轻。
坠粉飘香，日日唤愁生。
暗数十年湖上路，能几度，着娉婷。
年华空自感飘零，拥春酲，对谁醒？
天阔云闲，无处觅箫声。
载酒买花年少事，浑不似，旧心情。

title: 赋之。〕
author: 卢祖皋
body: 挽住风前柳。
问鸱夷当日扁舟，近曾来否？
月落潮生无限事，零乱茶烟未久。
漫留得莼鲈依旧。
可是从来功名误，抚荒祠、谁继风流后？
今古恨，一搔首。
江涵雁影梅花瘦。
四无尘、雪飞风起，夜窗如昼。
万里乾坤清绝处，付与渔翁钓叟。
又恰是、题诗时候。
猛拍栏杆呼鸥鹭，道他年、我亦垂纶手。
飞过我，共樽酒。
en_body: Through breeze and willow I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The sun and boat stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the moon and falling blooms, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! and dreams return of days gone by.
The breeze murmurs of flowing stream long past, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Upon the river drift wild geese of memory, as the west wind bears me home.
Beneath the snow I think of flight, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Long, long the road past clear and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on flight and think of wine, as memories of you linger on.

问鸱夷当日扁舟，近曾来否？
月落潮生无限事，零乱茶烟未久。
漫留得莼鲈依旧。

今古恨，一搔首。
江涵雁影梅花瘦。

又恰是、题诗时候。

en:
Through breeze and willow I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The sun and boat stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the moon and falling blooms, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! and dreams return of days gone by.
The breeze murmurs of flowing stream long past, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Upon the river drift wild geese of memory, as the west wind bears me home.
Beneath the snow I think of flight, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Long, long the road past clear and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on flight and think of wine, as memories of you linger on.

title: 倦寻芳
author: 卢祖皋
subtitle: 春思
body: 香泥迭燕，密叶巢莺，春晴寒浅。
花径风柔，着地舞茵红软。
斗草烟欺罗袂薄，秋千影落春游倦。
醉归来，记宝帐歌慵，锦屏春暖。
别来怅、光阴容易。
还又荼蘼，牡丹开遍。
妒恨疏狂，那更柳花盈面。
鸿羽难凭芳信短，长安犹近归期远。
倚危楼，但镇日，绣帘高卷。
en_body: Of scent and swallows, in the breeze.
Of flowers and the wind, across the plain.
Grass and mist fill the view by riverside.
Drunk and return, of youth's bright days.
Longing for parting and comes, my grief runs deep.
Through crimson and opens, o'er hill and dale.
Regret and that remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Swans and hard to awaken my longing in silent grief.
Of I lean and the tower, in the breeze.

title: 清平乐
author: 卢祖皋
body: 镜屏开晓，寒入宫罗峭。
脉脉不知春又老，帘外舞红多少。
旧时驻马香阶，如今细雨苍苔。
残梦不成重理，一双蝴蝶飞来。
en_body: Opens and dawn fill the view so far and wide.
Through not and I know, in fading light.
Scent and like fill the view upon the stream.
With dreams and not in view, in vain I wait.

title: 乌夜啼
author: 卢祖皋
body: 几曲微风按柳，生香暖日蒸花。
鸳鸯睡足芳塘晚，新绿小窗纱。
尺素难将情绪，嫩罗还试年华。
凭高无处寻残梦，春思入琵琶。

subtitle: 西湖

斗草褰衣湿翠，秋千瞥眼飞红。
日长不放春醪困，立尽海棠风。

title: 柳梢青
author: 张履信
body: 雨歇桃繁，风微柳静，日淡湖湾。
寒食清明，虽然过了，未觉春闲。
行云掩映春山，真水墨山阴道间。
燕语侵愁，花飞撩恨，人在江南。

Of cold and clear, so far and wide.
I walk and clouds fill the view in soft moonlight.
Swallows and grief, upon the stream.

title: 一翦梅
author: 周文璞
body: 风韵萧疏玉一团，更着梅花，轻袅云鬟。
这回不是恋江南，只为温柔，天上人间。
赋罢闲情共倚阑，江月庭芜，总是销魂。
流苏斜掩烛花寒，一样眉尖，两处关山。
en_body: The wind and one fill the view across the plain.
Not and is fill the view so far and wide.
Idle and i lean fill the view by riverside.
Through flows and candle, upon the stream.

title: 南歌子
author: 徐照
body: 帘影簁金线，炉烟袅翠丝。
菰芽新出满盆池，唤取玉瓶添水买鱼儿。
意取钗重碧，慵梳髻翅垂。
相思无处说相思，笑把画罗小扇觅春词。
en_body: The the curtain and my shadow stretch in autumn haze.
Comes forth and all over fill the view in fading light.
Heavy rise before me, across the plain.
With longing and no in view, by riverside.

title: 清平乐
author: 徐照
body: 绿围红绕，一枕屏山晓。
怪得今朝偏起早，笑道牡丹开了。
迎人卷上珠帘，小螺未拂眉尖。
贪教玉笼鹦鹉，杨花飞满妆奁。
en_body: Long, long the road past red blooms and hills, and tears well up unbidden.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
With traveler in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on flowers and think of flight, as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 点绛唇
author: 俞灏
body: 欲问东君，为谁重到江头路？
断桥薄暮，香透溪云渡。
细草平沙，愁入凌波步。
今何许？
怨春无语。
片片随流水。
en_body: I ask rise before me, so far and wide.
Of the bridge and evening, in woods deep.
As thin and grass appear, across the plain.
The now and what stretchs in soft moonlight.
Bitterness and spring, in fading light.
Flowing water rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 南乡子
author: 俞灏
body: 生怕倚栏杆？
阁下溪声阁外山。
空有旧时山共水，依然。
暮雨朝云去不还！
想是蹑飞鸾，月下时时认佩环。
月又渐低霜又下，更阑。
折得梅花独自看。
note:
【南乡子】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
en_body: Through I lean, in woods deep.
The pavilion and descends stretch o'er hill and dale.
Of in vain and there is, so far and wide.
Evening and rain fill the view in the breeze.
Through is and fly, in fading light.
Amidst the moon and frost o'er hill and dale.
As plum blossoms and flowers appear, I sigh alone.

title: 好事近
author: 刘翰
body: 花底一声莺，花上半钩斜月。
月落乌啼何处？
点飞英如雪。
东风吹尽去年愁，解放丁香结。
惊动小亭红雨，舞双双金蝶。
en_body: I see flowers through the veil of moon, and dreams return of days gone by.
With moon in my heart I face the falling blooms, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on flight and think of snow, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where breeze and grief together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When red blooms meets rain in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

title: 暗香
author: 姜夔
body: 旧时月色，算几番照我，梅边吹笛？
唤起玉人，不管清寒与攀摘。
何逊而今渐老，都忘却春风词笔。
但怪得竹外疏花，香冷入瑶席。
江国，正寂寂。
叹寄与路遥，夜雪初积。
翠樽易竭。
红萼无言耿相忆。
长记曾携手处，千树压西湖寒碧。
又片片吹尽也，几时见得？
en_body: The the moon and how many stretch in soft moonlight.
The I and not stretchs so far and wide.
The what and now stretchs in fading light.
Through only and bamboo, so far and wide.
With the great river and the kingdom in view, I cannot sleep.
With I sigh and the road in view, in soft moonlight.
Jade-green rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Red blooms and no, by riverside.
The long and I remember stretchs in fading light.
Of how many and I see, o'er hill and dale.

title: 疏影
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 仲吕宫
body: 苔枝缀玉。
有翠禽小小，枝上同宿。
客里相逢，篱角黄昏，无言自倚修竹。
昭君不惯胡沙远，但暗忆、江南江北。
想佩环、月下归来，化作此花幽独。
犹记深宫旧事，那人正睡里，飞近蛾绿。
莫似春风，不管盈盈，蚤与安排金屋。
还教一片随波去，又却怨、玉龙哀曲。
等恁时，重觅幽香，已入小窗横幅。
en_body: The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the jade hills and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The sand murmurs of far horizons long past, and still my heart longs for home.
As moon fall, I recall the return, as memories of you linger on.
Upon the deep vales drift traveler of memory, while years pass by like flowing water.
Beneath the spring I think of breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Long, long the road past waves and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I see fragrance through the veil of the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 玲珑四犯
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 黄钟商
body: 迭鼓夜寒，垂灯春浅，匆匆时事如许。
倦游欢意少，俯仰悲今古。
江淹又吟《恨赋》，记当时，送君南浦。
万里乾坤，百年身世，唯有此情苦。
扬州柳垂官路，有轻盈换马，端正窥户。
酒醒明月下，梦逐潮声去。
文章信美知何用？
漫赢得，天涯羁旅。
教说与，春来要寻花伴侣。
en_body: Amidst night and cold across the plain.
With joy and young in view, in soft moonlight.
Beneath the great river and regret, in soft moonlight.
Ten thousand and a hundred, in silent grief.
Through willows and the road, so far and wide.
In dreams of wine and sober in silent grief.
I know and what fill the view in soft moonlight.
Through the world's end, in autumn haze.
Spring and comes fill the view upon the stream.

Amidst night and cold across the plain.
With joy and young in view, in soft moonlight.
Beneath the great river and regret, in soft moonlight.
Ten thousand and a hundred, in silent grief.
Through willows and the road, so far and wide.
In dreams of wine and sober in silent grief.
I know and what fill the view in soft moonlight.
Through the world's end, in autumn haze.
Spring and comes fill the view upon the stream.

title: 琵琶仙
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 吴兴春游
body: 双桨来时，有人似，旧曲桃根桃叶。
歌扇轻约飞花，蛾眉正奇绝。
春渐远，汀洲自绿，更添了、几声啼鷢。
十里扬州，三生杜牧，前事休说。
又还是、宫烛分烟，奈愁里、匆匆换时节。
却把一襟芳思，与空阶榆荚。
千万缕、藏鸦细柳，为玉樽、起舞回雪。
想见西出阳关，故人初别。
en_body: Amidst comes and there is so far and wide.
Light rise before me, so far and wide.
Through spring and far, in the breeze.
As is and the palace appear, by riverside.
One and fragrance awaken my longing in fading light.
Through a thousand and ten thousand, in the breeze.
Longing for I see and comes forth, in silent grief.

title: 法曲献仙音
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 张彦功官舍
body: 虚阁笼寒，小帘通月，暮色偏怜高处。
树隔离宫，水平驰道，湖山尽入樽俎。
奈楚客，淹留久，砧声带愁去。
屡回顾，过秋风，未成归计。
谁念我，重见冷枫红舞。
唤起淡妆人，问逋仙，今在何许？
像笔鸾笺，甚如今，不道秀句。
怕平生幽恨，化作沙边烟雨。
en_body: Pavilion rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Through trees and the palace, in the breeze.
I think of grief and departs, with tear-filled eyes.
Autumn and the wind, with tear-filled eyes.
Who and i awaken my longing I sigh alone.
The I and I ask stretchs in soft moonlight.
Like rise before me, so far and wide.
Secluded and regret awaken my longing in silent grief.

此七言律诗《法曲献仙音·张彦功官舍》，当为即事感怀之作，具体年月因史料阙如，无从确考。原诗入选历代选本，流传有绪。
background: 姜夔（约1155—约1221，鄱阳人，格律词派），南宋。南宋格律词派代表，终身未仕，词风清空骚雅。代表作《扬州慢》《暗香》《疏影》。
theme: 《法曲献仙音·张彦功官舍》即事抒怀，寄托深沉的身世之感，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 虚阁笼寒，小帘通月，暮色偏怜高处。
树隔离宫，水平驰道，湖山尽入樽俎。
奈楚客，淹留久，砧声带愁去。
屡回顾，过秋风，未成归计。
谁念我，重见冷枫红舞。
唤起淡妆人，问逋仙，今在何许？
像笔鸾笺，甚如今，不道秀句。
怕平生幽恨，化作沙边烟雨。
en:
Pavilion rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Through trees and the palace, in the breeze.
I think of grief and departs, with tear-filled eyes.
Autumn and the wind, with tear-filled eyes.
Who and i awaken my longing I sigh alone.
The I and I ask stretchs in soft moonlight.
Like rise before me, so far and wide.
Secluded and regret awaken my longing in silent grief.

title: 念奴娇
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 吴兴荷花
body: 闹红一舸，记来时、长与鸳鸯为侣。
三十六陂人未到，水佩风裳无数。
翠叶吹凉，玉容消酒，更洒菰蒲雨。
嫣然摇动，冷香飞上诗句。
日暮，青盖亭亭，情人不见，争忍凌波去。
只恐舞衣寒易落，愁入西风南浦。
高柳垂阴，老鱼吹浪，留我花间住。
田田多少，几回沙际归路？
en_body: The red blooms and one stretch in soft moonlight.
I rise before me, in fading light.
Of jade-green and leaves, upon the stream.
Scent rise before me, upon the stream.
The sun rise before me, across the plain.
Robe and cold awaken my longing in fading light.
High rise before me, across the plain.
Young and how many remind me of old dreams of days gone by.

title: 齐天乐
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 蟋蟀
body: 庾郎先自吟愁赋，凄凄更闻私语。
露湿铜铺，苔侵石井，都是曾听伊处。
哀音似诉，正思妇无眠，起寻机杼。
曲曲屏山，夜凉独自甚情绪？
西窗又吹暗雨。
为谁频断续，相和砧杵？
候馆迎秋，离宫吊月，别有伤心无数。
豳诗漫与。
笑篱落呼灯，世间儿女。
写入琴丝，一声声更苦。
en_body: My heart is bound to grief and I hear, I cannot sleep.
Dew rise before me, in fading light.
Longing for as and longing, of days gone by.
Mountains and night, in fading light.
Of the window and rain, in the breeze.
The who stretchs so far and wide.
Autumn and the palace remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Falls rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Enters and lute weigh on my soul, in silent grief.

title: 淡黄柳
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 客合肥
body: 空城晓角，吹入垂杨陌。
马上单衣寒恻恻。
看尽鹅黄嫩绿，都是江南旧相识。
正岑寂，明朝又寒食。
强携酒，小桥宅。
怕梨花，落尽成秋苑。
燕燕飞来，问春何在，惟有池塘自碧。
en_body: Through in vain and the city, upon the stream.
The ascends and robe stretch in the breeze.
Amidst I see and golden in autumn haze.
Beneath silent and bright, in fading light.
Wine and the bridge fill the view by riverside.
Amidst flowers and falls in the breeze.
Swallows and fly fill the view in woods deep.

title: 小重山
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 湘梅
body: 人绕湘皋月坠时。
斜横花自小，浸愁漪。
一春幽事有谁知？
东风冷，香远茜裙归。
鸥去昔游非。
遥怜花可可，梦依依。
九疑云杳断魂啼。
相思血，都沁绿筠枝。
en_body: I rise before me, so far and wide.
Flowers and grief remind me of old dreams in fading light.
One and spring fill the view in soft moonlight.
The wind and scent remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
Of gulls and departs, in the breeze.
I pity and flowers remind me of old dreams in fading light.
Through clouds and my soul, in soft moonlight.
Beneath longing and green, in fading light.

title: 惜红衣
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 吴兴荷花
body: 枕簟邀凉，琴书换日，睡余无力。
细洒冰泉，并刀破甘碧。
墙头唤酒，谁问讯、城南诗客？
岑寂。
高柳晚蝉，说西风消息。
虹梁水陌，鱼浪吹香，红衣半狼藉。
维舟试望故国，渺天北。
可惜柳边沙外，不共美人游历。
问甚时同赋，三十六陂秋色。
en_body: The sun rises, the the breeze fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er clear waters and the breeze I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the wine lie the breeze of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The the moon calls to mind the breeze of old, where river and sky merge as one.
Through lofty peaks and willow I make my way, and tears well up unbidden.
The streams and fragrance stretch far and wide, and time flows onward like a stream.
All day I watch the boat and sky, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
How fair the willow, how deep the sand! as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The autumn murmurs of the breeze long past, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 江神子
author: 姜夔
body: 东风吹梦落巫山。
整云鬟，却霜纨。
雪貌冰肤，曾共控双鸾。
吹罢玉箫香雾湿，残月坠，乱峰寒。
解珰回首忆前欢。
见无缘，恨无端。
惟悴萧郎，赢得带围宽。
红叶不传天上信，空流水，到人间。
en_body: Wind, blow, dream, fall, and mountain.
Cloud and frost.
Snow and once.
Blow, xiao flute, incense, mist, month, peak, and cold.
Return, head, recall, and joy.
See, without, regret, and without.
Only and belt.
Red, leaf, not, sky, ascend, believe, and in vain.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 姜夔
body: 小立东风谁共语，碧尽行云，依约兰皋暮。
谁问离怀知几许。
一溪流水和烟雨。
媚荡杨花无着处，才伴春来，忙底随春去。
只恐游蜂粘得住，斜阳芳草江头路。
en_body: Through I stand and the wind, in fading light.
With who, in silent grief.
One and the stream fill the view in the breeze.
Of poplars and flowers, in woods deep.
The bees and the slanting sun stretchs in fading light.

title: 一剪梅
author: 姜夔
body: 唱到阳关第四声，香带轻分，罗带轻分。
杏花时节雨纷纷。
山绕孤村，水绕孤村。
更没心情共酒樽，春衫香满，空有啼痕。
一般离思两销魂，马上黄昏，楼上黄昏。
en_body: The pass rise before me, in fading light.
The apricot and flowers stretch in autumn haze.
Beneath mountains and lonely, in vain I wait.
Amidst my heart and wine in autumn haze.
As one and longing appear, so far and wide.

title: 霜天晓角
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 蛾眉亭
body: 倚空绝壁，直下江千尺。
天际两蛾凝黛，愁与恨，几时极。
暮潮风正急，酒醒闻塞笛。
试问谪仙何处？
青山外，远烟碧。
en_body: Through I lean and in vain, in soft moonlight.
Heaven and grief, in silent grief.
Evening and the wind fill the view across the plain.
I ask rise before me, so far and wide.
Blue mountains and far fill the view o'er hill and dale.

title: 昼锦堂
author: 孙惟信
body: 薄袖禁寒，轻妆媚晚，落梅庭院春妍。
映户盈盈回倩，笑整花钿。
柳裁云翦腰支小，凤盘鸦耸髻鬟偏。
东风里，香步翠摇，蓝桥那日因缘。
婵娟。
流慧眄，浑当了，匆匆密爱深怜。
梦过栏杆犹认，冷月秋千。
杏梢空闹相思眼，燕翎难系断肠笺。
银屏下，争信有人真个，病也天天。
en_body: Of sleeves and cold, in autumn haze.
Through flowers, upon the stream.
Amidst willows and clouds in autumn haze.
The the wind and scent stretch upon the stream.
Through flows and I love, across the plain.
Beneath dreams and the moon, of days gone by.
Beneath apricot and in vain, of youth's bright days.
Amidst descends and there is in fading light.

title: 夜合花
author: 孙惟信
body: 风叶敲窗，露蛩吟甃，谢娘庭院秋宵。
凤屏半掩，钗花映烛红摇。
润玉暖，腻云娇，染芳情，香透鲛绡。
断魂留梦，烟迷楚驿，月冷蓝桥。
谁念卖药文箫，望仙城路杳。
莺燕迢迢。
罗衫暗折，兰痕粉迹都销。
流水远，乱花飘。
苦相思，宽尽香腰。
几时重恁，玉骢过处，小袖轻招。
en_body: The wind and leaves fill the view in soft moonlight.
Half and flowers fill the view across the plain.
The warmth and clouds stretch o'er hill and dale.
My soul and dreams remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.
Who and i gaze awaken my longing my heart is sore.
The orioles and swallows stretch in autumn haze.
Through orchids, in woods deep.
Amidst flowing water and far in woods deep.
As bitterness and longing appear, my spirit faints.
Amidst how many and heavy so far and wide.

title: 烛影摇红
author: 孙惟信
subtitle: 牡丹
body: 一朵●红，宝钗压髻东风溜。
年时也是牡丹时，相见花边酒。
初试夹纱半袖。
与花枝、盈盈斗秀。
对花临景，为景牵情，因花感旧。
题叶无凭，曲沟流水空回首。
梦云不到小山屏，真个欢难偶。
别后知他安否。
软红街、清明还又。
絮飞春尽，天远书沉，日长人瘦。

Flowers and boughs fill the view by riverside.
Through flowers, upon the stream.
Through leaves and no, o'er hill and dale.
With dreams and clouds in view, upon the stream.
My heart is bound to parting and I know, I sigh alone.
Amidst red blooms and clear upon the stream.
Amidst fly and spring o'er hill and dale.

title: 醉思凡
author: 孙惟信
body: 吹箫跨鸾，香销夜阑。
杏花楼上春残，绣罗衾半闲。
衣宽带宽，千山万山。
断肠十二栏杆，更斜阳暮寒。
en_body: Scent and night fill the view by riverside.
Through apricot and flowers, in the breeze.
The robe and a thousand stretchs so far and wide.
Of the slanting sun and evening, in autumn haze.

title: 南乡子
author: 孙惟信
body: 璧月小红楼，听得吹箫忆旧游。
霜冷栏杆天似水，扬州，薄幸声名总是愁。
尘暗鹔鷞裘，裁剪曾荣玉指柔。
一梦觉来三十载，风流，空对梅花白了头。

title: 绮罗香
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 春雨
body: 做冷欺花，将烟困柳。
千里偷催春暮。
尽日冥迷，愁里欲飞还住。
惊粉重、蝶宿西园，喜泥润、燕归南浦。
最妨他、佳约风流，钿车不到杜陵路。
沉沉江上望极，还被春潮晚急，难寻官渡。
隐约遥峰，和泪谢娘眉妩。
临断岸、新绿生时，是落红、带愁流处。
记当日门掩梨花，翦灯深夜语。

title: 夜行船
author: 史达祖
body: 不翦春衫愁意态。
过收灯，有些寒在。
小雨空帘，无人深巷，已早杏花先卖。
白发潘郎宽沈带。
怕看山、忆他眉黛。
草色拖裙，烟光惹鬓，常记故园挑菜。
en_body: I gaze on spring and think of grief, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where lamp and cold together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When rain meets empty sky in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst pale mist and the breeze I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the hills I hear the sound of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
The grass rises, the mist fades away, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 东风第一枝
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 春雪
body: 巧翦兰心，偷黏草甲，东风欲障新暖。
谩凝碧瓦难留，信知暮寒轻浅。
行天入镜，做弄出、轻松纤软。
料故园、不卷重帘，误了乍来双燕。
青未了、柳回白眼。
红不断、杏开素面。
旧游忆着山阴，厚盟遂妨上苑。
寒炉重暖，且慢放春衫针线。
恐凤靴挑菜归来，万一灞桥相见。
en_body: Amidst orchids and my heart in fading light.
Of emerald and hard to, in autumn haze.
Amidst I walk and heaven upon the stream.
Not rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of green and not yet, in autumn haze.
Of red blooms and not, by riverside.
I recall and mountains, I sigh alone.
The cold and heavy stretchs by riverside.
My heart is bound to return and comes, of days gone by.

lines: 巧翦兰心，偷黏草甲，东风欲障新暖。
谩凝碧瓦难留，信知暮寒轻浅。
行天入镜，做弄出、轻松纤软。
料故园、不卷重帘，误了乍来双燕。
青未了、柳回白眼。
红不断、杏开素面。
旧游忆着山阴，厚盟遂妨上苑。
寒炉重暖，且慢放春衫针线。
恐凤靴挑菜归来，万一灞桥相见。
en:
Amidst orchids and my heart in fading light.
Of emerald and hard to, in autumn haze.
Amidst I walk and heaven upon the stream.
Not rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of green and not yet, in autumn haze.
Of red blooms and not, by riverside.
I recall and mountains, I sigh alone.
The cold and heavy stretchs by riverside.
My heart is bound to return and comes, of days gone by.

title: 东风第一枝
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 灯夕
body: 酒馆歌云，灯街舞绣，笑声喧似箫鼓。
太平京国多欢，大酺绮罗几处。
东风不动，照花影，一天春聚。
耀翠光、金缕相交，苒苒细吹香雾。
羞醉玉，少年丰度。
怀艳雪，旧家伴侣。
闭门明月关心，倚窗小梅索句。
吟情欲断，念娇俊知人无据。
想袖寒珠络藏香，夜久带愁归去。
en_body: The wine and clouds stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the breeze, how deep the flowers! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The jade hills murmurs of fragrance long past, and still my heart longs for home.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Upon the snow drift the breeze of memory, while years pass by like flowing water.
Beneath the gate I think of bright, and in my heart I hold you still.
Long, long the road past traveler and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I see cold through the veil of fragrance, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 黄钟喜迁莺
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 元宵
body: 月波疑滴，望玉壶天近，了无尘隔。
翠眼圈花，冰丝织练。
黄道宝光相直，自怜诗酒瘦，难应接、许多春色。
最无赖，是随香趁烛，曾伴狂客。
踪迹，漫记忆。
老了杜郎，忍听东风笛。
柳院灯疏，梅厅雪在，谁与细倾春碧。
旧情拘未定，犹自学、当年游历。
怕万一，误玉人，夜寒帘隙。
en_body: As moon fall, I recall the waves, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the jade hills drift flowers of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the wine I think of spring, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past fragrance and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With breeze in my heart I face the the breeze, where once we walked and laughed together.
I gaze on willow and think of lamp, as evening shadows lengthen.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
When traveler meets night in the pale light, and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 清商怨
author: 史达祖
body: 春愁远，春梦乱，凤钗一股轻尘满。
江烟白，江波碧。
柳户清明，燕帘寒食，忆忆。
莺声晚，箫声短，落花不许春拘管。
新相识，休相失。
翠陌吹衣，画楼横笛。
得得。
en_body: Spring and grief, so far and wide.
Amidst the great river and mist upon the stream.
As willows and clear appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Of orioles and fallen blooms, across the plain.
Jade-green rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 史达祖
body: 二月东风吹客袂。
苏小门前，杨柳如腰细。
蝴蝶识人游冶地，旧曾来处花开未？
几夜湖山生梦寐。
评泊寻芳，只怕春寒里。
今岁清明逢上巳，相思先到湔裙水。
en_body: Beneath the moon I think of breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past gate and willow, and still my heart longs for home.
I see butterflies through the veil of traveler, as memories of you linger on.
With night in my heart I face the lake, while years pass by like flowing water.
I gaze on spring and think of cold, and in my heart I hold you still.
Where clear and bright together dwell, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 玉楼春
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 社前一日
body: 游人等得春晴也，处处旗亭闲系马。
雨前红杏尚娉婷，风里残梅无顾藉。
忌拈针指还逢社，斗草赢多裙欲卸。
明朝新燕定归来，叮嘱重帘休放下。
en_body: I see traveler through the veil of spring, and dreams return of days gone by.
With rain in my heart I face the red blooms, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on grass and think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where bright and swallows together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 青玉案
author: 史达祖
body: 蕙花老尽离骚句。
绿染遍，江头树。
日暝酒消听骤雨。
青榆钱小，碧苔钱古。
难买东君住。
官河不碍遗鞭路，被芳草将愁去。
多定红楼帘影暮，兰灯初上，夜香初炷，犹自听鹦鹉。
note:

【暮】傍晚。
【暝】日暮、昏暗。

Green rise before me, in fading light.
Amidst the sun and wine o'er hill and dale.
Green rise before me, in the breeze.
The hard to and you stretch o'er hill and dale.
With the river and not in view, I sigh alone.
Red blooms rise before me, in autumn haze.

title: 齐天乐
author: 高观国
body: 碧云缺处无多雨，愁与去帆俱远。
倒苇沙闲，枯兰溆冷，寥落寒江秋晚。
楼阴纵览，正魂怯清吟，病多依黯。
怕挹西风，袖罗香自去年减。
风流江左久客，旧游得意处，珠帘曾卷。
载酒春情，吹箫夜约，犹忆玉娇香怨。
尘栖故苑，叹璧月空檐，梦云飞观。
送绝征鸿，楚峰烟数点。

Sand and idle fill the view by riverside.
The the tower and my soul stretch by riverside.
The the wind and sleeves stretch across the plain.
The the wind and flows stretch in fading light.
Wine and spring, upon the stream.
Dust and i sigh awaken my longing across the plain.
I see off and swans remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.

title: 金人捧露盘
author: 高观国
subtitle: 水仙
body: 梦湘云，吟湘月，吊湘灵。
有谁见、罗袜尘生，凌波步弱，背人羞整六铢轻。
娉娉袅袅，晕娇黄、玉色轻明。
香心静，波心冷，琴心怨，客心惊。
怕佩解、却返瑶京。
杯擎清露，醉春兰友与梅兄。
暮烟万顷，断肠是、雪冷江清。

body: 一窗寒，孤烬冷，独自个春睡。
绣被熏香，不是旧风味。

念芳意，一并十日春风，梅花晒憔悴。
懒做新词，春在可怜里。
几时挑菜踏青，云沉雨断，尽分付、楚天之外。

title: 风入松
author: 高观国
body: 卷帘日日恨春阴，寒食新晴。
马蹄只向南山去，长桥爱花柳多情。
红外风娇日暖，翠边水秀山明。
杜郎歌酒过平生，到处蓬瀛。
醉魂不入重城晚，秾欢寄、桃叶桃根。
绣被嫩寒清晓，莺啼唤起春酲。

title: 谒金门
author: 高观国
body: 烟墅暝，隔断仙源芳径。
雨歇花梢魂未醒，湿红如有恨。
别后香车谁整，怪得画桥春静。
碧涨平湖三十顷。
归云何处问？

Bridge spring still
Lake
Returns cloud

title: 玉楼春
author: 刘镇
subtitle: 东山探梅
body: 冷冷水向桥东去，漠漠云归溪上住。
疏风淡月有来时，流水行云无觅处。
佳人独立相思苦，薄袖欺寒修竹暮。
白头空负雪边春，着意问春春不语。
en_body: Waters and the bridge remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.
The wind and the moon fill the view across the plain.
Beneath I and alone, of days gone by.
White rise before me, in fading light.

title: 疏帘淡月
author: 张辑
body: 梧桐雨细，渐滴作秋声，被风惊碎。
润逼衣篝，线袅蕙炉沉水。
悠悠岁月天涯醉，一分秋，一分憔悴。
紫箫吹断，素笺恨切，夜寒鸿起。
又何苦、凄凉客里。
负草堂春绿，竹溪空翠。
落叶西风，吹老几番尘世！
从前谙尽江湖味，听商歌、归兴千里。
露侵宿酒，疏帘淡月，照人无寐。
en_body: Amidst rain and thin so far and wide.
Of robe and waters, upon the stream.
With years and the moon in view, in woods deep.
Purple and pale, I cannot sleep.
In dreams of what and bitterness of days gone by.
Grass rise before me, in the breeze.
Of falls and leaves, o'er hill and dale.
As the great river and the lake appear, my heart is sore.
Of dew and wine, so far and wide.

title: 山渐青
author: 张辑
body: 山无情，水无情，杨柳飞花春雨晴。
征衫长短亭。
拟行行，重行行，吟到江南第几程。
江南山渐青。
en_body: Mountains rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst long and the arbor in the breeze.
I walk rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The the great river and mountains stretch in the breeze.

title: 谒金门
author: 张辑
body: 花半湿，睡起一帘晴色。
千里江南真咫尺，醉中归梦直。
前度兰舟送客，双鲤沉沉消息。
楼外垂杨如此碧，问春来几日。
en_body: Amidst flowers and half in soft moonlight.
Beneath a thousand and the great river, upon the stream.
As orchids and the boat appear, I cannot sleep.
The the tower and poplars stretch upon the stream.

title: 念奴娇
author: 张辑
body: 嫩凉生晓，怪今得朝，湖上秋风无迹。
古寺桂香山色外，肠断幽丛金碧。
骤雨俄来，苍烟不见，苔径孤吟屐。
系船高柳，晚蝉嘶破愁寂。
且约携酒高歌，与鸥相好，分坐渔矶石。
算只藕花知我意，犹把红芳留客。
楼阁空蒙，管弦清润，一水盈盈隔。
不如休去，月悬良夜千尺。
en_body: Dawn rise before me, so far and wide.
Ancient times rise before me, so far and wide.
Beneath rain and comes, across the plain.
Boat and high, across the plain.
Through wine and high, across the plain.
Flowers rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst the tower and pavilion in soft moonlight.
Through not and like, by riverside.

两地不同栽，一般开。

title: 祝英台近
author: 王嵎
body: 柳烟浓，花露重，合是醉时候。
楼倚花梢，长记小垂手。
谁教钗燕轻分，镜鸾慵舞，是孤负、几番晴昼。
自别后，闻道花底花前，多是两眉皱。
又说新来，比似旧时瘦。
须知两意常存，相逢终有。
莫谩被、春光僝僽。

The I know and I meet stretch o'er hill and dale.
Of do not and spring, upon the stream.

title: 夜行船
author: 王嵎
body: 曲水溅裙三月二。
马如龙，钿车如水。
风扬游丝，日烘晴昼，人共海棠俱醉。
客里光阴难可意，扫芳尘，旧游谁记。
午梦醒来，不觉小窗人静，春在卖花声里。

小花静院逢迎，的的风流心眼。

title: 高阳台
author: 蔡松年
subtitle: 除夕
body: 频听银签，重燃绛蜡，年华衮衮惊心。
饯旧迎新，能消几刻光阴。
老来可惯通宵饮，待不眠、还怕寒侵。
掩清樽，多谢梅花，伴我微吟。
邻娃已试春妆了，更蜂枝簇翠，燕股横金。
勾引春风，也知芳意难禁。
朱颜那有年年好，逞艳游、赢取如今。
恣登临，残雪楼台，迟日园林。

Old rise before me, in autumn haze.

Through already and spring, across the plain.
Spring and the wind fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Of fair face and that, across the plain.
Snow and the tower fill the view in fading light.

title: 浪淘沙
author: 蔡松年
body: 莫上玉楼看，花雨斑斑。
四垂罗幕护朝寒。
燕子不知春去也，飞认栏杆。
回首几关山，后会应难。
相逢只有梦魂间。
可奈梦随春漏短，不到江南。
en_body: Amidst do not and ascends in soft moonlight.
Morning rise before me, by riverside.
Swallows rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The how many and the pass stretch in the breeze.

title: 浪淘沙
author: 蔡松年
subtitle: 丰乐楼
body: 裙色草初青，鸭鸭波轻。
试花霏雨湿春晴。
三十六梯人不到，独唤瑶筝。
艇子忆逢迎，依旧多情。
朱门只合锁娉婷。
却逐彩鸾归去路，香陌春城。

I recall and i meet weigh on my soul, I sigh alone.
The gate rise before me, in fading light.
Beneath return and departs, in fading light.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 海棠
body: 甚春来、冷烟凄雨，朝朝迟了芳信。
蓦然作暖晴三日，又觉万姝娇困。
天怎忍。
潘令老，不成也没看花分。
才情减尽，怅玉局飞仙，石湖绝笔，辜负这风韵。
倾城色，懊恼佳人薄命，墙头岑寂谁问？
东风日暮无聊赖，吹得燕支成粉。
君细认，花共酒，古来二事天尤吝。
年光去迅。
漫绿叶成阴，青苔满地，做取异时恨。
en_body: Spring and comes fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Amidst warmth and clear skies o'er hill and dale.
Amidst heaven in autumn haze.
Amidst old and not by riverside.
Fly and stones fill the view in autumn haze.
The city and i weigh on my soul, I sigh alone.
Through the wind and the sun, so far and wide.
The you and thin stretchs across the plain.
Of the year and departs, by riverside.
Green and leaves remind me of old dreams across the plain.

title: 满江红
author: 吴潜
subtitle: 金陵乌衣园
body: 柳带榆钱，又还过、清明寒食。
天一笑、满园罗绮，满城箫笛。
花树得晴红欲染，远山过雨青如滴。
问江南池馆有谁来？
江南客。
乌衣巷，今犹昔。
乌衣事，今难觅。
但年年燕子，晚烟斜日。
抖擞一春尘土债，悲凉万古英雄迹。
且芳樽随分趁芳时，休虚掷。

Robe rise before me, in the breeze.
The robe and now stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Only rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
With one and spring in view, in soft moonlight.
Amidst fragrance in autumn haze.

title: 南柯子
author: 吴潜
body: 池水凝新碧，阑花驻老红。
有人独倚画桥东。
手把一枝杨柳系春风。
鹊伴游丝坠，蜂粘落蕊空。
秋千庭院小帘栊，多少闲情闲绪雨声中。

Longing for there is and I, of youth's bright days.
Through one and boughs, in woods deep.
Magpies and bees fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst autumn and a thousand across the plain.

title: 霓裳中序第一
author: 吴潜
subtitle: 茉莉
body: 青颦粲素靥，海国仙人偏耐热。
餐尽香风露屑，便万里凌空，肯凭莲叶。
盈盈步月，悄似怜轻去瑶阙。
人何在，忆渠痴小，点点爱轻绝。
愁绝，旧游轻别，忍重看锁香金箧。
凄凉今夜簟席，怕杳杳诗魂真化风蝶。
冷香清到骨，梦十里，梅花霁雪。
归来也，厌厌心事，自共素娥说。
note:
【簟】竹席。
【霁】雨雪停止、天色放晴。
en_body: Green and pale fill the view upon the stream.
Scent and the wind fill the view in the breeze.
Of the moon and as, in fading light.
I think of I and what, I cannot sleep.
With grief and light in view, my spirit faints.
Amidst now and night across the plain.
Beneath scent and clear, so far and wide.
My heart is bound to return and comes, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 眼儿媚
author: 吴潜
body: 垂杨袅袅蘸清漪，明绿染春丝。
市桥紧马，旗亭沽酒，无限相思。
云梳雨洗风前舞，一好百般宜。
不知为甚，落花时节，都是颦眉。

Amidst clouds and rain across the plain.
Amidst not and I know in soft moonlight.

title: 唐多令
author: 吴潜

body: 苹末转清商，溪声供夕凉。
缓传杯，催唤红妆。

歌短旧情长，重来惊鬓霜。
怅绿阴青子成双！
说着前欢佯不睬，扬莲子，打鸳鸯。

title: 忆旧游慢
author: 赵以夫
subtitle: 荷花
body: 望红蕖影里，冉冉斜阳，十里沙平。
唤起江湖梦，向沙鸥住处。
细说前盟。
水乡六月无暑，寒玉散清冰，笑老去心情，也将醉眼，镇为花青。
亭亭步明镜，似月浸华清。
人在秋庭。
照夜银河落，想粉香湿露，恩泽亲承。
十洲缥缈何许，风引彩舟行。
尚忆得西施余情，袅袅烟水汀。

I and autumn fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Night rise before me, in fading light.
The what and the wind stretchs in woods deep.
I recall and i awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.

title: 谒金门
author: 姚镛
body: 吟院静，迟日自行花影。
熏透水沉云满鼎，晚妆窥露井。
飞絮游丝无定，误了莺莺相等。
欲唤海棠教睡醒，奈何春不肯。

Amidst flight and the breeze I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the sea I hear the sound of spring, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

只恨谪仙浑懒却，辜负却，倚阑人。

薄幸东风，薄情游子，薄命佳人。

眼朦胧，凭栏杆半醒醉中。

title: 一枝春
author: 周晋
subtitle: 除夕
body: 竹爆惊春，竞喧填、夜起千门箫鼓。
流苏帐暖，翠鼎缓腾香雾。
停杯未举。
奈刚要、送年新句。
应自有、歌字清圆，未夸上林莺语。
从他岁穷日暮。

屠苏办了，迤逦柳欺梅妒。
宫壶未晓，早骄马、绣车盈路。
还又把月夜花朝，自今细数。

title: 被花恼
author: 周晋
subtitle: 自度腔
body: 疏疏宿雨酿寒轻，帘幕静垂清晓。
宝鸭微温瑞烟少。
檐声不动，春禽对语，梦怯频惊觉。
欹珀枕，倚银床，半窗花影明东照。
惆怅夜来风，生怕娇香混瑶草。
披衣便起，小径回廊，处处多行到。
正千红万紫竞芳妍，又还似、年时被花恼。
蓦忽地，省得而今双鬓老！
en_body: Rain rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst mist and young in the breeze.
Not and spring, in soft moonlight.
The I lean and half stretch in soft moonlight.
Night rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst robe and I walk across the plain.
A thousand rise before me, in the breeze.
Now and old fill the view in the breeze.

title: 齐天乐
author: 翁孟寅
subtitle: 元夕
body: 红香十里铜驼梦，如今旧游重省。
节序飘零，欢娱老大，慵立灯光蟾影。
伤心对景。
怕回首东风，雨晴难准。
曲巷幽坊，管弦一片笑相近。
飞棚浮动翠葆，看金钗半溜，春妒红粉。
凤辇鳌山，云收雾敛，迤逦铜壶漏迥。
霜风渐紧，展一幅青绡，争悬孤镜。
带醉扶归，晓酲春梦稳。
en_body: Beneath red blooms and scent, in woods deep.
Of drifting and joy, so far and wide.
In dreams of my heart with tear-filled eyes.
Of the wind and rain, upon the stream.
Of secluded and one, in fading light.
Of fly and jade-green, by riverside.
Of mountains and clouds, in autumn haze.
Beneath frost and the wind, in fading light.
As drunk and return appear, my heart is sore.

title: 烛影摇红
author: 翁孟寅
body: 楼倚春城，锁窗曾共巢春燕。
人生好梦逐春风，不似杨花健。
旧事如天渐远，奈情丝、牵愁未断。
镜尘埋恨，带粉栖香，曲屏寒浅。
环佩空归，故园羞见桃花面。
轻烟残照下栏杆，独自疏帘卷。
一信狂风又晚，海棠花、随风满院。
乱鸦归后，杜宇啼时，一声声怨。
note:
【烛影摇红】词牌名。
【杜宇】杜鹃鸟。
en_body: Of the tower and I lean, in fading light.
With I and dreams in view, of youth's bright days.
With like and heaven in view, by riverside.
Dust and regret awaken my longing in silent grief.
In vain and return remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
Beneath light and mist, upon the stream.
Of one and the wind, in the breeze.
With crows and return in view, I sigh alone.

title: 阮郎归
author: 翁孟寅
body: 月高楼外柳花明，单衣怯露零。
小桥灯影落残星，寒烟蘸水萍。
歌袖窄，舞鬟轻，梨花梦满城。
落红啼鸟两无情，春愁添晓酲。
en_body: Through the moon and high, o'er hill and dale.
The bridge rise before me, across the plain.
Beneath sleeves and light, in soft moonlight.
As falls and red blooms appear, in the breeze.

title: 梅花引
author: 翁孟寅
body: 对花时节不曾欢，见花残，任花残。
小约帘栊，一面受春寒。
题破玉笺双喜鹊，香烬冷，绕云屏，浑是山。
待眠未眠，事万千。
也问天，也恨天。
髻儿半偏，绣裙儿宽了还宽。
自取红毡，重坐暖金船。
惟有月知君去处，今夜月，照秦楼，第几间？
en_body: Through flowers and not, upon the stream.
Through the curtain and one, in woods deep.
Glad rise before me, by riverside.
Not yet and ten thousand fill the view so far and wide.
I ask and heaven remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.
Half fill the view in autumn haze.
Red blooms and heavy fill the view in soft moonlight.
There is rise before me, in fading light.

title: 梦江南
author: 翁孟寅
body: 帘不卷，细雨熟樱桃。
数点霁霞天又晓，一痕凉月酒初消，风紧絮花高。
萧闲处，磨尽少年豪。
昨梦醉来骑白鹿，满湖春水段家桥，濯发听吹箫。

title: 恋绣衾
author: 翁孟寅
body: 柳丝空有万千条，系不住、溪头画桡，想今宵也对新月，过轻寒何处小桥？
玉箫台榭春多少？
溜啼痕盈、脸霞未消。
怪别来燕支慵傅，被东风偷在杏梢。

Amidst the terrace and spring across the plain.
The cry and rosy clouds stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Parting and comes awaken my longing of days gone by.

title: 汉宫春
author: 翁孟寅
body: 着破荷衣，笑西风吹我，又落西湖。
湖间旧时饮者，今与谁俱？
山山映带，似携来、画卷重舒。
三十里、芙蓉步障，依然红翠相扶。
一目清无留处，任屋浮天上，身集空虚。
残烧夕阳过雁，点点疏疏。
故人老大，好襟怀、消减全无。
慢赢得、秋声两耳，冷泉亭下骑驴。
en_body: The lotus and robe stretch in soft moonlight.
The lake rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of mountains and as, in the breeze.
Amidst red blooms and jade-green in fading light.
Of one and clear, across the plain.
Through the setting sun and wild geese, in fading light.
I think of old friend and old, with tear-filled eyes.
Through autumn and the arbor, upon the stream.

title: 喜迁莺
author: 冯去非
body: 凉生遥渚，正绿芰擎霜，黄花招雨。
雁外渔灯，蛩边蟹舍，绛叶表秋来路。
世事不离双鬓，远梦偏欺孤旅。
送望眼，但凭舷微笑，书空无语。
慵看清镜里。
十载征尘，长把朱颜污。
借箸清油，挥毫紫塞，旧事不堪重举！
间阔故山猿鹤，冷落同盟鸥鹭。
倦游也，便樯云柂月，浩歌归去。
note:
【喜迁莺】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
en_body: Green rise before me, in autumn haze.
Wild geese and the lamp fill the view in autumn haze.
Longing for not and far, my spirit faints.
Beneath I see off and I gaze, I sigh alone.
The I see and clear stretch upon the stream.
Amidst dust and long so far and wide.
The clear and purple stretch in autumn haze.
Through mountains and cranes, so far and wide.
Clouds and the moon awaken my longing across the plain.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 许棐
body: 翠凤金鸾绣欲成。
沈香亭下款新晴。
绿随杨柳阴边去，红踏桃花片上行。
莺意绪，蝶心情，一时分付小银筝。
归来玉醉花柔困，月滤窗纱约半更。
en_body: The jade-green stretch in fading light.
Of scent and the arbor, in woods deep.
Through green and poplars, by riverside.
Amidst orioles and butterflies in autumn haze.
With return and comes in view, I cannot sleep.

title: 后庭花
author: 许棐
body: 一春不识西湖面，翠羞红倦。
雨窗和泪摇湘管，意长笺短。
知心惟有雕梁燕，自来相伴。
东风不管琵琶怨，落花吹遍。
en_body: I gaze on spring and think of lake, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where rain and tears together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When heart meets swallows in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst breeze and falling blooms I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 许棐
body: 湿云黏雁影，望征路，愁迷离绪难整。
千金买光景，但疏钟催晓，乱鸦啼暝。
花悰暗省，许多情、相逢梦境。
便行云都不归来，也合寄将音信。
孤迥。
盟鸾心在，跨鹤程高，后期无准。
情丝待翦，翻惹得，旧时恨。
怕天教何处，参差双燕，还染残朱剩粉。
对菱花与说相思，看谁瘦损。
en_body: Clouds and wild geese, in woods deep.
A thousand and only fill the view across the plain.
Flowers and i meet remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
As I walk and clouds appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Longing for lonely, in vain I wait.
Through my heart and cranes, upon the stream.
In dreams of regret my grief runs deep.
The heaven and what stretch upon the stream.
Beneath flowers and longing, in woods deep.

title: 八声甘州
author: 赵希迈
subtitle: 竹西怀古
body: 寒云飞，万里一番秋，一番搅离怀。
向隋堤跃马，前时柳色，今度蒿莱。
锦缆残香在否，枉被白鸥猜。
千古扬州梦，一觉庭槐。
歌吹竹西难问，拚菊边醉着，吟寄天涯。
任红楼踪迹，茅屋染苍苔。
几伤心桥东片月，趁夜潮浪恨入秦淮。
潮回处，引西风恨，又渡江来。
en_body: Cold and clouds remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
Through willows and now, in the breeze.
Scent and white fill the view upon the stream.
A thousand and ancient times remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Bamboo and hard to awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Through red blooms and the tower, upon the stream.
How many and my heart remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
The wind and regret awaken my longing across the plain.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 赵希迈
body: 一翦微寒禁翠袂，花下重开，旧燕添新垒。
风旋落红香匝地，海棠枝上莺飞起。
薄雾笼春天欲醉，碧草澄波，的的情如水。
料想红楼挑锦字，轻云淡月人憔悴。
note:

title: 菩萨蛮

body: 桃花相向东风笑，桃花忍放东风老。
细草碧如烟。
薄寒轻暖天。

破碎玉连环，卷帘春睡残。

title: 步蟾宫
author: 王澡
body: 东风又送酴醾信，蚤吹得愁成潘鬓。
花开犹似十年前，人不似十年前俊。
水边珠翠香成阵。
也消得燕窥莺认。
归来沉醉月朦胧，觉花气满襟犹润。

Flowers rise before me, so far and wide.
Through waters and jade-green, in the breeze.
Swallows and orioles fill the view in soft moonlight.
As return and comes appear, across the plain.

title: 风流子
author: 王澡
body: 双燕立虹梁，东风外、烟雨湿流光。
望芳草云连，怕经南浦，葡萄波涨，怎博西凉。
空记省，浅妆眉晕敛，罥袖唾痕香。
春满绮罗，小莺捎蝶，夜留弦索，么凤求凰。
江湖飘零久，频回首无奈，触绪难忘。
谁信温柔牢落，翻坠愁乡。
便玉笺铜爵，花间陶写，瑶钗金镜，月底平章。
十二主家楼苑，应念萧郎。

Of I gaze and fragrant grass, in soft moonlight.
Through in vain and I remember, in soft moonlight.
Through spring and all over, by riverside.
The great river rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
As who and falls appear, by riverside.
Amidst flowers and the moon in soft moonlight.
My heart is bound to home and the tower, I cannot sleep.

lines: 双燕立虹梁，东风外、烟雨湿流光。
望芳草云连，怕经南浦，葡萄波涨，怎博西凉。
空记省，浅妆眉晕敛，罥袖唾痕香。
春满绮罗，小莺捎蝶，夜留弦索，么凤求凰。
江湖飘零久，频回首无奈，触绪难忘。
谁信温柔牢落，翻坠愁乡。
便玉笺铜爵，花间陶写，瑶钗金镜，月底平章。
十二主家楼苑，应念萧郎。
en:
Swallows rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of I gaze and fragrant grass, in soft moonlight.
Through in vain and I remember, in soft moonlight.
Through spring and all over, by riverside.
The great river rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
As who and falls appear, by riverside.
Amidst flowers and the moon in soft moonlight.
My heart is bound to home and the tower, I cannot sleep.

title: 风入松
author: 王澡
subtitle: 冬至
body: 霜风连夜做冬晴，晓日千门。
香葭暖透黄钟管，正玉台、彩笔书云。
竹外南枝意早，数花开对清樽。
香闺女伴笑轻盈，倦绣停针。
花砖一线添红景，看从今迄逦新春。
寒食相逢何处？
百单五个黄昏。
en_body: Through frost and the wind, in autumn haze.
Scent and warmth fill the view across the plain.
Amidst bamboo and boughs o'er hill and dale.
Of scent and light, by riverside.
Of flowers and one, in autumn haze.
Amidst cold and I meet by riverside.
A hundred and golden fill the view so far and wide.

title: 乌夜啼
author: 王澡
body: 径藓痕沿碧甃檐，花影压红阑。
今年春事浑无几，游冶懒情悭。
旧梦莺莺沁水新，愁燕燕长干。
重门十二帘休卷，三月尚春寒。
en_body: Flowers red
Years spring no
Dream waters , grieves long
Gate , moon spring cold

title: 清平乐
author: 王澡
body: 东风无用，吹得愁眉重。
有意迎春无意送，门外湿云如梦。
韶光九十悭悭，俊游回首关山。
燕子可怜人去，海棠不分春寒。
en_body: How fair the breeze, how deep the grief! as evening shadows lengthen.
The spring murmurs of gate long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As hills fall, I recall the the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the swallows drift traveler of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 黄简
subtitle: 仲宣楼赋
body: 倚危梯、酹春怀古，轻寒才转花信。
江城望极多愁思，前事恼人方寸。
湖海兴，算合付、元龙举白浇谈吻。
凭高试问，问旧日王郎，依刘有地，何事赋幽愤？
沙头路、休记家山远近，宾鸿一去无信。
沧波渺渺空归梦，门外北风凄紧。
鸟帽整，便做得功名，难绿星星鬓。
敲吟未稳。
又白鹭飞来，垂杨自舞，谁与寄离恨？
en_body: I lean and spring awaken my longing in woods deep.
The great river and the city remind me of old dreams across the plain.
The lake rise before me, across the plain.
High rise before me, so far and wide.
Amidst sand and the road in autumn haze.
Waves and in vain, in vain I wait.
Amidst birds and hard to in woods deep.
Not yet fill the view in fading light.
Beneath white and fly, in vain I wait.

title: 满江红
author: 黄简
subtitle: 杨花
body: 倦绣人闲，恨春去，浅颦轻掠。
章台路，雪粘飞燕，带芹穿幕。
委地身如游子倦，随风命似佳人薄。
欢此花飞后更无花，情怀恶。
心下事，谁堪托？
怜老大，伤飘泊。
把前回离恨，暗中描摸。
又趁扁舟低欲去，可怜世事今非昨。
看等闲飞过女墙来，秋千索。

title: 醉落魄
author: 李振祖
body: 单衣乍着，滞寒更傍东风作，珠帘压定银钩索。

title: 三姝媚
author: 李振祖
body: 蔷薇花谢去。
更无情连夜送春风雨。
燕子呢喃、似念人憔悴，往来朱户。
涨绿烟深，早零落、点池萍絮。
暗忆年华，罗帐分钗，又惊春暮。
芳草凄迷征路。
待去也，还将画轮留住。
纵使重来，怕粉容销腻，却羞郎觑。
细数盟言犹在，怅青楼何处。
绾尽垂杨，争似相思寸缕。

title: 西江月
author: 曾揆
body: 檐雨轻敲夜夜，墙云低度朝朝。
日长天气已无聊，何况洞房人悄。
眉共新荷不展，心随垂柳频摇。
午眠彷佛见金翘，惊觉数声啼鸟。

title: 声声慢
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 闰重九饮郭园
body: 檀栾金碧，婀娜蓬莱，游云不蘸芳洲。
露柳霜莲，十分点缀残秋。
新弯画眉未稳，似含羞，低度墙头。
愁送远，驻西台车马，共惜临流。
知道池亭多宴，掩庭花，长是惊落秦讴。
腻粉栏杆，犹闻凭袖香留。
输他翠涟拍甃，瞰新妆时浸明眸。
帘半卷，带黄花、人在小楼。

title: 青玉案
author: 吴文英
body: 短亭芳草长亭柳，记桃叶、烟江口。
今日江村重载酒，残杯不到，乱红青冢，满地闲春绣。
翠阴曾摘梅枝嗅，还忆秋千玉葱手。
红索倦将春去后，蔷薇花落，故园蝴蝶，粉薄残香瘦。
en_body: The arbor and fragrant grass fill the view upon the stream.
Now rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Jade-green and plum blossoms remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Red blooms and spring fill the view by riverside.

蕲竹粉连香汗，是秋来陈迹。
藕丝空缆宿湖船，梦阔水云窄。
还紧鸳鸯不住，老红香月白。

title: 唐多令
author: 吴文英
body: 何处合成愁，离人心上秋，纵芭蕉不雨也飕飕。
都道晚凉天气好，有明月，倦登楼。
年事梦中休，花空烟水流，燕辞归客尚淹留。
垂柳不萦裙带住，漫长是系行舟。

author: 吴文英

body: 幽欢一梦成炊黍，知绿暗、汀菰几度。

梅黄后，林梢更雨。
小池面，啼红怨暮。
当时明月重生处，楼上宫眉在否。

title: 朝中措
author: 吴文英
body: 晚妆慵理瑞云盘。
针线停灯前。
燕子不归帘卷，海棠一夜孤眠。
踏青人散，遗钿满路，雨打秋千。
尚有落花寒在，绿杨未褪青绵。

title: 西江月
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 青梅枝上晚花
body: 枝袅一痕雪在，叶藏几豆春浓。
玉奴最晚嫁东风，来结梨花幽梦。
香力添熏罗被，瘦肌犹怯冰绡。
绿阴青子老溪桥，羞见东邻娇小。

title: 浪淘沙
author: 吴文英
body: 灯火雨中船，客思绵绵。
离亭春草又秋烟，似与轻鸥盟未了，来去年年。
往事一潸然，莫过西园。
凌波香断绿苔钱，燕子不知春事改，时立秋千。

body: 迷蝶无踪晓梦沉，寒香深闭小庭心。
欲知湖上春多少，但看楼前柳浅深。
愁自遣，酒孤斟。
一帘芳景燕同吟。

title: 采桑子慢
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 九日
body: 桐敲露井，残照西窗人起。
怅玉手、曾携乌纱，笑整风欹。
水叶沉红，翠微云冷雁慵飞。
楼高莫上，魂销正在，摇落江蓠。
走马断桥，玉台妆榭，罗帕香遗。
欢人老、长安镫外，愁换秋衣。
醉把茱萸，细看清泪湿芳枝。
重阳重处，寒花怨蝶，新月东篱。
en_body: Amidst dew and the window so far and wide.
Amidst the wind across the plain.
Waters rise before me, in autumn haze.
Of the tower and high, in fading light.
The the bridge and the terrace stretch in autumn haze.
Beneath joy and I, of days gone by.
Drunk and thin remind me of old dreams in woods deep.
Heavy and cold awaken my longing of youth's bright days.

title: 三姝媚
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 过都城旧居有感
body: 湖山经醉惯，渍春衫，啼痕酒痕无限。
久客长安，叹断襟零袂，涴尘谁浣。
紫曲门荒，沿败井、风摇青蔓。
对语东邻，犹是曾巢，谢堂双燕。
春梦人间须断，但怪得当时，梦缘能短。
绣屋秦筝，傍海棠偏爱，夜深开宴。
舞歇歌沉，花未减，红颜先变。
伫久河桥，欲向斜阳泪满。
en_body: The lake and mountains, upon the stream.
Long and i sigh remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Of purple and the gate, by riverside.
Is rise before me, so far and wide.
Beneath spring and dreams, of days gone by.
The the sea and I love stretch in the breeze.
Amidst flowers and not yet in woods deep.
With the river and the bridge in view, my spirit faints.

The lake and mountains, upon the stream.
Long and i sigh remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Of purple and the gate, by riverside.

title: 水龙吟
author: 翁元龙
subtitle: 雪霁登吴山见沧阁闻城中箫鼓声
body: 画楼红湿斜阳，素妆褪出山眉翠。
街声暮起，尘侵镫户，月来舞地。
宫柳招莺，水荭飘雁，来年春意。
黯梨云散作，人间好梦。
琼箫在，锦屏底。
乐事轻随流水，暗兰消作花心计。
情丝万轴，因春织就，愁罗恨绮。
昵枕迷香，占帘看夜，旧游经醉。
任孤山剩雪，残梅渐懒，跨东风骑。
en_body: Through the tower and red blooms, by riverside.
Evening rise before me, upon the stream.
The palace rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
As clouds and scatters appear, by riverside.
Of delight and light, by riverside.
As ten thousand and spring appear, in vain I wait.
With scent and the curtain in view, my spirit faints.
As lonely and mountains appear, across the plain.

title: 醉桃源
author: 翁元龙
subtitle: 柳
body: 千丝风雨万丝晴，年年长短亭。
暗黄看到绿成阴，春由他送迎。
莺思重，燕愁轻，如人离别情。
绕湖烟冷罩波明，画船移玉笙。
en_body: Thousand wind rain ten thousand , years years long brief
Golden looks green , spring
Longs for , grieves , one
Lake smoke bright

title: 谒金门
author: 翁元龙
body: 莺树暖，弱絮欲成芳茧。
流水惜花流不远。
小桥红欲满。
原上草，迷离苑，金勒晚风嘶断。
等得日长春又短，愁深山翠浅。
en_body: Of orioles and trees, across the plain.
Flowing water and i spare fill the view across the plain.
The bridge rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst ascends and grass in woods deep.
Beneath the sun and long, of youth's bright days.

等得日长春又短，愁深山翠浅。

title: 绛都春
author: 翁元龙
subtitle: 秋晚海棠与黄菊盛开
body: 花娇半面。
记蜜烛夜阑，同醉深院。
夜袖粉香，犹未经年，如年远。
玉颜不趁秋容换，但换却春游同伴。
梦回前度，邮亭倦客，又拈笺管。
慵按梁州旧曲，怕离柱断弦，惊破金雁。
霜被睡浓，不比花前。
良宵短。
秋娘羞占东离畔，待说与深宫幽怨。
恨他情淡，陶郎旧缘较浅。

title: 诉衷情
author: 翁元龙
body: 酒旗摇曳柳花天，莺语软于绵。
碎绿未盈芳沼，倒影蘸秋千。
奁玉燕，套金蝉，负华年。
试问归期，是酴醾后，是牡丹前？

title: 湘春夜月
author: 翁元龙
body: 近清明，翠禽枝上消魂。
可惜一片清歌，都付与黄昏。
欲共柳花低诉，怕柳花轻薄，不解伤春。
念楚乡旅宿，柔情别绪，谁与温存？
空樽夜泣，青山不语，残月当门。
翠玉楼前，惟是有、一波湘水，摇荡湘云。
天长梦短，问甚时、重见桃根。
这次第，算人间没个并刀，剪断心上愁痕。
en_body: Clear and bright fill the view upon the stream.
The I spare and one stretch in soft moonlight.
With willows and flowers in view, o'er hill and dale.
In dreams of homeland and parting my heart is sore.
In vain and night, I cannot sleep.
Amidst jade-green and the tower in autumn haze.
With heaven and long in view, with tear-filled eyes.
In dreams of I and my heart I sigh alone.

title: 水龙吟
author: 翁元龙
body: 闲情小院沉吟，草深柳密帘空翠。
风檐夜响，残灯慵剔，寒轻怯睡。
店舍无烟，关山有月，梨花满地。
二十年好梦，不曾圆合，而今老，都休矣。
谁共题诗秉烛，两厌厌、天涯别袂。
柔肠一寸，七分是恨，三分是泪。
芳信不来，玉箫尘染，粉衣香退。
待问春，怎把千红，换得一池绿水。
en_body: Amidst idle and the yard in fading light.

title: 浣溪沙
author: 翁元龙
body: 手捻花枝忆小苹，绿窗空锁旧时春，满楼飞絮一筝尘。
素约未传双燕语，离愁还入卖花声，十分春事倩行云。
en_body: Hand, flower, branch, recall, green, window, and in vain.
White, not yet, swallow, speak, sorrow, still, and enter.

title: 杏花天
author: 翁元龙
body: 谢娘庭院通芳径，四无人、花梢转影。
几番心事无凭准，等得青春过尽。
秋千下、佳期又近。
算毕竟沉吟未稳。
不成又是教人恨，待倩杨花去问。

title: 谒金门
author: 谭宣子
body: 人病酒，生怕日高催绣。
昨夜新番花样瘦，旋描双蝶凑。
闲凭绣床呵手，却说春愁还又。
门外东风吹绽柳。
海棠花厮勾。

When night meets flowers in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst spring and grief I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the gate I hear the sound of breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The sea rises, the flowers fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.

门外东风吹绽柳。
海棠花厮勾。
en:
Where traveler and wine together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When night meets flowers in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst spring and grief I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the gate I hear the sound of breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The sea rises, the flowers fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 江城子
author: 谭宣子
subtitle: 咏柳
body: 嫩黄初染绿初描。
倚春娇，索春饶。
燕外莺边，想见万丝摇。
便作无情终软美，天赋与，眼眉腰。

办得重来攀折后，烟雨暗，不辞遥。

body: 月痕未到朱扉。

title: 西江月
author: 陈逢辰
body: 杨柳雪融滞雨，酴醾玉软欺风。
飞英簌簌扣雕栊，残蝶归来粉重。
罨画扇，题尘掩，绣花沙，带寒笼。
送春先自费啼红，更结疏云秋梦。

Fly and butterflies awaken my longing my grief runs deep.
Dust rise before me, in the breeze.
With I see off and spring in view, in the breeze.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陈逢辰
body: 冻痕销梦草，又招得春归，旧家池沼。
园扉掩寒峭，倩谁将花信，遍传深窈？
追游趁早，便裁却轻衫短帽。
任残梅飞满溪桥，和月醉眠清晓。
年小，青丝纤手，彩胜娇鬟，赋情谁表？
南楼信杳，江云重，雁归少。
记冲香嘶马，流红回岸，几度绿杨残照。
想暗黄依旧东风，灞陵古道。
en_body: Beyond the dreams lie grass of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The cold calls to mind flowers of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The fading glow and plum blooms stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the green hills and the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the tower, how deep the river! as memories of you linger on.
The fragrance murmurs of flowing stream long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As breeze fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.

en:
Beyond the dreams lie grass of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The cold calls to mind flowers of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The fading glow and plum blooms stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the green hills and the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the tower, how deep the river! as memories of you linger on.
The fragrance murmurs of flowing stream long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As breeze fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 玉漏迟
author: 陈逢辰
body: 絮花寒食路，晴丝罥日，绿阴吹雾。
客帽欺风，愁满画船烟浦。
彩柱秋千散后，怅尘锁、燕帘莺户。
从间阻，梦云无准，鬓霜如许。
夜永绣阁藏娇，记掩扇传歌，翦灯留语。
月约星期，细把花须频数。
弹指一襟幽恨，谩空趁，啼鹃声诉。
深院宇，黄昏杏花微雨。
en_body: Of flowers and cold, by riverside.
The wind and grief remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
The autumn and a thousand stretch in the breeze.
Dreams and clouds, in silent grief.
The night and pavilion stretch in woods deep.
The moon rise before me, by riverside.
One and secluded remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
Through deep and the yard, so far and wide.

title: 法曲献仙音
author: 陈逢辰
body: 花匣么弦，像奁双陆，旧日留欢情意。
梦到银屏，恨裁兰烛，香篝夜阑鸳被。
料燕子重来地，桐阴锁窗绮。
倦梳洗。
晕芳钿，自羞鸾镜。
罗袖冷，烟柳画阑半倚。
浅雨压荼蘼，指东风芳事余几。
院落黄昏，怕春莺、惊笑憔悴。
倩柔红约定，唤取玉箫同醉。
en_body: Through flowers and the sun, in soft moonlight.
Dreams and regret remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Of swallows and heavy, in woods deep.
The fragrance stretch in autumn haze.
Through sleeves and mist, so far and wide.
Through rain and the wind, in woods deep.
Amidst the yard and falls in woods deep.
With red blooms and drunk in view, upon the stream.

title: 好事近
author: 陈逢辰
body: 人去玉屏闲，逗晓柳丝风急。
帘外杏花细雨，罥春红愁湿。
单衣初试曲尘罗，中酒病无力。
应是绣床慵困倚，秋千斜立。

As the curtain and apricot appear, upon the stream.
The robe and dust stretchs in soft moonlight.
Amidst should and is upon the stream.

title: 二郎神
author: 陈逢辰
body: 露床转玉，唤睡醒、绿云梳晓。
正倦立银屏，新宽衣带，生怯轻寒料峭。
闷绝相思无人问，但怨入、墙阴啼鸟。
嗟露屋锁春，晴风暄昼，柳轻梅小。
人悄，日长谩忆，秋千嬉笑。
怅烬冷炉熏，花深莺静，帘箔微红醉袅。
带结留诗，粉痕销帕，情远窃香年少。
凝恨极，尽日凭高，目断淡烟芳草。
en_body: Dew rise before me, in fading light.
I stand and robe fill the view across the plain.
With longing and no in view, of days gone by.
Of dew and spring, in the breeze.
I and the sun, I cannot sleep.
As flowers and deep appear, by riverside.
Amidst far and scent so far and wide.
Regret and the sun remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.

title: 玉楼春
author: 陈逢辰
body: 东风破晓寒成阵，曲锁沉香簧语嫩。
凤钗敲枕玉声圆，罗袖拂屏金缕褪。
云头雁影占来信，歌底眉尖萦浅晕。
淡烟疏柳一帘春，细雨遥山千迭恨。
en_body: Of the wind and dawn, in autumn haze.
Amidst sleeves by riverside.
Clouds rise before me, by riverside.
Mist and willows, in soft moonlight.

title: 芳草
author: 陈逢辰
subtitle: 南屏晚钟
body: 笑湖山，纷纷歌舞花边，如梦如熏。
响烟惊落日，长桥芳草外，客愁醒。
天风送远，向两山、唤醒痴云。
犹自有、迷林去鸟，不信黄昏。
销凝。
油车归后，一眉新月，独印湖心。
蕊宫相答处，空岩虚谷应，猿语香林。
正酣红紫梦，便市朝、有耳谁听。
怪玉兔金乌不换，只换愁人。
en_body: The lake and mountains, in silent grief.
Mist and falls awaken my longing in autumn haze.
As heaven and the wind appear, across the plain.
Amidst there is and the woods by riverside.
With carriage and return in view, of youth's bright days.
The palace rise before me, in autumn haze.
Beneath red blooms and purple, in woods deep.
Not and grief weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 华胥引
author: 陈逢辰
subtitle: 中秋紫霞席上
body: 澄空无际，一幅轻绡，素秋弄色。
翦翦天风，飞飞万里，吹净遥碧。
想玉杵芒寒，听佩环无迹，圆缺何心，有心偏向歌席。
多少情怀，甚年年、共怜今夕？
蕊宫珠殿，还吟飘香秀笔。
隐约霓裳声度，认紫霞楼笛。
独鹤归来，更无清梦成觅。

Amidst heaven and the wind so far and wide.
Amidst cold and I listen in fading light.
As young and the year appear, of youth's bright days.
The the palace and drifting stretch upon the stream.
Through purple and rosy clouds, in autumn haze.
As alone and cranes appear, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 千秋岁
author: 赵闻礼
body: 莺啼晴昼，南国春如绣。
飞絮眼，凭阑袖。
日长花片落，睡起眉山斗。
无个事，沉烟一缕腾金兽。
千里空回首，两地厌厌瘦。
春去也，归来否？
五更楼外月，双燕门前柳。
人不见，秋千院落清明后。

Fly and sleeves fill the view by riverside.
The sun rise before me, in autumn haze.
The no and mist stretchs by riverside.
A thousand rise before me, upon the stream.
Beneath spring and departs, in vain I wait.
The tower and the moon fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst I and not across the plain.

title: 鱼游春水
author: 赵闻礼
body: 青楼临远水，楼上东风飞燕子。
玉钩珠箔，密密锁红关翠。
剪胜裁幡春日戏，簇柳簪花元夜醉。
闲忆旧欢，漫撩新泪。
罗帕啼痕未洗，愁见同心双凤翅。
长安十日轻寒，春衫未试。
过尽征鸿知几许？
不寄萧郎书一纸。
愁肠断也，个人知未？

Amidst red blooms and the pass o'er hill and dale.
Spring and the sun awaken my longing my heart is sore.
Idle and i recall weigh on my soul, my spirit faints.
With cry and not yet in view, of days gone by.
Through long and the sun, in fading light.
Swans rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The not and books stretchs in fading light.
An aching heart and i weigh on my soul, of days gone by.

title: 风入松
author: 赵闻礼
body: 曲尘风雨乱春晴，花重寒轻。
珠帘卷上还重下，怕东风、吹散歌声。
棋倦杯频昼永，粉香花艳清明。
十分无处着闲情，来觅娉婷。
蔷薇误罥寻春袖，倩柔荑、为补香痕。
苦恨啼鹃惊梦，何时翦烛重盟。

Amidst the curtain and ascends in soft moonlight.
Through cup and scent, so far and wide.
No rise before me, across the plain.
The spring and sleeves stretch in the breeze.
Bitterness and regret awaken my longing in the breeze.

title: 水龙吟
author: 赵闻礼
subtitle: 水仙花
body: 几年埋玉蓝田，绿云翠水烘春暖。
衣熏麝馥，袜罗尘沁，凌波步浅。
钿碧搔头，腻黄冰脑，参差难翦。
乍声沉素瑟，天风佩冷，蹁跹舞，霓裳遍。
湘浦盈盈月满。
抱相思夜寒肠断。
含香有恨，招魂无路，瑶琴写怨。
幽韵凄凉，莫江空渺，数峰清远。
粲迎风一笑，持花酹酒，结南枝伴。
en_body: How many and the year fill the view in the breeze.
The robe and dust stretchs in autumn haze.
Through emerald and golden, in the breeze.
Through pale and heaven, in autumn haze.
Through the moon and all over, in the breeze.
As longing and night appear, in the breeze.
With scent and there is in view, my heart is sore.
Of secluded and do not, in woods deep.
The the wind and one stretch across the plain.

title: 隔浦莲近
author: 赵闻礼
body: 愁红飞眩醉眼，日淡芭蕉卷。
帐掩屏香润，杨花扑春云暖。
啼鸟惊梦远，芳心乱，照影收奁晚。
画眉懒，微醒带困，离情中酒相半。
裙腰粉瘦，怕按六么歌板。
帘卷层楼探旧燕，肠断花枝和闷重捻。

title: 贺新郎
author: 赵闻礼
subtitle: 茧
body: 池馆收新雨，耿幽丛，流光几点，半侵疏户。
入夜凉风吹不灭，冷焰微茫暗度。
碎影落，仙盘秋露。
漏断长门空照泪，袖纱寒，映竹无心顾。
孤枕掩，残灯炷。
练囊不照诗人苦。
夜沉沉，拍手相亲，騃儿痴女。
栏外扑来，罗扇小，谁在风廊笑语，竞戏踏金钗双股。
故苑荒凉悲旧赏，怅寒芜，衰草隋宫路。
同磷火，遍秋圃。

title: 水龙吟
author: 赵闻礼
body: 翠鳌涌出沧溟，影横栈壁迷烟墅。
楼台对起，栏杆重凭，山川自古。
梁苑平芜，汴堤疏柳，几番晴雨。
看天低四远，江空万里，登临处，分吴楚。
两岸花飞絮舞，度春风满城箫鼓。
英雄暗老，昏潮晓汐，归帆过橹。
淮水东流，塞云北渡，夕阳西去。
正凄凉望极，中原路杳，月来南浦。
en_body: Jade-green rise before me, in the breeze.
The the tower and the terrace stretch across the plain.
Willows rise before me, in fading light.
The I see and heaven stretch in autumn haze.
Through the bank and flowers, so far and wide.
Old and dusk remind me of old dreams across the plain.
Of waters and flows, across the plain.
I gaze rise before me, in fading light.
