title: 行经拂水山庄
author: 周准
body: 扁舟泛泛越南沙，倚杖愁临涧路斜。
孝穆荒斋犹竹石，总持故宅尚莺花。
名高那许遗缨，情重难孝弃室家。
太息百年同逝水，凄凉还为惜才华。

Bamboo and stones fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst high and that in the breeze.
The a hundred and the year stretch in the breeze.

title: 晨自松陵归渡太湖即事
author: 周准

隐隐榜歌来雁汊。
凄凄渔笛出云汀。
还怜心切乡闾近，未暇携筇访洞庭。

title: 题秦馀女史所画楚辞图
author: 周准
body: 绕堂烟浪洞庭深，芳杜幽兰遍水浔。

云中桂棹声疑咽，天际瑶台影乍沉。
写尽《离骚》无限意，《竹枝》歌罢又猿吟。

title: 履霜操（自注：泸有抚琴渡，相传尹伯奇弹《履霜操》处，遂拟是作。）
author: 盛锦
body: 霜皑皑兮泸之浒，儿弗履兮，畏我父母叶。
儿身载寒兮，儿心载苦。
儿心兮父心，儿身兮母身。
寒兮苦兮，实伤我亲。
儿罪兮莫逭，亲心兮可转。
俟日出而回光兮，履霜亦暧。

title: 十二碚
author: 盛锦
body: 群峰束奔流，虎牙怒相向。
对峙十二碚，罗列钟鼓状。
颠崖矗层霄，旁窦穿激浪。
峡泉落九夭，汹汹翻海藏。
撑舟出井底，篙师气先丧。
众工捷如猱，百丈缘壁上。
木末纵飞腾，山凹迭升降。
一鼓更作气，千篙力谁让。
造化何神奇，设此待霸王。
颇闻白帝子，于此拒汉将。
铁锁贯浮梁，金戈森卫仗。
萧铣复何人，屯兵倚叠嶂。
群雄电扫空，故垒犹在望。
平生历险艰，未若兹游壮。
万里投蛮荒，一身堕烟瘴，风餐案倾欹，水宿魂震荡。
搜奇命转轻，得句神益旺。
讵畏前途修，瞿塘险如象。
杜诗所谓“百丈牵江上濑船”，“打鼓发船何处郎”也，经其地者，能亲切言之。

title: 空ぎ峡
author: 盛锦
body: 出峡复入峡，两崖插青冥。
中流逐狂飚，奔腾万马声。
下滩梭一掷，触石危樯倾。
逆挽劳百夫，十步九倒行。
力尽听所止，刺篙就回汀。
爱此民居壮，凌空驾轩楹。
宿云出洞户，古木撑岩屏。
惊猿或挂树，怪鸟时一鸣。
扪萝上绝壁，山风动冠缨。
呼童拾锦石，信手扳杂英。
兴幽忘涉险，角目多怡情。
前途苦逼仄，绝境难久停。
过午岩日晦，磊落见数星。
黑畏突虎，蛮语频丁宁。
移舟近湍激，拍枕声铿钅訇。
骨肉缘久断，中肖梦亦清。
狂吟出险句，那顾邻舟惊。
骨肉缘断，而梦亦不接，是远游人呕心语。

出峡复入峡，两崖插青冥。
中流逐狂飚，奔腾万马声。
下滩梭一掷，触石危樯倾。
逆挽劳百夫，十步九倒行。
力尽听所止，刺篙就回汀。
爱此民居壮，凌空驾轩楹。
宿云出洞户，古木撑岩屏。
惊猿或挂树，怪鸟时一鸣。
扪萝上绝壁，山风动冠缨。
呼童拾锦石，信手扳杂英。
兴幽忘涉险，角目多怡情。
前途苦逼仄，绝境难久停。
过午岩日晦，磊落见数星。
黑畏突虎，蛮语频丁宁。
移舟近湍激，拍枕声铿钅訇。
骨肉缘久断，中肖梦亦清。
狂吟出险句，那顾邻舟惊。
骨肉缘断，而梦亦不接，是远游人呕心语。

title: 过滩
author: 盛锦
body: 重峡间百滩，一滩度一厄。
江涡众壑趋，口乱石积。
大石叠鼋鼍，小石攒剑戟。
中流若沸川，翻倒蛟龙窟。
牵舟逼下流，凛若阻兵革。
长篙拄峰腰，远缆走山脊。
鸣金策众工，锐进不盈尺。
一丝中迸断，百里供一掷。
触石无完艘，沈渊有惊魄。
是时雨初霁，沙石多滑泽。
亡命争上，匍匐落冠舄。
妇孺互扶携，鸡犬任狼藉。
暂脱鱼腹灾，波涛亦衽席。
转思断鳌初，四极奠磐石。
岂其禹力衰，此境终未辟。
吾尤罪巨灵，何惜只手擘。
天宰真梦梦，人事日逼窄。
波静有潜鳞，林深多敛翮。
寄语营利徒，勿作远行客。

title: 峡夜
author: 盛锦
body: 敫々猿啼夜，凄凄鹤唳空。
断开四壁，深井落孤篷。
树漏暂明月，湍惊无定风。
万重云水隔，归梦亦途穷。

title: 登白帝城
author: 盛锦
body: 万仞墙临滟堆，子阳霸业划江开。

汉家陵阙同灰灭，泪尽寒猿日夕哀。
“深井落孤篷”，从高处入峡也，“巫峡帆从地底来”，从峡升高处也。

“深井落孤篷”，从高处入峡也，“巫峡帆从地底来”，从峡升高处也。

title: 白帝诚谒昭烈武侯庙
author: 盛锦
body: 永安宫殿峡江头，一体君臣祀武侯。
天祖式临传诏夜，风云色变出师秋。
鸣銮久绝空山道，筹笔犹悬古驿楼。
瞻尚死忠谌死孝，千秋配食重诒谋。
瞻、尚死忠，愧死谯周，谌死孝，愧死后主。
此种诗那得不传。

title: 蜀道写怀
author: 盛锦
body: 辞家动作经年别，动国真成万里游。
泪眼已枯猿啸夜，乡书空望雁来秋。
蚕丛路险连云栈，鹿角滩惊上峡舟。
心折江陵灌园叟，黄柑千树比封侯。
en_body: Home and the year, in autumn haze.
Beneath tears and already, I cannot sleep.
Through the road and clouds, so far and wide.
My heart and the great river fill the view across the plain.

title: 舟抵泸州
author: 盛锦
body: 锦江直下古城壕，地入炎荒近不毛。
万里亲朋劳梦寐，十旬餐宿托风涛。
征蛮罗甸军声远，《谕蜀》文园典策高。
扫尽瘴烟开郡阁，岷峨天半落挥毫。
en_body: Amidst the great river and descends across the plain.
Ten thousand and dreams, in vain I wait.
The far and high stretchs in the breeze.
Mist rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 任城使院晤翁霁堂有赠
author: 盛锦
body: 并马长安忆旧游，逢君意气振高秋。
酒徒半散荆卿市，词垒孤悬李白楼。
握手星辰摇短剑，离心风雨送扁舟。
明年醉我南池上，须典千金紫绮裘。
en_body: Long and i recall awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
I think of wine and half, in silent grief.
Stars and sword, my grief runs deep.
Bright and the year, my grief runs deep.

title: 白莲
author: 盛锦
body: 玉井分栽到野塘，冰绡翠袖迥生凉。

真相尚留开土社，红衣尽洗美人妆。
《水仙操》罢扁舟去，谁与凌波解。

相逢秋雪里，老我不胜愁。

title: 哭少宗伯春晖姊丈
author: 盛锦
body: 老去身家不两存，俄看霜后萎芳荪。
燕巢华屋垂新泪，马鬣空山感旧恩。
岂意十年重一面，却来千里与招魂，茑萝虽附潘杨未，未敢同声哭寝门。
谁知小别意千年，梦幻韵华逐逝川。
我尚拖泥兼带水，君非成佛定生天。
从前似历华严劫，向后休参文字禅。
昨自黄公垆下过，一声邻笛欲潸然。
en_body: Old rise before me, by riverside.
Beneath swallows and tears, of youth's bright days.
The year rise before me, in autumn haze.
Beneath who and I know, in silent grief.
I and waters fill the view in the breeze.
As rise before me, so far and wide.
Of golden and descends, in autumn haze.

title: 春日归泊阊门
author: 楼
body: 年年踪迹感漂蓬，冷落柴门烟雨中。

en_body: O'er falling blooms and gate I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the swallows lie return of home, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 上陈见复先生
author: 王大椿
body: 读书不求名位高，饮酒不尽千钟醪。
得心每在淡与泊，此中至乐诚陶陶。
先生闭户穴《坟》《典》，卅年门径丛蓬蒿。
三公令仆断梦寐，淡如云影径鸿毛。
忽传不诏贲郡邑，水南水北纷喧嚣。
公卿合辞拜手荐，汉廷经术千秋遭。
申辕年已惫筋力，蒲轮难涉风尘劳。
上陈著述达黼座，至尊下遣官胥钞。
周情孔思审中正，辨别白黑穷厘毫。
少司成职重太学，帝命取式风之浇。
先生受官不受禄，几席讲学仍衡茅。
走也仰钻希万一，有似蚁垤窥潐。
韩门近在许偻入，欲抉精髓弃粕糟。
寸莛巨杵叩俱应，试听钅黄钅黄天半鸣蒲牢。

周情孔思审中正，辨别白黑穷厘毫。
少司成职重太学，帝命取式风之浇。
先生受官不受禄，几席讲学仍衡茅。
走也仰钻希万一，有似蚁垤窥潐。
韩门近在许偻入，欲抉精髓弃粕糟。
寸莛巨杵叩俱应，试听钅黄钅黄天半鸣蒲牢。

title: 上巳忆白下
author: 李艹勉
body: 清明恰是握兰辰，遥卜秦淮景物新。
杨柳晚风深巷酒，桃花春水隔帘人。
桥边车过香生路，楼外船归月满津。
憔悴不堪来旧馆，相逢谁为浣沙尘。
en_body: As clear fall, I recall the bright, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the willow drift breeze of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the fragrance I think of road, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past sand and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

author: 潘廷熏
body: 羊肠岭畔幽栖处，一水当门泻作渠。
薇蕨西山心自印，藻南涧奠还虚。
相忘桑海逃名后，不接贤豪俟命馀。
）此日行人罕凭吊，烟云惟护逸民庐。
俟斋祠废，文虎父子重葺之，雅奏没，祠恐复废，读其诗，有望于潘氏之兴也。
en_body: In the streams I hear the sound of gate, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The hills rises, the heart fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er sea and the breeze I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the sun lie hills of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The sun calls to mind traveler of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.
The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, as memories of you linger on.

料得鱼轩回首处，沙场犹有未归人。
极愁惨中，不失和平气象，是为正声。

title: 死别离
author: 方维仪
body: 昔闻生别离，不闻死别离。
无论生与死，我独身当之。
北风吹枯桑，日夜为我悲。
上视沧浪天，下无黄口儿。
人生不如死，父母泣相持。
黄鸟各东西，秋草亦参差。
予生何所为，予死何所为？
白日有如此，我心当自知。
en_body: As of old and I hear appear, in vain I wait.
My heart is bound to no and I, my spirit faints.
The wind and the sun awaken my longing in the breeze.
Ascends and billows fill the view by riverside.
In dreams of I and not I cannot sleep.
Amidst golden and birds in woods deep.
What rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst white and the sun across the plain.

title: 哭伯兄
author: 钱凤纶
body: 在昔皇天倾，覆卵无完理。
兄不即殉身，感奋良有以。
摩挲双匕首，一夕再三起。
千钧重一发，恐复忧天只。
荏苒岁月间，隐痛入骨髓。
未揕仇人胸，抱疾忽焉死。
尸床目不瞑，不继非人子。
尚有娥亲在，李寿汝莫喜。
第未知异日报仇与否？

Amidst not yet and I know in fading light.

Of of old and heaven, in fading light.

title: 纪事
author: 毕著
body: 吾父矢报国，战死于蓟丘。
父马为贼乘，父尸为贼收。
父仇不能报，有愧秦女休。
乘贼不及防，夜进千貔貅。
杀贼血漉漉，手握仇人头。
贼众自相杀，尸横满坑沟。
父体舆榇归，薄葬荒山陬。
相期智勇士，慨焉赋同仇。
蛾贼一扫清。
国家固金瓯。

title: 晓思
author: 章有湘
body: 窗外鸡初唱，花间露未干。
欲临明镜照，犹怯翠眉寒。
宿鸟翻林树，归鸿振羽翰。
不知乡国信，何日报平安？

Bird, woods, tree, return, and swan goose.
Not, know, homeland, kingdom, believe, what, and day.

title: 泊浦子口
author: 钱敬淑
body: 残年泊归棹，问酒郭西亭。
雪圃芹芽白，江醪竹叶青。
夕阳新别路，衰草古离情。
隔岸寒山色，含凄望旧京。
en_body: The fading glow calls to mind return of old, and in my heart I hold you still.
Through snow and pale mist I make my way, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The parting and road stretch far and wide, where river and sky merge as one.
All day I watch the shore and cold, and tears well up unbidden.

title: 送别
author: 吴琪
body: 雪意满芳洲，苍山引去舟。
霜风醒客梦，笳月起边愁。
万里从军急，孤身倚剑游。
家园落日里，莫上最高楼。
en_body: The snow and all over stretchs in fading light.
Frost and the wind remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
In dreams of ten thousand and lonely I sigh alone.
Home and falls fill the view by riverside.

title: 咏史
author: 吴氏
body: 六贵同朝激虎彪，横江勒马下秦州。
银枪酒市春双靥，玉さ莲台月半钩。
赵鬼《西京》谙汉赋，阿兄东阁压通侯。
谁知讲武旄头入，芳乐笳声碧麝秋。
乃大起芳乐等苑。
梅虫儿，齐主呼为阿兄。
）右南齐同泰一人归佛地，寿阳千骑渡江波。
盟成自取金瓯缺，蔬绝空陈鸡子多。
五月谁勤君父难，七官先反弟兄戈。
江淮废后襄阳促，秋草台城放橐驼。
“金瓯无缺”，武帝自矜语。
围台城时，蔬茹皆绝，邵陵王纶上鸡子百枚。
太清三年五月，武帝殂。
武陵王自称帝曰：七官文士岂能匡济。
湘东王绎行七故云。
）右南梁

title: 戊子避乱舟中寄弟

title: 与冢妇朱柔则
author: 柴静仪
body: 深闺白日静，熏香垂罗帱。
病起罢膏沐，淡若明河秋。
自汝入家门，操作苦不休。
藻既鲜洁，牖户还绸缪。
丈夫志四方，钱刀非所求。
惜哉时未遇，林下聊优游。
相对理琴瑟，逸响随风流。
潜龙慎勿用，牝鸡乃贻羞。
寄言闺中子，柔顺其无忧。

title: 子用济有远行诗以贻之
author: 柴静仪
body: 吾子廉吏孙，读书昧生理。
三十未成名，徒然还乡里。
外侮旋复来，内忧方未己。
忽然远行役，披衣中夜起。
明星光在天，河流正弥弥。
行云有返期，游子靡所止，揽涕下高堂，长途从此始。
野雀从南来，翩翩思择木。
感此主人贤，飞鸣集其屋。
才地非独优，处卑愿亦足。
矧有嘉树林，朝昏托栖宿。
鹰过莫窥，罗无由触。
哀彼《黄鸟》诗，长谣念邦族。

开篇点题，铺陈缘起。

吾子廉吏孙，读书昧生理。　三十未成名，徒然还乡里。　外侮旋复来，内忧方未己。
承

承接前文，铺叙展开。

忽然远行役，披衣中夜起。　明星光在天，河流正弥弥。　行云有返期，游子靡所止，揽涕下高堂，长途从此始。
转

笔锋转折，翻进一层。

野雀从南来，翩翩思择木。　感此主人贤，飞鸣集其屋。　才地非独优，处卑愿亦足。
合

收束全篇，点出题旨。

矧有嘉树林，朝昏托栖宿。　鹰过莫窥，罗无由触。　哀彼《黄鸟》诗，长谣念邦族。

title: 勖用济
author: 柴静仪
body: 君不见侯家夜夜朱筵开，残杯冷炙谁怜才。
长安三上不得意，蓬头黧面仍归来，呜呼世情日千变，驾车食肉人争羡。
读书弹琴聊自娱，古来哲士能贫贱。
能贫贱，他日即能富矣。
学者宜三复斯言。
en_body: You rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Long and ascends remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
Amidst I read and books by riverside.
The I stand and myself stretch by riverside.
Amidst he and the sun o'er hill and dale.

title: 长信宫
author: 柴静仪
body: 玉台妆罢无人见，伤心空自悲团扇。
秋草偏生长信宫，春风只在昭阳殿。
殿里君王酒半醺，娇歌雅舞争纷纷。
三千锦帐飘香麝，十二长裙散彩云。
众中别有人如玉，新妆艳艳娇红烛。
不许寒乌带月啼，恐惊春燕衔花宿。
谁怜长夜梦难成，忽度流莺似有情。
片月高高挂天汉，千秋应照妾心明。
en_body: Beneath the terrace and no, I sigh alone.
Autumn rise before me, in the breeze.
Amidst you and wine in the breeze.
Of a thousand and drifting, across the plain.
As parting and there is appear, of youth's bright days.
Not rise before me, in the breeze.
Who and i pity remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
Amidst the moon and high across the plain.

title: 秋分日忆子用济
author: 柴静仪
body: 遇节思吾子，吟诗对夕曛。
燕将明日去，秋向此时分。
逆旅空弹铗，生涯只卖文。
归帆宜早挂，莫待雪纷纷。
en_body: Longs for
Bright sun departs , autumn time
Empty
Returns sail , snow
baihua_lines: 遇节思我您，吟诗对夕曛。
燕将要明日去，秋向此时分。
逆旅空弹铗，生涯只卖文。
归帆宜早挂，不要待雪纷纷。

title: 送顾启姬北上
author: 柴静仪
body: 一片桃花水，盈盈送客舟。
春来万杨柳，叶叶是离愁。
顾我穷途者，逢君意气投。
烟虹时染翰，风月几登楼。
只合熏香坐，谁堪鼓游。
燕台一回首，云白古杭州。
en_body: One and peach awaken my longing so far and wide.
Spring and comes awaken my longing in woods deep.
I and i meet fill the view in the breeze.
Mist and the wind fill the view in fading light.
Through scent and I sit, in autumn haze.
The swallows and the terrace stretch in fading light.

title: 山阴道中三首
author: 王慧
body: 出郭忘远近，十里清阴中。
川陆互回没，延缘遂无穷。
冈峦去殊势，竹树交成丛。
安知蒙密处，下有溪流通。
石桥路可寻，一转迷西东。
烟空人不见，寂寂山花红。
行行转深迥，所得益幽奇。
万壑与千岩，今来始见之。
纷纷红复碧，相引呈异姿。
心目所应接，人各领其私。
烟缕出丛薄，山家住茅茨。
人贳杳然隔，何殊太古时。
溪流绕岩，一苇去不息。
沙濑清且浅，水底见竹色。
文石无岁年，山根浸历历。
谷鸟鸣转幽，溯洄安所极。
水花爱明净，绝境杳难即。
可有浣纱人，一笑似相识。

title: 冷泉亭
author: 王慧
body: 泉声檐槛外，林壑杳然深。
人世热何处，我来清到心。
松林藏日色，潭底卧峰阴。
一自乐天记，山光寒至今。

title: 移居茜里旧宅
author: 王慧
body: 新唐一水绕街东，旧是柴桑五亩宫。
松菊尚存思祖德，蓬蒿不剪见家风。
花深鸡犬疏篱外，潮落鱼虾小市中。
却爱常前双燕子，还寻故垒入帘栊。
en_body: Amidst one and waters in soft moonlight.
Pines and chrysanthemums remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
Flowers and deep fill the view in fading light.
Amidst I love and swallows in autumn haze.

lines: 水浅舟胶日半斜，扣舷闲望似天涯。
烟深竹坞鸠呼雨，潮落芦根蟹聚沙。
愁绪萦缠同蔓草，年华衰谢感残花。

en:
Waters rise before me, so far and wide.
Amidst mist and deep in autumn haze.
Grief and grass remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
I pity and the window fill the view o'er hill and dale.

title: 禹陵
author: 王慧
body: 明德弥苍昊，神功迈大庭。
怀襄方尽力，胼胝极劳形。
草木开蒙昧，龙蛇涤秽腥。
铸金九土贡，志怪八方经。
苍水先呈简，防风后至刑。
相传弓剑弃，此地隧泉扃。
三古遗祠庙，千秋共荐馨。
璧牲前代典，碑版列朝铭。
深殿从群后，空山走百灵。
旧闻云驻，今见翠华停。
心法传河洛，天章焕日星。
殊恩沾后裔，异数出明廷。
肃穆瞻新象，登临泊小ぎ。
戚垣辞镂琢，户牖炯丹青。
莫觅藏书穴，徒看窆石亭。
萝长鼯窜迹，松老鹤修翎。
众水环襟带，诸峰列嶂屏。
桥山同故事，寂寞对秋。

title: 舟泊垂虹桥重翻吴江闺秀诗有感
author: 徐昭华
body: 吴江之水春泱泱，水边曾蘸青螺香。
我寻黛影不得见，对此绿波空断肠。
残星点点障轻雾，左妹金闺在何处？
雉堞连墙有蔽亏，渔舟荡桨空来去。
茭花菰叶满江浮，画烛银缸彻夜游。
曲渚流霞漾金钱，碧天清露洒琼楼。
一时吟咏出花下，百尺天孙锦云纟圭。
相隔风光知几春，教人宛转怀长夜。
十幅蒲帆五两风，长桥犹跨旧城东。
美人不在桥边住，盼作春天一段红。

title: 五日吊古
author: 孙淑
body: 田文五日生，屈原五日亡。
吉凶同此日，理固难推详。
原与国休戚，一死分所当。
渔父自鼓，詹尹龟宜藏。
抱石投湘流，心与日月光。
文从狡兔计，高枕乐未央。
后合魏秦赵，伐齐何披猖！
身死薛随灭，高户仍不详。
文生鸡狗雄，原死荃蘅芳。
世人何梦梦，悲屈羡孟尝。
我心独不然，临风慨以慷。
抚时怀往事，聊进菖蒲觞。
en_body: Through the sun, in autumn haze.
The this and the sun stretchs in fading light.
The kingdom rise before me, so far and wide.
The stones and flows stretch in the breeze.
Through high and delight, in fading light.
Amidst what o'er hill and dale.
Through myself and high, across the plain.
Through fragrance, o'er hill and dale.
In dreams of I and what in silent grief.
Beneath I and my heart, by riverside.

title: 偶然作
author: 金氏
body: 灼灼庭前花，春风斗红紫。
随荣复随谢，盛衰偶然尔。
草木岂无情，谁能一生死。
我思更如何，欲种菩提子。
en_body: Through flowers and spring I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the grass and the breeze, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 乡思
author: 王炜
body: 不禁乡思倚危楼，山色空蒙海气浮。
风雨别来花半老，音书隔绝雁惊秋。
林间野鹤呼幽梦，天际浮云带远愁。
好寄相思与娄水，门前日日有潮头。
en_body: As not and homeland appear, I cannot sleep.
The wind and rain remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
The woods and cranes awaken my longing in woods deep.
Longing and waters remind me of old dreams in fading light.

title: 寄远曲
author: 朱柔则
body: 恨少垂杨柳，殷勤系玉鞍。
夕阳鸦背暖，春雪马蹄寒。
入世逢迎拙，依人去住难。
痴儿啼向我，昨夜梦长安。
猎猎风初劲，沉沉雨未阑。
因怜儿被薄，转忆客衣单。
栖燕将雏苦，征鸿失侣寒。
居家与行路，同是一艰难。
闻说燕台路，生涯亦可怜。
耻弹门下铗，谁乞广文钱。
久客非长策，归耕有薄田。
一棺痛慈母，急为卜牛眠。
末章望其葬亲急归，游子不容不归矣。
性情既挚，诗安得不工。

title: 杂咏
author: 张凌仙
body: 家住青山侧，青山断尘迹。
浮世几兴亡，依旧青山色。
明镜如满月，朝朝弄妆靓。
一自弃尘埃，不照孤鸾影。
夙昔爱鸣琴，流泉指下生。
子期今已没，谁听断肠声？
en_body: Through home and blue mountains, so far and wide.
Of how many and blue mountains, across the plain.
Amidst bright and like by riverside.
As one and dust appear, my heart is sore.
Of of old and I love, so far and wide.
Now and already fill the view so far and wide.

title: 初夏送夫子北上
author: 顾英
body: 杜鹃唤春归，和风吹芳芷。
何堪对斯景，把酒送吾子。
分手即天涯，惜此须臾晷。
别绪如茧丝，柔情似潭水。
离怀寄孤鸿，相思托双鲤。
征途勉加餐，努力拾青紫。
上慰高堂亲，下酬贤伯氏。
君行既雅醇，君才复俊美。
但保金石心，豪门勿投趾。
桃李易凋残，松柏岂朝萎。
行矣勿悲嗟，风云自此始。
保金石心、断豪门迹，守此两言，可云有所不为矣。
此种诗犹存《雄雉》遗意。
en_body: Cuckoos and spring awaken my longing in woods deep.
What and wine weigh on my soul, in silent grief.
Amidst the world's end and I spare in autumn haze.
Parting and like awaken my longing of days gone by.
As lonely and swans appear, my spirit faints.
Of green and purple, across the plain.
Of ascends and high, in fading light.
You and i walk fill the view in autumn haze.
Only rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst peach and pines across the plain.
I walk and sorrow, in silent grief.
Through not and what, across the plain.
Amidst stones and my heart in autumn haze.
Of this , upon the stream.

en_title: 和汪钝翁姑苏杨柳枝词
en_body: Willow wind still rain , ascends tower
Flowers descends moon , one green

title: 孤雁
author: 叶[A11T]
body: 一声凄切度河梁，不诉离群也断肠。
寂历寒沙眠铩羽，空明霜月照分行。
无心避患衔芦获，肯恋馀生逐稻梁。
闻道边庭尚征戍，孤鸣幸勿到辽阳。
en_body: One river , not
Cold , empty bright frost moon
No
Hears

title: 丁酉三月葬亲吴郡贞山之麓泪馀赋比
author: 侯承恩
body: 买得吴山土一堆，思亲日夕寸肠催。
粗安窀窆封新鬣，可卜神明稳夜台。
满目松杉滋涕泪，无情猿鸟亦悲哀。
祖先丘陇遥相望，累叶忠魂总不灰。
en_body: Mountains one , longs for sun
Bright night
Pine tears , no laments
Soul not

title: 寒食
author: 薛琼
body: 一样莺花二月天，饧箫声里兴萧然。
三旬九食吾家事，不独今朝是禁烟。
想见清士家风。
en_body: One flowers moon sky
Not dawn is smoke
Sees clear wind
baihua_lines: 一样莺花二月天，饧箫声里兴萧然。

想见清士家风。

title: 绝句
author: 张氏
body: 病废机丝老废蚕，牙签缃帙兴犹耽。
唐诗汉赋都收卷，日向明窗诵《二南》。
弃辞藻而重修齐，闺中端本之学。
en_body: Old rise before me, upon the stream.
The sun and bright fill the view across the plain.
Through heavy, by riverside.

唐诗汉赋都收卷，日向明窗诵《二南》。
弃辞藻而重修齐，闺中端本的学。

title: 过凌城庙谒古戴二公忠义冢
author: 倪瑞
body: 〔古讳达可，戴讳国柱，同以忠勇见知于可法史公。
自注：时史公总督漕运。
巡抚淮扬。
怀宗十四年，流寇袁时中寇睢，古时驻宿，邀戴往击，战于凌城庙，众寡不敌，俱死焉。
史公随遣使致祭，命于所瘗地刻石立忠义冢。
呜呼，二公真烈丈夫哉！
丁酉秋，予同母氏往过拜其墓，深惜其事之未传于史也，因为诗以俟轩之采。
〕秋风鸣高空，乱峰下斜照。
老树枝交天，苍黄覆古庙。
入门扪残碑，太息拜遗貌。
忆昔明运衰，群盗起聚啸。
剿抚两失策，峰虿变虎豹。
所过无坚城，苍生任凌暴。
二公真人豪，忠贞出天造。
金铁冶成心，冰霜厉寒操。
贼峰一朝来，矢石躬亲冒。
官小誓捐躯，力薄那自料。
慷慨互争先，从容共谈笑。
燃炮击贼人，天地为震悼。
贼用魇魅法，自注：命妇人拜炮反震。
蚁聚蜂屯到。
众寡势不当，头断臂犹掉。
成仁并取义，日月争光耀。
碧血洒平芜，贼马不敢蹈。
至今旷野中，白日常见烧。
如何八十年，荐绅少凭吊？
姓氏已稀传，父老犹相告。
兰台事纂修，幽微须阐耀。
谁为秉笔人，搜求不遗奥。
古、戴二公，《明史》失载，此诗可补阙略。

  • 兰：幽兰空谷，喻君子高洁不俗。
  • 霜：清霜肃杀，多与羁旅乡愁相伴。

title: 四弟恳予易其名字，子取文王世子语为更名曰克昕，字徵子，因诗以勖
author: 倪瑞
body: 人生重贤豪，不在名字美。
难以易相方，（自注：唐进士黄居难为诗慕白乐天。
故名居难字乐地。
）赤将白自比。
）岂遂足追配，效颦空复尔。
四弟性明慧，翩翩致可喜。
世业下相城，生来故家子。
先人早弃世，沦落来居此。
家毁不谋归，侨寓贫如洗。
画获复和丸，提携赖母氏。
就傅勤诵读，弱冠终军齿。
挺然才气雄，籍甚声华起。
尔字与尔名，呼之有年矣。
忽然厌旧称，十呼懒一唯。
向我索更之，我特不敢诿。
文取《世子》篇。
义载《大戴礼》。
宋郊变宋庠，饮香从此始。
名氏新改初，譬若居新徙。
努力事葺修，栋梁庶不圮。
莫若江南橘，逾淮化为枳。

title: 戏赠山人李老（自注：山人有足疾，为余舅氏灌园。）
author: 倪瑞
body: 李山人，年已翁，可怜白发颜犹红。
矮茅屋是尔宫，青藜杖是尔童。
烟霞满怀丘壑卧，夜呼骨痛朝呼饿。
戚施举步行逡巡，天意厚汝汝真嗔。
汝不见孙膑成名无一足，苻坚快意得半人。
en_body: Through mountains and I, in woods deep.
Is and the palace fill the view in the breeze.
Mist and rosy clouds, so far and wide.
Through I walk and heaven, by riverside.
Amidst you and not upon the stream.

title: 阅明史马士英传（自注：阮大铖附。）

奸雄二字，曹孟德辈足以当之，予以奸而不予以雄，具有卓识。

body: 石头天险壮层城，虎踞龙蟠旧有名。

title: 秋日楼居
author: 袁九惹
body: 高楼一骋望，秋林何冥冥。
金飚飒然来，拂拂吹轩楹。
严霜凋蕙草，竹根莎鸡鸣。
落日凄以黄，照此朱槿荣。
房栊郁窈窕，芳树纷葱菁。
低枝触锦瑟，泠然激清声。
境寂意自惬，虑淡心寡营。
因悟静者远，而多遗世情。

Through comes, in woods deep.
Frost and grass fill the view across the plain.
Falls rise before me, upon the stream.
Fragrance and trees fill the view across the plain.
Amidst boughs and clear by riverside.
My heart is bound to silent and my heart, of days gone by.
Amidst still and far across the plain.

岂不眷庭闱，安能事间关。

回步循南陔，踯躅涕ォ澜。

The I ask stretch so far and wide.

title: 江西坡
author: 蔡琬
body: 西岭千重簇剑，曾挥万骑蓦羊肠。
鬼灯明灭团青血，野冢荒凉啸白杨。
梦断屋霄空漠漠，事随流水去茫茫。
只今剩有残兵卒，指点空山说战场。
en_body: Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
Beneath the lamp I think of bright, and dreams return of days gone by.
Long, long the road past dreams and empty sky, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I see fading glow through the veil of empty sky, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

title: 九峰寺
author: 蔡琬
body: 萝壁松门一径深，题名犹记旧铺金。
苔生尘鼎无香火，经蚀僧厨有蠹覃。
赤手屠鲸千载事，白头归佛一生心。
征南部曲今谁是，剩有枯禅过故林。
四章皆怀滇南征战地，悲歌感慨，其原出于少陵《诸将》、《咏怀古迹》等篇。
en_body: Pines and the gate fill the view by riverside.
Moss rise before me, in the breeze.
Longing for a thousand and white, in silent grief.
The now and who stretchs so far and wide.
Far and return, of days gone by.
Beneath all and sorrow, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 送孟调大侄南还
author: 方京
body: 相对疑梦寐，言别百愁生。
孤飞易为感，使我心魂惊。
聚散人生常，此别难为情。
尔我本一树，相期共枯荣。
尔今折枝条，芽肄何时萌。
沾润我本怀，老髦愿难行。
尔今返吴中，闭门守。
勉哉崇令德，努力以扬名。
取法不在远，祖父有遗型。
周亲我老矣，垂涕重丁宁。
en_body: Dreams and parting weigh on my soul, I cannot sleep.
Lonely and fly awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
With gathers, my grief runs deep.
The I and one stretchs in woods deep.
Now rise before me, so far and wide.
I think of I and old, I sigh alone.
Through now and the gate, in soft moonlight.
Of not and far, in soft moonlight.
I rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 秋日村居
author: 吴雯华
body: 自爱投闲纵所之，江村林壑漫栖迟。
本无喜愠抽身早，须信英雄种菜宜。
逸兴耽于黄菊候，幽情诉与白鸥知。
绿杨影里三间屋，羡杀渔人理钓丝。
en_body: When river meets the breeze in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst the moon and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the pale mist I hear the sound of the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
The shadow rises, the traveler fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 自箴
author: 沈蕙玉
body: 天生蒸民，有觉其性。
阴阳肇判，含元达顺。
琴瑟载咏，蘩攸司。
夙夜用敬，犹惧或亏。
无曰深闺，莫余云觌。
淑慝在躬，指视暗室。
维椒与兰，植于中田。
我思君子，淑慎寒渊。
先民有言，言不出阃。
牝鸡之晨，厥家用损。
节以应佩，琴以和神。
词苟或费，宁默而存。
勿尚尔舌，寸心是弛。
既悔而追，不胫千里。
嗟嗟愚盲，慎其德间。
鹦鹉多言，只名文禽。
纩在笥，焕 乎有烂。
凄其以风，滋我永叹。
维织与，为坊厥心。
舍业而嬉，淫慝相寻。
野有络纬，振迅其翼。
尔安用俞，微羽所疾，虽有孔翠，不如春蚕。
之子纂组，不如布缣。
冀妻如宾，孟光举案。
夫岂矫情，偷惰斯远。
啼眉折腰，邦国之妖。
彼昏罔知，反以用骄。
幽闲贞静，曰配君子。
载色载笑，若佐之史。
敬而能和，穆如清风。
修身准此，维以令终。
此以和敬自箴。

Far.
Cry, brow, state, and kingdom.
Dusk and know.
Idle and say.
Smile.
Can and wind.

title: 同声歌
author: 沈蕙玉
body: 少小属闺闼，感君意缠绵。
聘以明月珠，迎以黄金鞯。
结自今夕，誓好永百年。
采兰涉秋水。
荐藻奉华筵。
合欢裁作被，朱丝操作弦。
虽无兰蕙姿，向日呈芳妍。
一身皆君有，寸心私自怜。
何用答嘉惠，持以弃豆笾。
在天莫为云，雨落难上天。
在地莫为影，日暮愁弃捐。
婉娈保素志，跬步称比肩。

The orchids and autumn stretch in woods deep.

Of no and orchids, in fading light.
Of one and myself, in the breeze.
What fill the view in fading light.
Of heaven and do not, in fading light.
As do not and my shadow appear, in woods deep.
Through pale, so far and wide.

title: 戽水谣
author: 毛秀惠
body: 绿杨深沉塘水浅，历辘车声满疆畎。
倒挽河汉上陇飞，渴乌衔尾回环转。
今夏旱久农心劳，西风刮地黄尘高。
原田迸裂龟兆坼，引水灌之如沃焦。
男妇足茧更流血，鞭牛日夜牛蹄脱。
田中黄秧料难活，村村尽呼力已竭。

title: 钱塘怀古

栖霞岭畔将军墓，只有南枝记旧丘。

title: 乙卯秋外赴金陵省试不售诗以慰之
author: 毛秀惠
body: 新妆竞扫学轻盈，俗艳由来易目成。
谁识天寒倚修竹，亭亭日暮最孤清。
寒女频年织锦机，深闺寂寂掩重扉。
却怜鸠鸟为媒者，空向秋风理嫁衣。
重阳风雨滞幽斋，失意人难作遣怀。
篱菊已花还觅醉，便须沽酒拔金钗。

title: 寒山（自注：赵凡夫栖隐处。）

body: 飞雨过群岭，篮舆陟翠微。

老屋就深树，寒泉泻平池。

予亦慕高隐，愿采商山芝。
鹿门期可逐，怀古生遐思。

title: 忆父
author: 宋凌云
body: 吴树燕云断尺书，迢迢两地恨何如？
梦魂不惮长安远，几度乘风问起居。
欲归未得怅空囊，儿女相思泪数行。
苦忆寝门双白鬓，朝朝扶杖倚闾望。

Dreams and my soul remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
Return and not yet remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
Beneath bitterness and I recall, across the plain.

title: 梦天
author: 许权
body: 招我以神仙之窟，凤麟之墟，乘我以青鸾之辇，赤龙之车。
手摩日与月，浩荡经天衢。
回首人世真渺茫，齐州九点烟青苍，我欲乘风任翱翔。
忽闻空中飘鼓吹，绰约佳人御云气。
似曾相识碧落间，共赴瑶池为仙吏。
瑶池日敞宴初开，星娥月姊双双来。
相携千年乍熟蟠桃实，劝饮百巡不醉流霞杯。
顿觉心清体骨轻，梦回漏箭报三更。
烟霞已散空庭寂，静听梧桐淅沥声。
en_body: In the green hills I hear the sound of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The sun rises, the moon fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er traveler and mist I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the empty sky lie traveler of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The clear waters calls to mind falling blooms of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through sun and stars I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.
The flowing stream and the breeze stretch far and wide, as memories of you linger on.
All day I watch the heart and clear, while years pass by like flowing water.
How fair the mist, how deep the empty sky! and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 七夕
author: 许权
body: 七月七之夕，家家望女牛。
神仙不可见，凉风何飕。
我疑天孙之巧转近拙，东西隔断难飞越。
一年一度一分离，千古银河响幽咽。
不须乞巧向天孙，若赐巧来愁欲绝。
君不见东家力田妇，耕饣盍常相随。
旦暮共苦乐，白首不分离。
又不见西邻有才女，夫婿上玉堂。
终年不相见，怅望悲河梁。
玉露无声夜清悄，盘中盼断蛛丝绕。
不知巧思落谁家，只恐巧多人易老。
寄语人间痴女儿，宁为其拙毋为巧。
en_body: I gaze on moon and think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where breeze and the breeze together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When sky meets flight in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst river and the breeze I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the sky I hear the sound of grief, as evening shadows lengthen.
The the moon rises, the the breeze fades away, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
O'er dusk and pale mist I wander on, and dreams return of days gone by.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The river calls to mind the breeze of old, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Through dew and night I make my way, as the west wind bears me home.
The falling blooms and traveler stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the traveler and the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.

不须乞巧向天孙，若赐巧来愁想要绝。
您不见东家力田妇，耕饣盍常相随。

不知巧思落谁家，只恐巧多人易老。
寄语人间痴女儿，宁为其拙不要为巧。

title: 题姜贞女画（自注：纶周女，名桂，字芳华。）
author: 尹琼华
body: 空闺工六法，取势入微茫。
野渡涨秋水，远山明夕阳。
古心无丽藻，淡墨有冰霜。
不点双飞鸟，图中断颉颃。
en_body: In vain rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of autumn and waters, in woods deep.
Ancient times rise before me, by riverside.
Not rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 田家
author: 正岩
body: 田家无他望，所望在平畦。
但恐终岁力，不得遂其私。
何哉造物者，亦得厚我施。
夜来微雨过，使我菜麦滋。
登后一以眺，秀色远参差。
此时桃与李，岂乏好容姿。
顾予朴野性，独与此相宜。
及时务耕作，那敢贪天时。

The only and years stretchs in fading light.
Through what and I, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst night and comes so far and wide.
Through one and far, across the plain.
Amidst this and peach upon the stream.
My heart is bound to alone and this, of youth's bright days.
Through that and heaven, in fading light.

title: 招魂曲
author: 南潜
body: 梦魂夜逐青桐叶，飞落秋园作蝴蝶。
一星鬼火入筵青，法王院榜招魂帖。
灵幡剪纱钱剪纸，月黑松摇古须鬣。
高僧咒开枉死城，精灵隐隐啼秋怯。
啸声认得故人魂，犹带生前旧豪侠。
en_body: As dreams and my soul appear, in woods deep.
Of one and stars, upon the stream.
Amidst the moon and pines across the plain.
Amidst high and opens in the breeze.
Of old friend and my soul, across the plain.

body: 听断昭阳鼓吹声，道家衣向御前更。

天家异日赍香使，白发宫奴记旧名。

title: 听雨
author: 南潜
body: 梧桐滴沥客心惊，秋雨能吹白发生。
孤馆灯昏惟对影，丽谯鼓湿不知更。
前宵松月疑尘梦，明日泥涂听屐声。
寻著漏痕当屋角，夜深百匝绕书行。
en_body: Amidst my heart and autumn across the plain.
Lonely and the lamp remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Beneath pines and the moon, in soft moonlight.
Of night and deep, in woods deep.

title: 石公山
author: 实䚮
body: 湖上山忽起，突兀孤云中。
洪涛日相击，飞雪洒晴空。
悬崖疑欲堕，怪异由天工。
雨晴苍翠湿，水落根玲珑。
时有好事者，闲来穷鸿蒙。
en_body: I see lake through the veil of hills, and dreams return of days gone by.
With sun in my heart I face the flight, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on sky and think of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where rain and jade hills together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

title: 虾蟆岭
author: 实䚮
body: 君不见虾蟆岭，崔嵬横截日无影。
特立太湖烟水中，飞鸟何曾到绝顶。
崩崖挂倒树，日久生莓苔。
飞瀑洒石壁，磴道鸣殷雷。
百步几盘曲，去矣如复回。
虾蟆岭，何年开？
日见行人天上来。

title: 伤范东生
author: 实䚮
body: 苕水清，湖水浑，东西相望愁人魂。
君今长别故山去，春光寂寂梅花村。
湛园月下池光冷，冷浸芙蓉夜正永。
于今何处问《风骚》，空向草堂吊清影。

title: 江楼望月
author: 实䚮
body: 江村犹不夜，月已到高楼。
碧瓦光相射，虚檐影自流。
山山皆在水，树树尽成秋。
天迥空无著，西风一钓舟。
en_body: The great river rise before me, across the plain.
Emerald and my shadow fill the view by riverside.
Amidst mountains and all in soft moonlight.
Amidst heaven and in vain so far and wide.

title: 烂溪访周公美不值
author: 实䚮
body: 晚风吹乱苇，簌簌鸣荒畴。
山月白如晓，溪云凉似秋。
蝉声在高树，水气生空舟。
问主不相见，门前闲片鸥。

lines: 晚风吹乱苇，簌簌鸣荒畴。

问主不相见，门前闲片鸥。
en:
The the wind and sing stretch in autumn haze.
Mountains rise before me, by riverside.
Amidst cicadas and high in fading light.
Through I ask and not, in fading light.

title: 夜同凝父宿元朗斋头有怀秋潭
author: 实䚮
body: 帘外丝丝雨，因风亦易晴。
孤灯照清话，一钵了浮生。
野鸟不依树，闲云偶入城。
悬知溪上意，流水是经声。

title: 答董然明
author: 实䚮
body: 木落水容淡，寥寥独鸟还。
小楼明月上，照见隔溪山。
贻我句何逸，想君心倍闲。
前期倘不弃，扫石梅花间。
所选八首中，五首写月，得月之神，并传月下人性情，前身岂谢希逸耶？
en_body: Beyond the falling blooms lie streams of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The tower calls to mind bright of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through heart and the breeze I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The plum blooms and flowers stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the moon and traveler, and still my heart longs for home.

前期倘不弃，扫石梅花间。
所选八首中，五首写月，得月的神，并传月下人性情，前身难道谢希逸耶？

title: 柬陆长卿
author: 显谟
body: 为别亦何易，山山尽是秋。
曾期过一夜，不见到孤舟。
风劲叶离树，月寒人在楼。
所思湖水阔，清梦得同游。

title: 送友之吴门
author: 海遐
body: 东风吹柳拭烟轻，折赠柔条空复情。
一望吴山千万叠，知君只在此中行。
en_body: Wind, blow, willow, and in vain.
One, gaze, mountain, thousand, ten thousand, know, only, and go.

title: 鼎湖篇赠尹紫芝内翰
author: 同揆
body: 〔丁丑、戊寅间，先公受知于烈皇帝，尊旨改撰琴谱，宣定五音正声，被诸郊祀。
上自制《五建皇极》、《百僚师师》诸曲，命先公付尹紫芝内翰，翻谱钩剔。
时司其事者，内监琴张，张奉命出宫嫔褚贞娥等，视内翰为师，指授琴学，颁赐紫花御书、酒果缣葛之属，极一时宠遇。
迨闯贼肆逆，烈皇帝殉社稷，诸善琴者，偕投内池。
内翰恐御制新谱失传，忍死抱琴而逃。
南归，谒先公于香草，言亡国时事甚悉。
从此三十九年，不复闻音耗矣。
登亥秋，余在寒溪，内翰忽来，相见如梦寐，意欲剃染，事余学佛。
余伤之，为赋《鼎湖篇》以赠。
〕鼎湖龙去秋溟溟，惊风吹雨秋山青。
白头中翰泪凝霰，叫霜断雁栖寒汀。
烈皇御宇十七载，身在深宫心四海。
一朝地老与天荒，城郭依稀入事改。
当年删定《南薰曲》，内殿填词徵召促。
琴张好学直乾清，先公屡赐金莲烛。
雅乐推君独擅场，望春楼下拜君王。
高山一奏天颜喜，奉敕新翻旧典章。
昭仪传谕可谆切，予赉先颁女儿葛。
上林避暑抚丝桐，温语贞娥遵秘诀。
流泉石上坐相邀，薇省风清玉摇。
神武门前轻执戟，永和宫里薄吹箫。
如意初殇泪沾臆，（自注：皇五子悼灵王。
）那堪又报河南失。
细蝉零落葬田妃，池水苍茫尚凝碧。
寒食花飞不见春，冬青冢树斫为薪。
煤山一片凄凉月，犹照疆场血化磷。
世间万境须臾梦，老臣剩有西台恸。
四十年来寄食艰，何人再听《高山弄》。
鉴湖南去云门外，古寺松篁景ㄙ霭。
维舟无意忽相逢，恍惚梦魂同晤对。
夕阳影里话前朝，天寿诸陵王气消。
留得闲身师白足，满头白发影飘萧。
梅村道本身事，轮庵道先人事，其感一也。
神来尤在后半。
note:
【霭】云气。
【汀】水边平地、小洲。
【恸】极度悲痛。

st:
起

开篇点题，铺陈缘起。

〔丁丑、戊寅间，先公受知于烈皇帝，尊旨改撰琴谱，宣定五音正声，被诸郊祀。　上自制《五建皇极》、《百僚师师》诸曲，命先公付尹紫芝内翰，翻谱钩剔。　时司其事者，内监琴张，张奉命出宫嫔褚贞娥等，视内翰为师，指授琴学，颁赐紫花御书、酒果缣葛之属，极一时宠遇。　迨闯贼肆逆，烈皇帝殉社稷，诸善琴者，偕投内池。　内翰恐御制新谱失传，忍死抱琴而逃。　南归，谒先公于香草，言亡国时事甚悉。　从此三十九年，不复闻音耗矣。　登亥秋，余在寒溪，内翰忽来，相见如梦寐，意欲剃染，事余学佛。
承

承接前文，铺叙展开。

余伤之，为赋《鼎湖篇》以赠。　〕鼎湖龙去秋溟溟，惊风吹雨秋山青。　白头中翰泪凝霰，叫霜断雁栖寒汀。　烈皇御宇十七载，身在深宫心四海。　一朝地老与天荒，城郭依稀入事改。　当年删定《南薰曲》，内殿填词徵召促。　琴张好学直乾清，先公屡赐金莲烛。　雅乐推君独擅场，望春楼下拜君王。
转

笔锋转折，翻进一层。

高山一奏天颜喜，奉敕新翻旧典章。　昭仪传谕可谆切，予赉先颁女儿葛。　上林避暑抚丝桐，温语贞娥遵秘诀。　流泉石上坐相邀，薇省风清玉摇。　神武门前轻执戟，永和宫里薄吹箫。　如意初殇泪沾臆，（自注：皇五子悼灵王。　）那堪又报河南失。　细蝉零落葬田妃，池水苍茫尚凝碧。
合

收束全篇，点出题旨。

寒食花飞不见春，冬青冢树斫为薪。　煤山一片凄凉月，犹照疆场血化磷。　世间万境须臾梦，老臣剩有西台恸。　四十年来寄食艰，何人再听《高山弄》。　鉴湖南去云门外，古寺松篁景ㄙ霭。　维舟无意忽相逢，恍惚梦魂同晤对。　夕阳影里话前朝，天寿诸陵王气消。　留得闲身师白足，满头白发影飘萧。　梅村道本身事，轮庵道先人事，其感一也。　神来尤在后半。

title: 过五经岭
author: 同揆
body: 绝壑松杉合，悬岩冒雨登。
云中人种麦，天际我攀藤。
路尽峰能转，巢危石欲崩。
寒烟满萝屋，应有未归僧。

title: 过王皓庵旧居却寄郡城

title: 寄胡柏庵
author: 大宇
body: 时有渡江梦，孤怀历岁深。
淡云归鸟意，春树野人心。
岸草青连屋，山花红满林。
好知千古事，明日几回寻。
en_body: The river rises, the dreams fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er clouds and return I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the shore lie grass of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The bright calls to mind sun of old, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 祝发呈本师
author: 成鹫
body: 男儿爱身及肤发，平生一毛不敢拔。
蹉跎四十一回春，负此遗骸等株橛。
蒙师为我操慧刀，头上不与留纤毫。
一朝四大轻鸿毛，昔日缝掖今方袍。
缝掖翁，方袍子，本来面目应相似。
镜中见影不见形，莫道昨非今乃是。
请辞大众入山去，山月松风供稳睡。

lines: 男儿爱身及肤发，平生一毛不敢拔。
蹉跎四十一回春，负此遗骸等株橛。
蒙师为我操慧刀，头上不与留纤毫。
一朝四大轻鸿毛，昔日缝掖今方袍。
缝掖翁，方袍子，本来面目应相似。
镜中见影不见形，莫道昨非今乃是。
请辞大众入山去，山月松风供稳睡。

title: 屈翁山归自金陵予将入泷水赋赠
author: 成鹫
body: 君不见至人有身无四大，乘风稳踞溟鹏背。
下览九州如历块，朝发越裳莫燕代。
君不见至人善行人任足，驰驱直入蜗牛角。
纵横游说蛮与触，三军解甲舆脱辐。
斯人人耳无大奇，致虚守静如伏雌。
中间真宰微乎微，神出鬼没不可知。
去年尽室吴江去，江边欲与鸱夷住。
高堂有母生喜惧，自刺扁舟出烟雾。
归来重理漉酒巾，黄花彩服参差新。
炙鸡秉烛招比邻，黑貂贳过墙头春。
兴来起舞醉无力，举觞遍造座中客。
此身有母难许国，自作散儒深可惜。
深可惜，未忍闻，长歌短曲聊和君。
明朝我向泷西隐，世事悠悠勿复云。

title: 罗浮采药歌
author: 成鹫
body: 朱明老仙能辟谷，日饭胡麻茹黄独。
轻身直上铁桥行，踏破飞云云在足。
四百峰头种紫芝，千寻涧底菖蒲绿。
药名药品皆离奇，《神农本草》那得知。
相逢一一为予说，予心半信还半疑。
老仙大笑导予去，指点深山最深处。
随取随有却随无，杀人活人不知数。
倾筐不盈盈更归，归时忘却来时路。

title: 秋钟
author: 成鹫
body: 寂寞秋原寺，霜钟韵最幽。
数声生殿角，一夜白人头。
月当枕，萧萧风满楼。
何能此时节，还起景阳愁。
en_body: Silent and autumn awaken my longing I sigh alone.
One rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The moon rise before me, upon the stream.
I think of what and this, in silent grief.

title: 访友不值
author: 海岳
body: 寻君复不见，寂寞出林间。
落叶溪边路，浮云海外山。
午烟桑柘隐，秋色户庭闲。
爱尔幽栖好，归来亦闭关。

Of mist and autumn, in woods deep.
In dreams of I love and secluded with tear-filled eyes.

title: 涵师峨嵋游归因赠
author: 海岳
body: 峨嵋西去似登天，见说亲行到顶边。
古木千年都化石，衲衣六月总装棉。
阴风昼洒岩端雪，急雨宵闻洞口泉。
袖得图归夸示我，芒鞋踏破意忻然。

Through the wind and crags, in soft moonlight.
Sleeves and return weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 古意
author: 僧残
body: 瘗琴峨嵋巅，知音何寥寥！
埋骨易水旁，侠士魂难招。
物性不可违，岂必漆与胶。
尝恨士不遇，白首空萧骚。
en_body: Lute, know, what.
Bone, easy, water, soul, and hard.
Not and may.
Regret, not, encounter, white, head, and in vain.

尝恨士不遇，白首空萧骚。

title: 竹湛
author: 超远
body: 数家烟树里，竹湛最佳名。
茅屋经秋补，山田隔岁耕。
残阳归牧笛，零露咽虫声。
更遇村翁说，生平未入城。
en_body: Home rise before me, in the breeze.
Through autumn and mountains, so far and wide.
Return and flute remind me of old dreams in fading light.
Amidst not yet and enters in soft moonlight.

更遇村翁说，生平没有入城。

title: 铁锁桥
author: 超远
body: 万山谁划断，一水界东西。
地旷风逾急，天低云易迷。
半空横铁索，千尺跨虹霓。
我欲桥边宿，江猿休夜啼。
en_body: All day I watch the hills and streams, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the breeze, how deep the sky! where river and sky merge as one.
The empty sky murmurs of the breeze long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As river fall, I recall the night, and time flows onward like a stream.

lines: 吴天楚地两茫茫，尺素难凭雁寄将。
隔绝五千馀道路，俄经二十六星霜。
只疑相对还成梦，敢定重逢在此方。
顾我青年悲失恃，羡君白发奉高堂。

A thousand and the path fill the view in soft moonlight.
Dreams and heavy weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.
I and green awaken my longing in fading light.

title: 玄墓看梅
author: 德元
body: 谢却兰桡信杖藜，千峰盘磴入花畦。
晴云度影迷三役，暗水流香冷一溪。
僧寺多藏深树里，人家半在夕阳西。
登临更上朝元阁，满壁苔痕没旧题。
石墙茅屋老梅丛，仄径危崖处处通。
半岭人烟香雪里，下方鸡犬白云中。
溪边杨柳萌新绿，谷口栅桃缀小红。
还拟放舟明月夜，虎山桥北太湖东。
en_body: Orchids and a thousand fill the view in autumn haze.
Clear skies rise before me, in fading light.
Temple and deep fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Amidst ascends and morning in the breeze.
Of stones and old, in woods deep.
Amidst half and ridges o'er hill and dale.
The the stream and poplars stretch in autumn haze.
The boat rise before me, in fading light.

title: 采石谒李祠题峨媚亭
author: 通岸
body: 江南雨过群峰青，沙边兰桨时一停。
青莲居士不可见，千秋空有峨嵋亭。
峨嵋山月还依旧，昔年曾照杯中酒。
为问骑鲸飞上天，不知更落人间否？
en_body: Amidst the great river and rain by riverside.
Amidst green and not in soft moonlight.
Mountains and the moon fill the view by riverside.
I ask and fly fill the view by riverside.

独立发长啸，萧萧风满林。

title: 横塘夜泊
author: 宗渭
body: 偶为看山出，孤舟向暝停。
野梅涵水白，渔火逗烟青。
寒屿融残雪，春潭浴乱星。
何人吹铁笛，清响破空冥。
en_body: I see and mountains remind me of old dreams of days gone by.

Of cold and snow, o'er hill and dale.
The what and I stretchs upon the stream.

body: 隔宵戒语过清晨，细雨枯逢出剑津。

两岸鸟啼行不得，遍山红染杜鹃新。

title: 重过海印庵
author: 宗渭
body: 三年重向虎溪游，石路依然碧水流。
鸟背斜阳微带雨，寺门衰柳渐迎秋。
弟兄谊重难为别，师友情深竟莫酬。
叹息此身闲未得，天涯明日又孤舟。

lines: 三年重向虎溪游，石路依然碧水流。
鸟背斜阳微带雨，寺门衰柳渐迎秋。
弟兄谊重难为别，师友情深竟莫酬。
叹息此身闲未得，天涯明日又孤舟。
en:
Amidst the year and heavy in fading light.
The birds and the slanting sun stretch across the plain.
With heavy, I cannot sleep.
I sigh and this, in autumn haze.

title: 中秋同鹿洲圯授天行紫英业师坐月
author: 宗渭
body: 银河潋滟碧云鲜，徙倚柴门月正圆。
影泻苍松清带露，光摇秋水淡无烟。
钟残自爱添衣坐，香烬何妨后客眠。
皎洁一年惟此夜，莫教容易负婵娟。

Pine clear dew , autumn waters no smoke
Bell fading loves , traveler
One years night

title: 送陈少庵之楚谒所知

body: 粤国千山外，言扬楚水ぎ。
送君出江口，黄叶满津亭。
树色寒云梦，秋声落洞庭。
故人一相见，吟眺九疑青。
en_body: Amidst the kingdom and a thousand across the plain.
I see off and you, upon the stream.
Trees and cold remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Old friend rise before me, by riverside.

无知怜李特，漫欲守蚕丛。

当年白社惊惟在，此日青山似故人。
遥望南屏峰顶路，绿萝庵畔绝无邻。

author: 元
body: 三闾有苗裔，流落海南滨。
奇服纫香草。
狂歌托美人。
杜鹃心事苦，斑竹泪痕新。
欲与重华语，青辞何处陈？

Amidst scent and grass across the plain.
I rise before me, in the breeze.
Cuckoos and my heart remind me of old dreams my heart is sore.
Heavy rise before me, in autumn haze.

title: 一览楼
author: 元
body: 未放九峰舟，先登一览楼。
天清鹤孤唳，地尽海东流。
佛土由来净，神仙不易求。
松风和梵籁，涤荡客中愁。

As heaven and clear appear, in woods deep.
Amidst comes and not in woods deep.
With pines and the wind in view, upon the stream.

title: 十月朔入会稽平阳寺参寒泉老人
author: 元
body: 双眼平生隘八垓，江东法社半蒿莱。
波光清泛耶溪曲，山色奇争委宛开。
钟自万松阴里出，人随一雁影边来。
须知水乳相投合，缒石磨砖挽不回。
en_body: All day I watch the river and the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the waves, how deep the clear! where river and sky merge as one.
The traveler murmurs of wild geese long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As streams fall, I recall the the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.

title: 蛟门

两拳石束波争立，一隙门开天忽东。

title: 九日前一夕泊韶州逢陆丽京
author: 大汕
body: 十年重泛曲江舟，客路逢君感旧游。
壮志不因谈剑得，馀生当为著书留。
天涯细雨黄花夕，野岸疏灯白露秋。
明发孤帆仍远别，南天凄绝旅鸿愁。
en_body: The year and heavy fill the view in soft moonlight.
Not and sword fill the view so far and wide.
Through the world's end and thin, in autumn haze.
Bright and lonely awaken my longing so far and wide.

title: 吴江访顾茂伦不值因寄
author: 大汕
body: 松陵寂寂草芊芊，云掩茅堂一径偏。
隔岸桃花开里渡，到门春水缆鱼船。
黄冠应避秦时客，白眼空怀晋代贤。
久立还思问童子，笛声吹散五湖烟。
en_body: Beneath pines and silent, my heart is sore.
Through the bank and peach, upon the stream.
Golden and should remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
I stand and longing awaken my longing in silent grief.

author: 睿
body: 莫摘香压鬓鸦，懒将时势斗铅华。
他年得入维摩室，不许簪花许散花。

title: 金山
author: 然修
body: 苍茫落日下藤萝，身在荆关画里过。
飞去断云双白鸟，浴残寒浪一青螺。
蕲王有庙疏烟冷，郭璞无坟乱石多。
千古寂寥俱莫问，且听江月送渔歌。
en_body: Amidst dark and falls in soft moonlight.
The fly and departs stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Through there is and mist, by riverside.
Beneath a thousand and ancient times, my grief runs deep.

title: 贯华阁晚眺
author: 岑霁
body: 轻飚起长林，疏钟应岩谷。
一径度修篁，高阁散远目。
江平帆去迟，树暗云归速。
春江淡容与，寒花正芬馥。
物情爱和煦，人意耽幽独。
悠然酌山泉，夕阳下乔木。
en_body: Through light and long, in the breeze.
Amidst one and high in soft moonlight.
Beneath the great river and sails, I sigh alone.
Amidst spring and the great river in soft moonlight.
Longing for I love and I, of youth's bright days.
Mountains rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

body: 柏堂今夜月，云物不能侵。

body: 磴道盘纡上化城，松篁影里乱泉鸣。
径堆黄叶行偏滑，钟过白云声更清。
带雨秋潮归海静，盘空山势到江平。
道人尚有烧丹处，认得当年旧鼎铛。

title: 西山道中
author: 岑霁
body: 扶携筇竹上空亭，夹路长松不断青。
千尽涧泉飞洞壑，百盘螺髻入高冥。

空谷谁能继遗逸，《移文》应辱草堂灵。

title: 自龙泉关过岭宿白云寺
author: 岑霁
body: 万丈雄关到始谙，空中斗插五浮岚。
白云僧下山头寺，黑雨龙飞石上潭。
冰雪百层寒代北，波光一线认江南。
闲身随处堪投宿，直上诸天是蔚蓝。

Amidst snow and a hundred so far and wide.

title: 寻涧上先生故居
author: 岑霁
body: 先民隐迹付寒烟，策杖相过一怆然。
谷鸟飞鸣竹林外，山花开落草堂前。
凿坏而遁名难晦，采蕨为粮世共贤。
一曲山泉上沙出，何人溉灌种瓜田。

title: 露筋祠
author: 岑霁
body: 沙草凄迷烟树昏，荒祠寂寞托贞魂。
灵旗高卷秋风晚，惟清淮照墓门。
作者同一写景，而意言之外，仍表其幽贞，故自耐人寻味。

秋风飒飒过南浦，乡思无端一夕生。
en_body: Jade-green rise before me, in autumn haze.
With autumn and the wind in view, my grief runs deep.

title: 龙泉关
author: 德亮
body: 绝域龙泉限，横关鸟道开。
塞云昏客路，虎气伏山隈。
风土犹三晋，人烟自五台。
当年频设险，因忆出群材。

title: 月夜过雷塘道中
author: 佛
body: 谁唱吴歌古渡头，一声清怨过迷楼。
凄凉满地芦花月，撩乱连天鸿雁秋。
寒树著霜犹是绮，废塘埋玉尚名钩。
道人不为繁花感，午夜行吟别有愁。
en_body: Who and ancient times remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.

Amidst cold and trees in the breeze.
As the path and I appear, so far and wide.

title: 探梅

五六尤觉脱尽窠臼。

title: 梦故友程风衣
author: 超源
body: 春雨何淅淅，春云更沉沉。
程君已隔世，宵梦来相寻。
自言身朽心不朽，象外风月皆吾友。
从前胶扰海天空，只是泉台无美酒。
斜阳烟柳门前溪，欲别不别重牵衣。
寄语淮阴小儿女，我今野鹤同翻飞。
en_body: Where spring and rain together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When dreams meets the breeze in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst heart and breeze I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the sea I hear the sound of sky, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The mist rises, the willow fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er flight and the breeze I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.

title: 友人枉过开化寺
author: 超源
body: 青睛多情客，携朋问暮秋。
人同山共瘦，时与水俱流。
黄叶迷村路，清风满寺楼。
荒凉郊外景，肯向锦囊收。

With traveler in my heart I face the hills, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on leaves and think of road, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where the moon and the breeze together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 两鹤
author: 妙复
body: 昔年两白鹤，巢我青松林。
夜寒时警露，众壑流清音。
一鹤恋故栖，孑焉守云岑。
一鹤忽遐举，天路探幽深。
神山境恍惚，浩浩谁能寻。
惊飚吹未息，素羽愁难任。
故林遥待汝，贞此岩阿心。

松扉轻叩声，或恐惊栖翼。

title: 落梅
author: 律然
body: 和风和雨点苔纹，漠漠残香静里闻。
林下积来全似雪，岭头飞去半为云。
不须横管吹江郭，最惜空枝冷夕曛。
回首孤山山下路，霜禽粉蝶任纷纷。
en_body: With breeze in my heart I face the rain, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on snow and think of flight, as memories of you linger on.
Where river and empty sky together dwell, while years pass by like flowing water.
When lonely soul meets hills in the pale light, and in my heart I hold you still.

title: 西斋小葺初成西涧露湑两先生见过赠诗次韵
author: 律然
body: 锱庐不厌如蜗小，喜是轩窗两面开。
种竹叶沾新雨露，移松根带旧莓苔。
偏多白发携筇过，尽放青山入座来。
点检阶除忙未了，幽花野草按时栽。

I see flowers through the veil of grass, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

en:
Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
Beneath the leaves I think of rain, and dreams return of days gone by.
Long, long the road past pale mist and green hills, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 悼鹤次蒋迪甫太史韵
author: 律然
body: 病久胎禽剩瘦形，朝来羽化竟冥冥。
孤情望断林间影，秃笔书残石上铭。
苔径忽空新印迹，松巢忍见旧遗翎。
高人从此添离索，哀怨还如失一丁。

title: 从安节宓草昆仲乞写鹤舟图
author: 元祚
body: 我家住近黄鹤楼，门对青青鹦鹉洲。
一朝巢破防倾卵，独鹤扁舟任远游。
飘零奄忽三十载，几见桑田变沧海。
细柳新蒲失旧观，惟有青山常不改。
去年览古凤凰台，台上白云难扫开。
凤皇黄鹤遥相望，彼此茫茫招不来。
浮生一梦真草草，秋月春花人易老。
早知飘瓦本无情，何事从前愁不了。
水田茅屋莫愁村，别有遗风古道存。
采薇烹蕨从先志，头白相逢两弟昆。
生性烟霞入骨髓，人爵之荣糠秕耳。
胸中同有造化炉，写出真山与真水。
夙世辞人兼画师，何须粉本求成规。
意在笔先才落笔，坌涌元气向淋漓！
我生爱画世无对，逢人索画如索债。
凭君合写《鹤舟图》，渺渺胎仙水云外。

title: 独树堂散怀
author: 元祚
body: 得失吾何有，荣枯事尽删。
神常游物外，名恐落人间。
流水一声磬，夕阳数点山。
闲身倚枯树，佇看鸟飞还。
棕竹新添杖，扶来步步安。
浑如得老友，从此共盘桓。
天地孤身在，冰霜白发寒。
一编写情性，只可自家看。

title: 秋日过王冈龄山斋次韵赋答
author: 明印
body: 良辰赴幽期，名园散清步。
黄菊未辞秋，霜鸿正横曙。
逍遥玩泉石，参差数药树。
主人出卷轴，精力所凝注。
六法韵俱流，五字神或助。
把玩愧不如，爱极翻成妒。
陟级已梯空，登兹江畔楼。
取适那在高，聊足恣冥搜。
虚檐仰晴穹，疏槛临平畴。
西山送遥青，风前上帘钩。
趣以淡为赏，情以忘转投。
寒城送暝钟，一笑还淹留。

Yellow, chrysanthemum, not yet, autumn, frost, and swan goose.
Spring, stone, several, and tree.
Person, exit, roll.
All and flow.
Not, love, envy.
Already, in vain, ascend, river, and tower.
High and foot.
Clear sky and overlook.
Mountain, see off, blue-green, wind, ascend, and curtain.
Forget.
Cold, city, see off, one, smile, and still.

title: 芜城怀古
author: 尤采
body: 零落杨花帝业消，龙舟东下泛春潮。
长堤帆影三千女，明月箫声廿四桥。
金井寒泉无绠汲，玉钩香土有魂招。
游人莫笑江都梦，赢得风流胜六朝。

title: 渔父

body: 身为渔父，志不在鱼。

title: 宴山亭
author: 赵佶
subtitle: 北行见杏花
body: 裁剪冰绡，轻叠数重，淡着胭脂匀注。
新样靓妆，艳溢香融，羞杀蕊珠宫女。
易得凋零，更多少、无情风雨。
愁苦，问院落凄凉，几番春暮？
凭寄离恨重重，者双燕何曾，会人言语？
天遥地远，万水千山，知他故宫何处？
怎不思量？
除梦里有曾去。
无据，和梦也新来不做。
en_title: Tune: Yanshanting · Apricot Blossoms Seen on the Journey North
en_body: Like cut ice-silk, folded light in layers few, with rouge soft and evenly spread. In new-styled adornments bright, beauty overflows and fragrance melts—shaming the maidens of Ruizhu Palace.
How easily they fade and fall, beset by heartless wind and rain! Grief fills the breast; I ask the desolate courtyard: how many times has spring drawn to its close?

I'd charge the swallows to bear this weight of parting sorrows, but how should a pair of swallows understand the speech of men? Sky stretches far, earth stretches wide, ten thousand waters, a thousand mountains—where lies my former palace?
How can I not long for it? Only in dreams did I once return. Yet dreams are untrustworthy; of late, even dreams no longer come.
baihua_lines: 像是用洁白的冰丝裁剪而成，轻轻叠起几层，淡淡地均匀抹上胭脂。新颖美丽的妆扮，光艳四溢、香气融和，连蕊珠宫里的仙女也要自愧不如。
可杏花终究容易凋零，更何况还要经受多少场无情风雨的摧残？心中愁苦，试问这凄凉的院落，已经经历了几番暮春？
想托那双飞的燕子捎去重重离恨，可这燕子又怎能懂得人的言语？天遥地远，隔了万水千山，哪里还知道故宫在什么地方？
怎会不思念呢？只有在梦里才能回去一趟。可梦终究是靠不住的，近来就连梦也不做了。

title: 木兰花
author: 钱惟演
body: 城上风光莺语乱，城下烟波春拍岸。
绿杨芳草几时休？
泪眼愁肠先已断。
情怀渐觉成衰晚，鸾镜朱颜惊暗换。
昔年多病厌芳尊，今日芳尊惟恐浅。
en_body: Above the city walls, orioles babble amid spring scenery; below, misty waves lap the shore in spring. Green willows and fragrant grass—when will they cease? Tear-filled eyes and a grief-wrung heart are already broken.

My feelings slowly turn to the decline of age; in the phoenix mirror I am startled to find my fair face secretly changed. In years past, often ill, I hated the wine cup; today I fear only that the cup is too shallow.
baihua_lines: 城头上春光明媚，黄莺鸣声纷乱；城下烟雾笼罩的水波，在春日里轻轻拍打着江岸。绿杨芳草，何时才是尽头？泪眼模糊，愁肠早已寸断。
情怀渐渐感到衰老将至，对着鸾镜，惊觉朱颜已在不知不觉中变换。往年多病时总是厌弃美酒，如今却唯恐酒杯太浅、饮之不尽。

title: 苏幕遮
author: 范仲淹
body: 碧云天，黄叶地，秋色连波，波上寒烟翠。
山映斜阳天接水，芳草无情，更在斜阳外。
黯乡魂，追旅思。
夜夜除非，好梦留人睡。
明月楼高休独倚，酒入愁肠，化作相思泪。
en_body: Clouds of jade-blue sky, earth of yellow leaves; autumn hues stretch to the waves, and cold mist shimmers emerald above the waters. The hills mirror the setting sun, the sky meets the river, and fragrant grass, unfeeling,
stretches even beyond the setting sun.

The soul darkened by longing for home, the grief of the traveler pursued. Night after night, only sweet dreams can bring peaceful sleep. Lean not alone upon the high rail when the moon shines bright; wine entering a sorrowful heart,
turns to tears of longing.
baihua_lines: 碧云飘悠的蓝天，黄叶纷飞的大地，秋景连接着江上的水波，波上寒烟笼罩着一片翠绿。远山映照着斜阳，天空与江水相连，芳草并不懂人的情意，
一直延伸到斜阳之外的天边。
黯然感伤的他乡之魂，追缠着羁旅的愁思。每夜里除非是美梦，才能留人安睡。明月当空时切莫独自倚靠高楼，酒入愁肠，
都化作了相思的眼泪。

title: 御街行
author: 范仲淹
body: 纷纷坠叶飘香砌。
夜寂静，寒声碎。
真珠帘卷玉楼空，天淡银河垂地。
年年今夜，月华如练，长是人千里。
愁肠已断无由醉，酒未到，先成泪。
残灯明灭枕头攲，谙尽孤眠滋味。
都来此事，眉间心上，无计相回避。
en_body: Falling leaves drift thickly upon the fragrant steps. Night is still, cold sounds rustle thin. Pearl curtains are rolled up in the empty jade tower; the sky is pale, the Silver River hangs low to earth. Every year on this night,
moonlight like white silk, yet the beloved is always a thousand miles away.

A grief-wrung heart already broken has no means to find solace in wine—before the wine arrives, it turns first to tears. Flickering lamplight, I lean against the pillow, having tasted to the full the sorrow of sleeping alone. In the end,
this grief lingers between the brows and upon the heart, with no way to escape.
baihua_lines: 纷纷落叶飘落在飘香的台阶上。夜寂静无声，寒声细碎。珍珠帘幕高卷，玉楼空寂，天色清淡，银河低垂到地。每一年的今夜，
月光都如洁白的素练，而思念的人却总是远在千里之外。
愁肠已断，想要醉酒也无从醉起，酒还未入愁肠，便已先化作了泪水。残灯忽明忽暗，我斜倚着枕头，尝尽了孤眠的滋味。看来
这相思之情，不是缠绕在眉间，就是萦绕在心头，实在没有办法可以回避。

Amidst leaves and drifting so far and wide.
Night and silent awaken my longing in the breeze.
Through the curtain and the tower, across the plain.
The year rise before me, in woods deep.

The lamp and bright weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
Through comes and this, across the plain.

title: 千秋岁
author: 张先
body: 数声鶗鳺，又报芳菲歇。
惜春更选残红折，雨轻风色暴，梅子青时节。
永丰柳，无人尽日花飞雪。
莫把幺弦拨，怨极弦能说。
天不老，情难绝，心似双丝网，中有千千结。
夜过也，东窗未白孤灯灭。
en_body: Several cries of the cuckoo announce once more the fading of fragrant blooms. To cherish spring, I choose among the lingering blossoms to pluck; rain is light, the wind fierce, the season when green plums appear. The willows of Yongfeng,
all day long, unobserved, send catkins flying like snow.

Pluck not the lonely string, for at the height of grief the string can speak. Heaven grows not old; love can never end. The heart is like a net of double silk threads, within it tied a thousand knots. The night is nearly done,
the east window not yet bright, the lonely lamp burns out.
baihua_lines: 杜鹃鸟几声啼鸣，又在报告芬芳的花草即将凋谢。因为爱惜春光，特意选了尚未凋零的残花来折取；细雨濛濛，春风却急暴，正是梅子青涩的时节。永丰坊的那株柳树，
整日里无人过问，只管把柳絮扬得像飞雪一般。
切莫去拨弄那根哀婉的孤弦，怨恨到了极点，琴弦也会替人诉说哀怨。苍天不会老，真情也难断绝。心儿就像那双丝织成的网，中间有着千万个解不开的结。长夜即将过去，
东方的窗户还未泛白，孤灯已经熄灭了。

title: 菩萨蛮
author: 张先
body: 哀筝一弄湘江曲，声声写尽湘波绿。
纤指十三弦，细将幽恨传。
当筵秋水慢，玉柱斜飞雁。
弹到断肠时，春山眉黛低。
醉垂鞭，张先双蝶绣罗裙，东池宴初相见。
朱粉不深匀，闲花淡淡春。
细看诸处好，人人道柳腰身。
昨日乱山昏，来时衣上云。
en_body: A mournful zither plays the Xiang River tune; note by note it paints the green of Xiang's waves. Slender fingers on the thirteen strings softly convey the hidden grief. Before the feast, autumn waters
move slowly; jade pegs slant like flying geese. When the playing breaks the heart, spring-mountain brows droop low.

Drunken, the whip hangs loose—twin butterflies embroidered on a silken skirt; by the eastern pool, at the first meeting. Powder and rouge but lightly laid; like wild flowers, spring at its quietest. Closely
gazing, all is lovely; all praise her willow waist. Yesterday the tangled mountains were dim; when she came, clouds rested on her gown.
baihua_lines: 弹起哀怨的筝，奏一曲《湘江曲》，一声声写尽了湘波的碧绿。纤细的手指拨动十三根琴弦，将幽幽的幽怨细细传递。筵席上她的眼波如秋水般
缓缓流转，筝上的玉柱斜排，如一行飞雁。弹到最伤心之处，她那如春山般的黛眉低低垂下。
醉后马鞭低垂——罗裙上绣着双飞的蝴蝶，在东池的宴席上初次相见。胭脂和铅粉敷得并不浓重，像闲雅的花朵带着淡淡的春意。仔细
端详，她处处都美好，人人都称赞她那柔如柳枝的腰肢。昨日黄昏时乱山昏暗，她来时衣上仿佛带着山间的云气。

title: 一丛花
author: 张先
body: 伤高怀远几时穷？
无物似情浓。
离愁正引千丝乱，更东陌，飞絮蒙蒙。
嘶骑渐遥，征尘不断，何处认郎踪？
双鸳池沼水溶溶，南北小桡通。
梯横画阁黄昏后，又还是，斜月帘栊。
沉恨细思，不如桃杏，犹解嫁东风。
note:
【一丛花】词牌名，又名「一丛花令」，双调七十八字，平韵。
【伤高怀远】登高望远，思念远方的人。
【千丝乱】千万条柳丝缭乱，双关「千思」。
【东陌】东边的田间小路，指送别之地。
【嘶骑（jì）】嘶叫的马；骑，一人一马为骑。
【征尘】旅途上的尘土。
【双鸳】成双的鸳鸯，象征爱侣。
【小桡（ráo）】小船桨，代指小船。
【梯横画阁】梯子横搁在画楼旁，暗示情人已去，不复再登。
【帘栊】窗帘和窗牖。
【嫁东风】化用李贺《南园》「可怜日暮嫣香落，嫁与春风不用媒」句意，谓桃杏犹能嫁东风，而人反不如花。
en_body: Gazing from heights, longing for the distant one—when shall this end? Nothing is as deep as love. The grief of parting sets a thousand willow threads in disarray, and on the eastern paths catkins drift in misty haze. Neighing
horses fade into the distance, dust of the road unceasing—where shall I trace my beloved's tracks?

A pair of mandarin ducks, the pond waters flowing smooth; small boats ply between north and south. Ladder laid aside, the painted pavilion at dusk, and once again, slanting moonlight upon the curtain. In deepest
grief I think: even peach and apricot blooms, I suppose, know to wed the east wind.
baihua_lines: 登高怀远，心中愁绪几时才能穷尽？没有什么东西比情意更浓厚了。离别的愁绪正引得千条柳丝纷乱，更兼东边的大路上，柳絮飞落迷蒙一片。嘶鸣的
坐骑渐渐远去，旅途的尘土飞个不停，我又到哪里去辨认心上人的踪迹呢？
池塘里鸳鸯成对，水溶溶地流淌着，南北两岸之间有小船往来相通。梯子横斜地靠在画阁旁，黄昏之后，依旧是斜月映照着窗帘。怀着深深的愁
恨仔细思量，自己还不如那桃花杏花，它们尚且懂得嫁给东风、获得归宿。

坐骑渐渐远去，旅途的尘土飞个不停，我又到哪里去辨认心上人的踪迹呢？
池塘里鸳鸯成对，水溶溶地流淌着，南北两岸之间有小船往来相通。梯子横斜地靠在画阁旁，黄昏之后，依旧是斜月映照着窗帘。怀着深深的愁
恨仔细思量，自己还不如那桃花杏花，它们尚且懂得嫁给东风、获得归宿。
appr: 张先，宋人。这首古体诗《一丛花》即事抒怀，寄托身世之感。起句「伤高怀远几时穷？」即景即事，情随境生；至「沉恨细思，不如桃杏，犹解嫁东风。」情思愈转愈深，篇中月、风、东风、水诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇7句，铺叙从容、开合有度，语淡而情深，读之令人怅然。

title: 天仙子
author: 张先
subtitle: 时为嘉禾小倅以病眠不赴府会
body: 水调数声持酒听，午醉醒来愁未醒。
送春春去几时回？
临晚镜，伤流景，往事后期空记省。
沙上并禽池上暝，云破月来花弄影。
重重帘幕密遮灯，风不定，人初静，明月落红应满径。
en_title: Tune: Tianxianzi (Song of the Heavenly Immortal)
en_body: I hold my wine and listen to a few strains of the Water Tune; noon-drunk I wake, yet sorrow remains unawakened. Seeing spring off—when will spring return? Facing the evening mirror, grieved by passing years,
past affairs and future hopes are but empty memories.

On the sand, paired birds rest as the pond grows dim; through breaking clouds the moon appears, and flowers play with shadows. Layer on layer of curtains, tightly drawn to shield the lamp; wind unsteady, people first falling still—
beneath the bright moon, fallen blooms must now fill the path.
baihua_lines: 端着酒杯听了几遍《水调》曲，午后从醉中醒来，愁却未醒。送别春天，春去了几时才回？傍晚对镜自照，感伤年华如水般流逝，
往日的事、后会的期约，都只是空自留在记忆里。
沙滩上水鸟双栖，池上暮色渐浓；云开月出，花影在风中摇曳。重重帘幕密密遮住灯光，风势不定，人声初静，
明天的月光下，落红该是铺满了小径吧。

Waters and wine awaken my longing of youth's bright days.

Sand rise before me, across the plain.
Heavy rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 青门引
author: 张先
body: 乍暖还轻冷，风雨晚来方定。
庭轩寂寞近清明，残花中酒，又是去年病。
楼头画角风吹醒，入夜重门静。
那堪更被明月，隔墙送过秋千影。
en_body: After sudden warmth, a light chill returns; wind and rain only cease as evening falls. Lonely in the courtyard near the Clear Bright Festival, with leftover blossoms I sit and drink, once more the same illness as last year.
From the tower a painted horn wakes me with the wind; as night falls, double gates grow still. How can I bear that the bright moon once more, over the wall, sends over the shadow of the swing?
baihua_lines: 天气刚转暖，还带着轻微的寒意，一天风雨到了傍晚才停歇。庭院中寂寞冷清，将近清明时节，对着残花喝醉了酒，又犯了和去年一样的病。
城楼上画角声声，被风吹醒我的醉意；入夜之后，重门寂静。哪堪忍受那轮明月，又隔着墙，把秋千的影子送了过来？

title: 浣溪沙
author: 晏殊
body: 一曲新词酒一杯，去年天气旧池台，夕阳西下几时回？
无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来，小园香径独徘徊。
en_body: A new verse to a single tune, a cup of wine; last year's weather, the old pavilion terrace. The sun sets in the west—when shall it return?
Flowers fall all too helplessly; swallows return, seeming familiar. Along the fragrant path in the little garden, alone I linger.
baihua_lines: 听一曲新词，饮一杯美酒，依旧是去年的天气，依旧是旧时的亭台，而西下的夕阳什么时候才能再回来？
春花凋落，我终究无法挽留；燕子归来，似是去年旧识。在小园的落花飘香的小路上，我独自徘徊、久久不去。

title: 浣溪沙
author: 晏殊
body: 一向年光有限身，等闲离别易消魂，酒筵歌席莫辞频。
满目山河空念远，落花风雨更伤春，不如怜取眼前人。
en_body: A moment of youthful light, a body all too finite; partings of the ordinary sort easily break the soul. At wine feasts and song banquets, do not decline the frequent cup.
Before my eyes, mountains and rivers stretch empty in longing for the distant; falling blooms and wind and rain but wound spring further. Better to cherish the one before your eyes.
baihua_lines: 片刻的青春年华，有限的人生；寻常的离别，就足以让人黯然销魂。酒宴歌席之上，且莫推辞频频举杯。
放眼望去，山河空阔，思念远方之人也是徒然；落花风雨更让人感伤春天的逝去，倒不如好好珍惜眼前的人吧。

title: 清乐平
author: 晏殊
body: 红笺小字，说尽平生意。
鸿雁在云鱼在水，惆怅此情难寄。
斜阳独倚西楼，遥山恰对帘钩。
人面不知何处，绿波依旧东流。
note:
【清平乐】词牌名，又名「清平乐令」，双调四十六字，上片仄韵，下片平韵。
【红笺】红色的精美信纸，唐代蜀笺有名，即薛涛笺，多用来题诗写信。
【鸿雁在云鱼在水】古人有「鸿雁传书」「鱼传尺素」之说，此处雁在云中、鱼在水中，皆无法代为传信。
【鸿雁传书】出《汉书·苏武传》，汉使诈称天子射雁得书，苏武乃得归汉。
【鱼传尺素】古乐府《饮马长城窟行》「客从远方来，遗我双鲤鱼。呼儿烹鲤鱼，中有尺素书」。
【人面不知何处】化用崔护《题都城南庄》「人面不知何处去，桃花依旧笑春风」。
en_body: Small words on red letter paper tell all the longings of a lifetime. Wild geese rest in the clouds, fish in the waters—heavy-hearted, this love is hard to send.
In the slanting sun I lean alone on the western tower; distant mountains meet precisely the curtain hook. The beloved's face is gone, none knows where; green waves still flow east as ever.
baihua_lines: 精美的红笺上写满了小字，诉说着平生的相思情意。可鸿雁高飞云端，游鱼深潜水底，这份惆怅的情意终究难以寄达。
夕阳西下，我独自倚着西楼，远山恰好正对着帘钩。相思之人不知在何处，只有碧绿的波浪依旧向东流去。

title: 清乐平
author: 晏殊
body: 金风细细，叶叶梧桐坠。
绿酒初尝人易醉，一枕小窗浓睡。
紫薇朱槿花残，斜阳却照阑干。
双燕欲归时节，银屏昨夜微寒。
note:
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Golden winds blow fine and thin; leaf by leaf parasol leaves fall. Tasting green wine for the first time, one grows easily drunk; by the small window with a pillow I sink into deep sleep.
Crape myrtle and rose-of-sharon blooms fade; slanting sunlight rests upon the railings. A pair of swallows, the season for returning; by the silver screen, last night was faintly cold.
baihua_lines: 秋风轻轻地吹，梧桐叶一片片飘落。初尝绿酒，人很容易喝醉，枕在枕上靠着小窗沉沉睡去。
紫薇花和朱槿花都已凋残，斜阳正照在栏杆上。双燕将要南飞的时节，昨夜在银屏之内，已微微感到一丝寒意。

title: 木兰花
author: 晏殊
body: 燕鸿过后莺归去，细算浮生千万绪。
长于春梦几多时，散似秋云无觅处。
闻琴解佩神仙侣，挽断罗衣留不住。
劝君莫作独醒人，烂醉花间应有数。
en_body: After swallows and geese have passed, orioles depart as well; counting the thousand threads of this floating life, all is tangled. Longer than a spring dream—how much more time? Scattered like autumn clouds, no trace to be found.

One who hears the zither, one who unfastens the pendant—immortal companions; though I snap the silken gown, I cannot hold them back. I urge you, be not the sole sober man; drunk among the flowers should be one's lot.
baihua_lines: 燕鸿过境之后，黄莺也归去了；细想这飘浮不定的人生，愁绪千头万绪。春梦般的美好时光能有多久？一朝离散便如秋云无踪可寻。
无论是听琴心许的卓文君，还是解佩相赠的江妃，那般神仙美眷，我即便是挽断罗衣也留不住。劝你不要做那独自清醒的人，烂醉于花间大抵是命中注定的吧。

title: 木兰花
author: 晏殊
body: 池塘水绿风微暖，记得玉真初见面。
重头歌韵响琤琮，入破舞腰红乱旋。
玉钩栏下香阶畔，醉后不知斜日晚。
当时共我赏花人，点检如今无一半。
en_body: The pond waters are green, the breeze faintly warm; I remember when first I met the Jade Immortal. Repeated strains of song echo clear and tinkling; at the dance's break, red-sashed waists spin in wild rotations.
Beneath the jade-railed steps by the fragrant courtyard, after drunkenness I knew not that the slanting sun was late. Those who once enjoyed the flowers with me—counting now, less than half remain.
baihua_lines: 池塘里碧波荡漾，风儿微带暖意，还记得初次遇见那位如玉佳人的情景。一曲重头歌唱得音韵清脆动听，入破的舞乐响起，穿着红衣的舞腰急促旋转。
在玉栏下香阶旁，醉后浑然不觉夕阳已经晚了。当年和我一起赏花的人，如今细数，竟已不到一半。

title: 木兰花
author: 晏殊
body: 绿杨芳草长亭路，年少抛人容易去。
楼头残梦五更钟，花底离愁三月雨。
无情不似多情苦，一寸还成千万缕。
天涯地角有穷时，只有相思无尽处。
en_body: Green willows, fragrant grass, the road to the Pavilion of Parting; in youth the beloved slips away all too easily. At the tower's head, broken dreams under the fifth-watch bell; at the flower's base, parting sorrows in third-month rain.

The heartless do not know the bitter pangs of the loving; one inch of sorrow yet weaves into a thousand threads. Earth's ends and heaven's corners have their bounds; only longing stretches on, with no end.
baihua_lines: 绿杨依依，芳草萋萋，长亭路上正是送别之处；青春年少的时光，总是那样轻易地抛下人离去。楼头传来五更钟声，惊破了残梦；花底下三月的春雨，更添离别的愁绪。
无情之人不像多情之人那样愁苦，一寸芳心竟化作千万缕情丝。天涯海角总有尽头，只有相思之情是无穷无尽的。

title: 踏莎行
author: 晏殊
body: 祖席离歌，长亭别宴，香尘已隔犹回面。
居人匹马映林嘶，行人去棹依波转。
画阁魂消，高楼目断，斜阳只送平波远。
无穷无尽是离愁，天涯地角寻思遍。
en_body: A farewell song at the parting feast, a banquet of separation at the Long Pavilion; though fragrant dust divides us, still we turn to look back. The lone horse of the stay-at-home neighs against the woods; the traveler's oar turns away with the waves.

In the painted pavilion the soul melts away; from the high tower the gaze breaks; the setting sun only escorts the level waves afar. Boundless, unending is the grief of parting; to earth's ends and heaven's corners my longing searches everywhere.
baihua_lines: 在饯别的宴席上唱着离歌，长亭下设了送别的酒宴，虽然香尘已将我们隔开，还是忍不住频频回望。送别的人马儿对着树林嘶鸣，远行人的船已随波渐远。
画阁之上我黯然销魂，高楼上望断双眼，斜阳只护送着平波流向远方。无穷无尽的是离愁别恨，我的思绪寻遍了天涯海角。

title: 踏莎行
author: 晏殊
body: 小径红稀，芳郊绿遍，高台树色阴阴见。
春风不解禁杨花，蒙蒙乱扑行人面。
翠叶藏莺，朱帘隔燕，炉香静逐游丝转。
一场愁梦酒醒时，斜阳却照深深院。
en_body: On the small path red blooms grow thin; the fragrant meadows are filled with green. From the high terrace tree shades are dimly seen. The spring wind, unknowing how to willow catkins refrain, sends them in misty flurries to beat against the traveler's face.

Kingfisher leaves hide orioles; pearl curtains screen out swallows. Incense from the burner quietly chases the drifting gossamer threads. After a sorrowful dream, when the wine fades, the slanting sun shines upon the deep, deep courtyard.
baihua_lines: 小路旁的红花已经稀疏，郊野上已处处是碧绿的草色。高台上望去，树色郁郁葱葱、隐约可见。春风不懂得管束柳絮，任它蒙蒙乱乱地扑打到行人脸上。
翠绿的叶丛中藏着黄莺，朱红的帘幕外隔着春燕。香炉里的轻烟静静追逐着飘荡的游丝流转。一场愁梦醒来，酒意已消，斜阳正照着深深的庭院。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 晏殊
body: 六曲阑干偎碧树,杨柳风轻,展尽黄金缕。
谁把钿筝移玉柱，穿帘海燕双飞去。
满眼游丝兼落絮,红杏开时,一霎清明雨。
浓睡觉来莺乱语，惊残好梦无寻处。
note:
【蝶恋花】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Six-bended railings curl around emerald trees; willow catkins light in the wind, unfurling golden threads full. Who draws the inlaid zither to move the jade pegs? Swallows from the sea fly in pairs through the curtains.

All eyes are on drifting gossamer and falling catkins; when red apricots bloom comes a sudden Clear Bright rain. Waking from heavy sleep, orioles chatter wildly, shattering my sweet dream—nowhere to be found.
baihua_lines: 曲折的栏杆紧挨着碧绿的树木，杨柳在春风中轻盈摇曳，舒展着千万条金丝般的柔枝。是谁在拨弄镶嵌精美的筝、移动玉制的弦柱？穿帘的海燕双双飞去。
满眼是游丝飘转、柳絮飞落，红杏花开时节，下了一阵清明节的骤雨。浓睡醒来，只听得黄莺乱啼，把我的好梦惊得支离破碎，再无觅处。

title: 凤箫吟
author: 韩缜
body: 锁离愁连绵无际，来时陌上初熏，绣帏人念远，暗垂珠露，泣送征轮。
长行长在眼，更重重、远水孤云。
但望极楼高，尽日目断王孙。
消魂池塘别后，曾行处、绿妒轻裙。
恁时携素手,乱花飞絮里,缓步香茵。
朱颜自改，向年年、芳意长新。
遍绿野、嬉游醉眼，莫负青春。
en_title: Tune: Fengxiaoyin (Song of the Phoenix Flute)
en_body: Locked in parting sorrow, stretching boundless, when we came the paths were freshly scented. She in the embroidered curtain, thinking of the far traveler, lets pearl tears fall in secret, weeping to see the traveling wheels depart. Long the road stretches before the eyes, yet more and more, distant waters, lonely clouds.
But when I gaze from the highest tower, all day my eyes strain to follow the noble traveler.

Soul-wrenched since our parting by the pond, where once we walked the green grass envies her light skirt. That time, holding her white hand, amid fallen blooms and flying catkins we strolled the fragrant lawns.
Her fair face will change with time, yet year by year the spring's intention grows ever new. Across the green fields, in playful wanderings and drunken gaze, do not squander your youth.
baihua_lines: 连绵无际的离愁，紧紧锁在心头；来时郊野的道路上，春草正散发着初香。闺帷中的她思念着远方的我，暗暗垂下泪珠，哭泣着目送我的车轮远去。长路漫漫总在眼前，更有一重又一重的远水孤云。
只能登楼极目远眺，终日远望那远行人的方向。
自从池塘边分别之后，黯然销魂；我们曾经走过的地方，绿草都要嫉妒她那轻盈的罗裙。那时我挽着她洁白的手，在乱花飞絮之中，漫步于芬芳如茵的草地上。
青春的容颜自然会衰老，可年年春草却总是新鲜茂盛。走遍绿野，尽情嬉游，醉眼赏春，切莫辜负了大好青春。

青春的容颜自然会衰老，可年年春草却总是新鲜茂盛。走遍绿野，尽情嬉游，醉眼赏春，切莫辜负了大好青春。

title: 木兰花
author: 宋祁
body: 东城渐觉风光好，彀皱波纹迎客棹。
绿杨烟外晓云轻，红杏枝头春意闹。
浮生长恨欢娱少，肯爱千金轻一笑？
为君持酒劝斜阳，且向花间留晚照。
en_body: East of the city, I gradually feel the scenery grows fair; rippled waves like pressed gauze welcome the traveler's oar. Beyond the mist of green willows morning clouds drift light; on red apricot branches spring's mood runs riot.

In this floating life I oft lament that joy comes all too seldom—how begrudge a thousand gold for one light laugh? For you I hold the wine and urge the setting sun: linger a while among the flowers, cast your evening glow.
baihua_lines: 城东渐渐感觉风光越来越美好，绉纱般的微波迎接着游船。绿杨如烟的柳林外，晓云轻轻飘；红杏枝头，春意正热闹得欢。
漂泊的人生总遗憾欢乐太少，怎会因吝惜千金而轻视那美人的一笑？让我为你举杯劝斜阳：且在花丛间多留一会儿，把晚霞的余晖洒下吧。

title: 采桑子
author: 欧阳修
body: 群芳过后西湖好，狼籍残红，飞絮蒙蒙，垂柳阑干尽日风。
笙歌散尽游人去，始觉春空，垂下帘栊，双燕归来细雨中。
note:
【采桑子】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: After all the blooms have faded West Lake is still fair: scattered fallen reds, flying willow catkins in mist, drooping willows by the railing, all day long the wind.
When song and flute have dispersed and visitors departed, I begin to feel spring's emptiness. Down I let the curtain fall; a pair of swallows returns through the fine rain.
baihua_lines: 百花凋谢之后，西湖依旧美丽：残花散乱飘落，飞絮濛濛一片，垂柳拂着栏杆，整天风儿轻吹。
笙箫歌声都散去，游人们也走了，才觉得春意阑珊、一片空寂。刚刚放下窗帘，就看见一对燕子在细雨中归来。

title: 诉衷情
author: 欧阳修
body: 清晨帘幕卷轻霜，呵手试梅妆。
都缘自有离恨，故画作远山长。
思往事，惜流芳，易成伤。
拟歌先敛，欲笑还颦，最断人肠。
en_body: In early morning I roll up the curtain, light frost upon it; blowing on my hands, I try the plum-blossom makeup. All because there lies a grief of parting within, I paint my brows long like distant mountains.
Recalling past events, cherishing fleeting years, one easily falls to sorrow. About to sing, I first frown; about to smile, I knit my brows anew—this most breaks the heart.
baihua_lines: 清晨卷起帘幕，帘上带着薄薄的霜；我呵暖双手，试着画那梅花妆。只因为心中满是离别的愁恨，所以特意把双眉画成远山一般修长。
回念往事，痛惜流逝的芳年，最容易令人感伤。想唱歌却先皱起眉头，想笑却又蹙起了双眉，这光景最令人心碎。

title: 踏莎行
author: 欧阳修
body: 候馆梅残，溪桥柳细，草薰风暖摇征辔。
离愁渐远渐无穷，迢迢不断如春水。
寸寸柔肠，盈盈粉泪，楼高莫近危阑倚。
平芜尽处是春山，行人更在春山外。
en_body: At the courier lodge plums fade by; by the bridge over the brook willows slender; grass-scented warmth in the wind sways the traveler's reins. The grief of parting grows farther, grows more endless—stretching on and on like spring waters.

Inch by inch the tender heart breaks; tear on tear the powdery cheeks are wet. In the high tower lean not against the perilous rail. Where the flat meadow ends are spring hills; the traveler is yet beyond those spring hills.
baihua_lines: 旅舍旁的梅花已经凋谢，溪桥边的柳树纤细柔长；暖风送来草的清香，吹动着远行游子的马缰。离愁渐行渐远渐无穷，就像那迢迢不断的春水一样。
柔肠寸断，粉泪盈盈挂满了面颊。高楼之上切莫去倚那高高的栏杆。平旷的草地尽头是春山，而远行的人，更在那春山之外。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 欧阳修
body: 庭院深深深几许？
杨柳堆烟,帘幕无重数。
玉勒雕鞍游冶处,楼高不见章台路。
雨横风狂三月暮，门掩黄昏,无计留春住。
泪眼问花花不语,乱红飞过秋千去。
en_body: The courtyard is deep, deep—how deep it is! Willows pile up mist, curtains and screens beyond number. Where the jade-bit and carved saddle roam in pleasure, from the high tower I cannot see the Zhangtai Road.

Rain rages, wind is wild in the third month's dusk; the door is shut on twilight, no way to keep spring home. Tear-filled I ask the flowers, but the flowers answer not; in wild confusion red petals fly past the swing.
baihua_lines: 庭院深深，到底有多深？杨柳笼罩在烟雾中，帘幕不知有多少重。乘着华丽车马在外寻欢作乐的人，他去了哪里？我在高楼上望不到那条章台路。
暮春三月的傍晚，风狂雨骤；黄昏时分掩上门户，却没有办法把春天留住。含泪问花儿花儿不回答，纷乱的落花飞过秋千去了。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 欧阳修
body: 谁道闲情抛弃久？
每到春来,惆怅还依旧。
日日花前常病酒,不辞镜里朱颜瘦。
河畔青芜堤上柳，为问新愁,何事年年有？
独立小桥风满袖,平林新月人归后。
en_body: Who says idle grief has long been cast aside? Each time spring comes the melancholy returns as before. Day after day before the flowers, often sick with wine, I do not shrink from seeing in the mirror my fair face grow thin.

By the riverbank green meadows, willows on the dyke—I ask, this new sorrow, for what does it arise year after year? I stand alone on the small bridge, wind filling my sleeves; beyond the level woods the new moon rises as people head home.
baihua_lines: 谁说闲愁已经被抛却很久了？每到春天来临，惆怅之情还和过去一样。天天在花前饮酒，常常大醉，也不顾镜中红润的容颜日益消瘦。
河畔青草丛生，堤上柳树成行，我要问：这新添的愁绪，为什么年年都有？独自站在小桥上，清风吹满衣袖，平林之上新月初升，路上的行人都已归去。

lines: 谁道闲情抛弃久？
每到春来,惆怅还依旧。
日日花前常病酒,不辞镜里朱颜瘦。
河畔青芜堤上柳，为问新愁,何事年年有？
独立小桥风满袖,平林新月人归后。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 欧阳修
body: 几日行云何处去？
忘了归来,不道春将暮。
百草千花寒食路,香车系在谁家树？
泪眼倚楼频独语。
双燕来时,陌上相逢否？
撩乱春愁如柳絮,依依梦里无寻处。
en_body: These few days, where have the drifting clouds gone? Forgetting to return, knowing not that spring draws to its close. Amid a hundred herbs, a thousand flowers, the Cold Food road; to whose tree is the fragrant carriage tied?

Tear-filled, I lean upon the tower and often speak to myself. When the paired swallows come, have you met on the paths afar? Tangled spring sorrows like willow catkins—longing in dreams, nowhere to be found.
baihua_lines: 这几日飘浮的行云到哪里去了？竟忘了归来，不知道春天就要过去了。在那百草千花盛开的寒食路上，你的香车究竟系在谁家的树上？
满含眼泪独倚高楼，频频自言自语。双燕飞来的时候，你们可曾在途中相遇？撩乱的春愁就像那漫天的柳絮，即使在依依的梦中也找不到他的去处。

title: 木兰花
author: 欧阳修
body: 别后不知君远近，触目凄凉多少闷！
渐行渐远渐无书，水阔鱼沉何处问？
夜深风竹敲秋韵，万叶千声皆是恨。
故攲单枕梦中寻，梦又不成灯双烬。
en_body: Since parting I know not whether you are near or far; wherever I look, all is desolate, and how great the gloom! Slowly you walk farther off, slowly letters cease; waters wide, fish sunk deep—where may I ask for news?

Deep at night, wind in the bamboo strikes the autumn rhythm; ten thousand leaves, a thousand sounds—all are hate. So I lean upon the single pillow to seek in dreams, but dreams will not come, and the lamp burns out its twin wicks.
baihua_lines: 自从分别之后，便不知你是远是近；映入眼帘的都是凄凉景象，心中有说不尽的愁闷！你越走越远，渐渐连书信也断了；水势辽远，鱼儿沉底，我又到哪里去打听你的消息？
夜深人静，风吹竹叶敲出秋声；万叶千声，声声都饱含着离恨。因此我斜倚孤枕想在梦中寻你，可终究难成眠，连油灯的双芯也燃成灰烬。

title: 浪淘沙
author: 欧阳修
body: 把酒祝东风，且共从容。
垂杨紫陌洛城东，总是当时携手处，游遍芳丝。
聚散苦匆匆，此恨无穷。
今年花胜去年红，可惜明年花更好，知与谁同？
en_body: Raising my cup, I toast the east wind: let us tarry yet a while. Purple willows along the purple lanes east of Luoyang—all were places where once we walked hand in hand, wandering through every fragrant lane.
Meeting and parting are bitter in their haste; this grief is endless. This year's flowers outshine last year's red. Alas, next year the flowers will be finer still—who will share them with me?
baihua_lines: 我端起酒杯向东风祈祷：请你暂且放慢脚步、多留些时光。洛阳城东紫陌路上垂杨飘拂，当年我们携手同游的地方，游遍了每一处芳花丛。
可叹欢聚离散都太过匆匆，这遗恨无穷无尽。今年的花比去年开得更红。可惜明年花会更好，不知那时我又与谁一同观赏呢？

Of wine and the wind, in woods deep.
Poplars rise before me, in the breeze.
With gathers, with tear-filled eyes.
Through now and the year, in woods deep.

title: 青玉案
author: 欧阳修
body: 一年春事都来几？
早过了、三之二。
绿暗红嫣浑可事。
绿杨庭院，暖风帘幕，有个人憔悴。
买花载酒长安市，又争似，家山见桃李？
不枉东风吹客泪，相思难表，梦魂无据，惟有归来是。
note:
【青玉案】词牌名。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: A year of spring affairs—how many have passed? Already gone two-thirds of the way. Green dark, red charming—all in perfect ease. Green willow courtyard, warm wind by curtain,
there is one whose face grows pale and worn.

Buying flowers and bearing wine in the Chang'an market—how can it compare with seeing peach and plum at my homeland hills? In vain the east wind blows the traveler's tears; longing too hard to tell, dreams
and souls untrustworthy—only returning home is true.
baihua_lines: 一年春事，算来已过去了几分？早过了三分之二。绿意浓浓，红花娇美，一切看上去都安好。绿杨成荫的庭院里，暖风吹拂着帘幕，
有一个人儿却已憔悴消瘦。
在长安城里买花载酒、追欢买笑，又怎比得上在家乡的山野看那桃花李花呢？难怪东风要吹落游子的眼泪；相思之情难以表达，梦
境终究虚幻无凭，只有回到故乡才是真正的归宿。

在长安城里买花载酒、追欢买笑，又怎比得上在家乡的山野看那桃花李花呢？难怪东风要吹落游子的眼泪；相思之情难以表达，梦
境终究虚幻无凭，只有回到故乡才是真正的归宿。

title: 曲玉管
author: 柳永
body: 陇首云飞，江边日晚，烟波满目凭阑久。
一望关河萧索，千里清秋，忍凝眸。
杳杳神京，盈盈仙子，别来锦字终难偶。
断雁无凭，冉冉飞下汀洲、思悠悠。
暗想当初，有多少、幽欢佳会；岂知聚散难期，翻成雨恨云愁。
阻追游，每登山临水，惹起平生心事，一场消黯，永日无言，却下层楼。
en_body: Clouds fly from the mountain ridge; by the river sun grows late; misty waves fill the eyes as I lean long upon the rail. At one glance, the passes and rivers stretch desolate, a thousand li of clear autumn—I cannot bear to gaze

steadily. Far, far the divine capital; fair, fair the immortal maid; since parting, letters of brocade have been hard to match. The broken wild goose has no proof, floating slowly down to the sandbar, thoughts stretching
endlessly.

In secret I recall the beginning: how many secret trysts, joyous meetings! Who knew that meeting and parting are so hard to promise, turning instead to rain-grief and cloud-sorrow? Blocked are our wanderings;
each time I climb a hill or waterside I stir up life-long memories: a spell of soul-wrenched gloom, the whole day without speech, as I descend the tower.
baihua_lines: 山头云飞，江边日晚，烟波满目，我久久地倚靠着栏杆。一眼望去，关河萧条冷落，千里清秋，我实在不忍凝
眸远望。遥远渺渺的神京，那位体态轻盈的仙女，自别后音书断绝难以相逢。孤雁无法传书，它缓缓地飞落沙洲，我的思绪悠
悠无尽。
回想当初，我们曾有过多少幽欢佳会，怎知聚散难料，反而变成了雨恨云愁。山水阻隔，不能相伴同游；
每当我登山临水，总会勾起平生心事，只落得一场黯然销魂，终日默默无言，怅然走下高楼。

title: 雨霖铃
author: 柳永
body: 寒蝉凄切，对长亭晚，骤雨初歇。
都门帐饮无绪，留恋处、兰舟催发。
执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎。
念去去、千里烟波，暮霭沉沉楚天阔。
多情自古伤离别，更那堪、冷落清秋节！
今宵酒醒何处？
杨柳岸、晓风残月。
此去经年，应是良辰好景虚设。
便纵有千种风情，更与何人说？
note:
【雨霖铃】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【霭】云气。
en_body: Autumn cicadas chirp mournfully; facing the Long Pavilion at dusk, a sudden shower has just ceased. At the city gate we drink a parting tent-wine with no heart for it; lingering, the orchid boat urges departure. Holding

hands we gaze into each other's tearful eyes, at last without words, choked with sobs. Thinking of going on and on, a thousand li of misty waves, the evening haze hanging heavy over the southern sky so vast.

Since ancient times the tender-hearted have grieved at parting; how much harder still, this cold, deserted autumn festival! Where shall I wake from wine tonight? By the willow bank, the dawn breeze and the fading
moon. This parting may last for years, and all fine moments, lovely scenes shall be but empty things. Even if I have a thousand kinds of tender feelings, to whom shall I speak of them again?
baihua_lines: 秋后的蝉鸣声凄凉悲切，面对着长亭，正是傍晚时分，一阵骤雨刚刚停歇。在京城门外设帐饯别，我却毫无畅饮的心绪；正在依依不舍之时，船上的人已催促着要出发。握
着手互相凝望，满眼泪花，终究无言相对，千言万语都哽咽在喉间。想到这一去，千里烟波，那夜雾沉沉的楚地天空竟是一望无际。
自古以来多情之人最伤心的就是离别，更何况又逢这冷落凄凉的深秋时节！今夜我酒醒之后会身在何处？怕只怕是在杨柳岸边，
面对着凄凉的晓风与天边的残月。这一去年复一年，就算遇到美好的时辰、美丽的风景，也不过形同虚设。就算心中有千种深情蜜意，又能向谁去诉说呢？

Departs and a thousand, upon the stream.

Where shall I be when I wake from wine tonight?
By the willow bank, the morning breeze and a waning moon.
Of this and departs, in autumn haze.
There is and a thousand fill the view in the breeze.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 柳永
body: 伫倚危楼风细细，望极春愁，黯黯生天际。
草色烟光残照里，无言谁会凭阑意？
拟把疏狂图一醉，对酒当歌，强乐还无味。
衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴。
note:
【蝶恋花】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: I lean long against the high tower, the breeze fine and thin; gazing as far as spring sorrow may reach, darkly it rises at the edge of heaven. In grass-colored mist and the glow of the setting sun, in silence, who understands
my intent as I lean upon the rail?
I long to drown my sorrows in wild and reckless drinking; facing wine, facing song, forced mirth yet lacks all savor. My sash grows slowly loose, yet I do not regret—for her I pine, until I grow
haggard and worn.
baihua_lines: 久久地倚立在高楼上，微风细细，望不尽的春日离愁，从天边黯然升起。草色烟光中，夕阳残照里，默默无言，谁又能理解我
凭栏远望的心意？
真想放纵疏狂一醉方休，可是举杯高歌，勉强欢笑终究觉得索然无味。衣带渐渐宽松，我却始终不后悔——为了她，我情愿
一身憔悴。

title: 采莲令
author: 柳永
body: 月华收,云淡霜天曙。
西征客、此时情苦。
翠娥手,送临歧、轧轧开朱户。
千娇面、盈盈伫立,无言有泪,断肠争忍回顾？
一叶兰舟,便凭急桨凌波去。
贪行色、岂知离绪,万般方寸，但饮恨、脉脉同谁语？
更回首、重城不见，寒江天外，隐隐两三烟树。
note:
【采莲令】词牌名，双调九十一字，仄韵，为柳永所创。
【月华收】月光收敛，指月亮西沉、天将破晓。
【霜天曙】秋霜满天的天空露出曙光。
【西征客】向西远行的人。
【翠娥】即翠蛾，美人之眉修长如蚕蛾，代指美女。
【临歧】到了岔路口，即分别之处。
【轧轧（yà yà）】拟声词，形容开门声。
【朱户】朱红大门。
【千娇面】千娇百媚的脸庞。
【盈盈伫立】体态美好地久久站立。
【争忍】怎忍。
【一叶兰舟】一叶小舟。
【凌波】凌驾波浪。
【行色】出行的神态。
【方寸】指心，因心为方寸之地。
【脉脉】含情相视、无言而深情的样子。
【重城】高城、重重城郭。
en_body: Moonlight fades; clouds pale; the frosty sky nears dawn. The westward traveler—bitter the feelings at this hour. Fair lady's hand sees me to the crossroads; creaking open the crimson gate.
A thousand charming faces, standing graceful in tears; without words, tears falling—how, heart-broken, could I bear to look back?

A single leaf of orchid boat thereupon by swift oars goes gliding over the waves. Greedy for the road, how shall I know the grief of parting—ten thousand feelings in the breast, only drinking down regret; in silent yearning,
to whom may I speak? Again I turn my head: the city walls are gone, beyond the cold river and sky, dimly two or three mist-shrouded trees.
baihua_lines: 月光已经收敛，云彩淡淡，霜天渐露曙光。即将西行的游子，此刻的心情何等凄苦。美人牵着我的手送到岔路口，轧轧地打开了朱门。
那千娇百媚的人儿，盈盈地伫立着，一句话也说不出，只有默默流泪；我肝肠寸断，又怎忍心回头再看？
一叶小舟，便靠着急桨划开波浪而去。只顾着赶路，哪顾得离恨千头万绪，心中万般痛楚，只有暗饮长恨，情意绵绵，
又能与谁诉说？再回头望去，重重城郭已不见，在寒江天外，隐隐约约只剩两三株烟树。

title: 浪淘沙慢
author: 柳永
body: 梦觉透窗风一线,寒流灯吹息。
那堪酒醒,又闻空阶夜雨频滴。
嗟因循、久作天涯客。
负佳人、几许盟言，便忍把、从前欢会，陡顿翻成忧戚。
愁极，再三追思,洞房深处,几度饮散歌阑，香暖鸳鸯被。
岂暂时疏散，费伊心力。
殢云尤雨，有万般千种，相怜相惜。
恰到如今,天长漏永,无端自家疏隔。
知何时、却拥秦云态？
愿低帏昵枕，轻轻细说与，江乡夜夜，数寒更思忆。
en_title: Tune: Langtaosha Man (Slow Waves Sifting Sand)
en_body: Dreaming broken by a thread of wind through the window, cold currents blow the lamp out. How can I bear, roused from wine, to hear night rain drip ceaselessly on the empty steps? Lamenting my wayward lot, long
a wanderer at earth's far end. Betraying the fair one—so many vows! I have cruelly turned all our former joyous meetings, in a sudden turn, to grief and sorrow.

Sorrow at its height, I think back again and again: deep within the painted chamber, how many times we drank till songs dispersed, warm in the scented mandarin-duck quilt. Never a moment apart, I spent
her heart and strength. Cloud-sport and rain-passion in ten thousand forms—a thousand kinds of tenderness, loving and cherishing each other.

Now days stretch long, the water-clock drips forever; without reason we have grown estranged. When, oh when, shall I again hold that cloud-of-Qin grace? I long to rest, low by the curtain, pillow-near,
softly recounting to her, in every river-village night, as I count the cold watches, all my longing thoughts.
baihua_lines: 一觉醒来，一缕寒风透窗而入，寒气把灯吹灭。酒醒后哪堪忍受，又听见夜雨在空阶上滴滴答答下个不停。可叹我蹉跎漂泊，长
年作客天涯。辜负了佳人多少山盟海誓，又怎忍把从前的欢会，陡然间都化作忧伤悲戚。
愁到极点，再三追忆：洞房深处，有多少次酒散歌阑，在鸳鸯被中香暖缠绵。片刻都不曾分离，耗
费了她多少心力。那些缠绵的云雨欢爱，有着万种千般的相怜相惜。
可到如今，天长夜长，平白无故地就疏远隔绝了。不知何时才能再拥着那娇美的人儿？愿在低垂的帏帐中、亲昵的枕边，
轻轻地向她细细诉说：在这江畔异乡的每一个夜晚，我是如何数着寒夜更鼓，把她苦苦思忆。

en:
Beneath dreams and I feel, in vain I wait.
Of that and wine, in woods deep.
The world's end fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Longing for I and how many, my spirit faints.
With grief and longing in view, my grief runs deep.
Scatters and she fill the view by riverside.
The clouds and rain stretch upon the stream.
Like rise before me, so far and wide.
Of I know and what, in woods deep.
Light and thin, so far and wide.

title: 定风波
author: 柳永
body: 自春来、惨绿愁红，芳心是事可可。
日上花梢，莺穿柳带，犹压香衾卧。
暖酥消，腻云亸，终日厌厌倦梳裹。
无那。
恨薄情一去，音书无个。
早知恁么。
悔当初、不把雕鞍锁。
向鸡窗、只与蛮笺象管，拘束教吟课。
镇相随，莫抛躲。
针线闲拈伴伊坐。
和我，免使年少光阴虚过。
note:
【定风波】词牌名。
【衾】被子。
【恁】这样、如此。
en_body: Since spring came, the green is grievous, the red is mournful; the tender heart finds all things indifferent. The sun rises to the tips of the blossoms, orioles dart through willow fronds, yet still I press the fragrant quilt to lie.
My soft skin wanes, my cloudy tresses slump; all day long, wearied, I cannot bear to dress. Alas! Since the faithless one departed, no word, no letter at all.
Had I known it would be thus, I'd regret it—locked his carved saddle to keep him here. By the study window, giving him only fine paper and ivory brush, binding him to chant lessons all day long.
Always together, never to stray; with needlework I'd sit idle and keep him company. With me, he'd be spared the idle waste of youth.
baihua_lines: 自从入春以来，绿叶凄惨红花愁惨，我的芳心什么事都不上心。太阳已升到花梢，黄莺在柳丝间穿梭，我却还压着香被高卧。
润泽的肌肤消瘦了，浓密的发髻也散乱下垂，整日恹恹地懒得梳妆。无可奈何啊，自从那薄情郎离去后，连一个字的音信都没有。
早知如此，真后悔当初没有把他的雕鞍锁起来。就让他守着书窗，给他蛮纸和象牙笔管，拘束着他吟咏诵读诗书功课。
整日陪伴在他身边，寸步不离。闲时手里拈着针线伴他闲坐。有我在他身边，免得他将青春年少的光阴白白虚度。

title: 少年游
author: 柳永
body: 长安古道马迟迟，高柳乱蝉嘶。
夕阳岛外，秋风原上，目断四天垂。
归云一去无踪迹，何处是前期？
狎兴生疏，酒徒萧索，不似去年时。
戚　氏　柳永晚秋天。
一霎微雨洒庭轩。
槛菊萧疏,井梧零乱,惹残烟。
凄然。
望江关，飞云黯淡夕阳间。
当时宋玉悲感，向此临水与登山。
远道迢递,行人凄楚,倦听陇水潺湲。
正蝉吟败叶，蛩响衰草，相应喧喧。
孤馆度日如年。
风露渐变，悄悄至更阑。
长天净，绛河清浅，皓月婵娟。
思绵绵，夜永对景，那堪屈指，暗想从前。
未名未禄，绮陌红楼，往往经岁迁延。
帝里风光好,当年少日,暮宴朝欢。
况有狂朋怪侣，遇当歌、对酒竞留连。
别来迅景如梭，旧游似梦，烟水程何限。
念利名、憔悴长萦绊。
追往事、空惨愁颜。
漏箭移、稍觉轻寒。
渐呜咽画角数声残。
对闲窗畔，停灯向晓，抱影无眠。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: On the ancient road to Chang'an horses plod slowly; high willows, cicadas cry wildly. Beyond the sun-setting isle, autumn winds upon the plain, the gaze ends as four skies hang low.
Returning clouds depart without a trace; where are the promises of earlier days? Rough pleasures lose their zest, drinking companions grow few and far between—not like last year.
——以下为《戚氏》——

Late autumn sky. A sudden shower sprinkles the courtyard. Chrysanthemums by the rail sparse and bare, parasol trees by the well scattered and wild, stirring lingering smoke. Grieved, I gaze at the river and passes,
flying clouds dark and dim between the setting sun. Then Song Yu lamented, climbing waters and hills. The long road stretches far, travelers sad and weary, tired of hearing
the Long waters gurgling on. Just as cicadas hum in failing leaves, crickets chirp in withered grass, answering each other noisily.
In the lonely inn days pass like years. Wind and dew slowly turn, quietly till the watches wane. The vast sky clean, the Milky Way clear and shallow, the bright moon lovely.

Thoughts unending; facing the scene through the long night, how can I bear to count on my fingers, secretly thinking of days gone by? No name yet, no salary, on embroidered streets and red towers too often I let the years
slip by.
In the capital the scenery was fair; in the days of youth, evening feasts and morning revels. Moreover, wild friends and odd companions, when faced with song and wine vied to linger on.

Since parting, swift time flies like a shuttle; old wanderings seem like a dream, the mist-and-water journey stretches without bound. Thought of fame and gain, haggard, forever bound and tangled. Chasing past events, vainly casting
a gloomy face. As the water-clock arrow moves I feel a light chill. Faintly sobs the painted horn, a few notes fading. By the idle window, putting out the lamp as dawn approaches, I hold my shadow,
sleepless.
baihua_lines: 长安古道上马行迟缓，高高的柳树上秋蝉乱嘶。夕阳照在小岛之外，秋风掠过旷野，极目望去，四方的天幕沉沉垂下。
归云一去便杳无踪迹，从前的期约又在何处？冶游的兴致已经淡薄，酒友们也零落稀少，不再像年少时那样了。
——以下为《戚氏》——
正是晚秋天气。一阵微雨洒落在庭院里。栏杆边菊花萧疏，井边梧桐叶零乱，沾带着残烟。凄凉地遥望江河关山，
飞云黯淡漂浮在夕阳之间。当年宋玉见此景而生悲秋之感，临水登山、漂泊远方。路途遥远，游子神情凄楚，厌倦了听
陇水潺潺流淌。此时寒蝉在败叶间哀鸣，蟋蟀在衰草中啼叫，彼此喧闹应和。
在孤馆中度日如年。风露渐渐变冷，悄无声息地到了更深夜尽。长天明净，银河清浅，明月美好动人。
思绪绵绵，长夜面对着这样的景色，哪堪屈指暗想从前。未得名禄之时，在那繁华街巷和红楼楚馆，我常常年复一年地
拖延着岁月。
京都里风光正好，当我年少时，夜夜宴饮、朝朝欢乐。何况还有那些狂放的朋友，遇到当歌对酒时竞相留连。
分别之后时光如梭飞逝，旧游如梦如烟，烟水路程何等遥远。想到功名利禄，使人憔悴，长久地被牵绊。追思往事，空自
愁容惨淡。漏壶的箭标移动，渐渐感到一丝轻寒。画角几声呜咽，余音将尽。我对着寂静的窗边，熄了灯等到天晓，抱影独坐，
彻夜无眠。

长安古道上马行迟缓，高高的柳树上秋蝉乱嘶。夕阳照在小岛之外，秋风掠过旷野，极目望去，四方的天幕沉沉垂下。
归云一去便杳无踪迹，从前的期约又在何处？冶游的兴致已经淡薄，酒友们也零落稀少，不再像年少时那样了。
——以下为《戚氏》——
正是晚秋天气。一阵微雨洒落在庭院里。栏杆边菊花萧疏，井边梧桐叶零乱，沾带着残烟。凄凉地遥望江河关山，

title: 夜半乐
author: 柳永
body: 冻云黯淡天气，扁舟一叶，乘兴离江渚。
渡万壑千岩，越溪深处。
怒涛渐息，樵风乍起，更闻商旅相呼，片帆高举。
泛画鹢、翩翩过南浦。
望中洒旆闪闪，一簇烟村，数行霜树。
残日下渔人鸣榔归去。
败荷零落，衰杨掩映，岸边两两三三，浣纱游女。
避行客，含羞笑相语。
到此因念，绣阁轻抛，浪萍难驻。
叹后约、丁宁竟何据。
惨离怀、空恨岁晚归期阻。
凝泪眼、杳杳神京路。
断鸿声远长天暮。
note:
【夜半乐】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【暮】傍晚。
en_body: Frozen clouds make dark the weather; a small boat, a single leaf, on impulse I leave the river isle. Crossing ten thousand ravines, a thousand crags, deep into the Yue Stream. Angry waves slowly
subside; woodcutter winds spring up, and I hear merchants and travelers call to one another; the sail is raised aloft. Painted herons glide gracefully past the Southern Ford.

Before my eyes wine-shop banners flutter; a cluster of smoke-shrouded villages, several rows of frost-coated trees. Beneath the sinking sun fishermen, beating their wooden clappers, head home. Withered lotus scattered and fallen,
faded willows hide and reveal; along the bank, in twos and threes, girls who have washed the silk. Avoiding the traveler's gaze, they laugh and whisper shyly.

At this sight I think: too lightly I left the embroidered chamber, as a floating duckweed I find it hard to stay. I sigh—for promises made in farewell what proof do they finally hold? Grievous parting thoughts, empty regret that year's
end blocks the date of return. Eyes brimming tears, I gaze toward the far-off road to the divine capital. The lone wild goose cries afar as the vast sky grows dark.
baihua_lines: 寒云浓重，天色阴沉，我驾着一叶扁舟，乘兴驶离江中的小洲。渡过万壑千岩，进入越溪深处。怒涛渐渐
平息，山风乍然吹起，又听见商旅们相互呼唤，片帆高高扬起。船头画着鹢鸟的大船，轻快地驶过南边的浦口。
视野中酒旗闪闪，一丛烟霭缭绕的村落，几行经霜的秋树。夕阳下，渔民们敲着船榔归家去了。残荷零落，
衰杨掩映，岸边三三两两有浣纱归来的女子。她们躲避着行客的目光，含羞地笑着低语。
见到这般情景，我不禁感慨：当初轻易地抛下了闺中佳人，如今像浪中浮萍一般漂泊不定。可叹临别时反复叮咛的约期，到头来又有什么凭据？离愁凄惨，空自怅恨岁
末天寒归期被阻。我含着泪眼遥望通往神京的遥远道路，孤雁的哀鸣声渐远，长天已到了日暮时分。

lines: 冻云黯淡天气，扁舟一叶，乘兴离江渚。
渡万壑千岩，越溪深处。
怒涛渐息，樵风乍起，更闻商旅相呼，片帆高举。
泛画鹢、翩翩过南浦。
望中洒旆闪闪，一簇烟村，数行霜树。
残日下渔人鸣榔归去。
败荷零落，衰杨掩映，岸边两两三三，浣纱游女。
避行客，含羞笑相语。
到此因念，绣阁轻抛，浪萍难驻。
叹后约、丁宁竟何据。
惨离怀、空恨岁晚归期阻。
凝泪眼、杳杳神京路。
断鸿声远长天暮。

title: 玉胡蝶
author: 柳永
body: 望处雨收云断,凭栏悄悄,目送秋光。
晚景萧疏，堪动宋玉悲凉。
水风轻、蘋花渐老，月露冷、梧叶飘黄。
遗情伤。
故人何在？
烟水茫茫。
难忘。
文期洒会，几孤风月，屡变星霜。
海阔山遥，未知何处是潇湘？
念双燕、难凭远信，指暮天、空识归航。
黯相望。
断鸿声里，立尽斜阳。
en_body: Where I gaze, rain has ceased and clouds break; leaning upon the rail in silence I let my eyes escort autumn light. The evening scene is desolate, enough to stir Song Yu's grief. Water winds light,
duckweed blooms slowly fade; moon dews cold, parasol leaves drift yellow. Left alone with wounded feelings. Where is my old friend? Mists and waters stretch vast and endless.

Hard to forget. Meetings of verse, wine gatherings—how many moons have I forsaken? Stars and frosts have changed again and again. Seas are wide, mountains far; I know not where the Xiaoxiang lies. I think of

the paired swallows, too distant to trust with letters; pointing to the twilight skies, vainly I recognize the returning boats. In gloom I gaze. Amid the cry of the lone wild goose, I stand until the setting sun is spent.
baihua_lines: 举目远望，雨停云散；我默默倚着栏杆，目送着秋光消逝。晚景萧瑟，足以唤起宋玉那样的悲凉之感。水面上清风吹拂，
蘋花渐渐老去；月寒露冷，梧桐叶枯黄飘落。我黯然感伤。故友在哪里？烟水茫茫，无边无际。
往事难以忘怀。吟诗作赋的雅聚、饮酒高歌的欢会，我辜负了多少清风明月，度过了多少变幻的岁月。海阔山遥，不知友人所在的潇湘究竟在何处？想到那
双飞燕难以托付远方的书信，我只能对着黄昏天空徒然辨认着归来的航船。黯然远望，在孤雁的哀鸣声中，我一直伫立到夕阳完全落下。

title: 八声甘州
author: 柳永
body: 对潇潇暮雨洒江天，一番洗清秋。
渐霜风凄紧，关河冷落，残照当楼。
是处红衰翠减，苒苒物华休。
惟有长江水，无语东流。
不忍登高临远，望故乡渺邈，归思难收。
叹年来踪迹，何事苦淹留？
想佳人妆楼凝望，误几回天际识归舟？
争知我、倚阑干处，正恁凝愁？
note:
【八声甘州】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
【恁】这样、如此。
en_body: Facing the pattering evening rain that sweeps across river and sky, a single drench washes clear the autumn air. Gradually the frosty wind grows bitter and keen; the passes and rivers desolate, the last rays of sun light the tower. Everywhere
red fades, green withers, slowly the beauties of things pass away. Only the waters of the Long River flow east without a word.

I cannot bear to climb high and gaze into the distance; longing for home faint and far, the urge to return is hard to hold. Sighing over these years of wandering—for what have I lingered on in bitterness? I think of my beloved,
gazing from her painted chamber, mistaken again and again in the sky's edge, recognizing homeward boats. How should she know that I, here leaning upon the railing, am frozen in such grief as this?
baihua_lines: 面对着潇潇暮雨洒遍江天，一番雨过洗出了清飒的秋景。凄凉的霜风越吹越紧，关隘山河冷落萧条，落日的余晖照在楼上。处处
都是红花凋零、绿叶衰谢，美好的景物渐渐衰残殆尽。唯有长江水，默默无语地向东流去。
实在不忍心登高望远，遥望故乡渺邈难见，归家的思绪难以收束。可叹这些年来四处漂泊，为什么还要苦苦滞留异乡？想那心上人儿，
正在梳妆楼上抬头凝望，多少次错把天边驶来的船只当作我的归舟。她哪里知道，此时此刻我正倚着栏杆，这样深深地凝结着愁绪？

争知我、倚阑干处，正恁凝愁？
en:
Upon the dusk drift rain of memory, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
Beneath the frost I think of breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
Long, long the road past red blooms and jade hills, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I see long years through the veil of river, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
With lofty peaks in my heart I face the far horizons, as the west wind bears me home.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Where traveler and tower together dwell, while birds return to their evening rest.
When grief meets the breeze in the pale light, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.

title: 迷神引
author: 柳永
body: 一叶扁舟轻帆卷,暂泊楚江南岸。
孤城暮角,引胡笳怨。
水茫茫，平沙雁，旋惊散。
烟敛寒林簇，画屏展。
天际遥山小，黛眉浅。
旧赏轻抛，到此成游宦。
觉客程劳,年光晚。
异乡风物,忍萧索、当愁眼。
帝城赊，秦楼阻，旅魂乱。
芳草连空阔，残照满。
佳人无消息，断云远。
en_title: Tune: Mishenyin (Song of the Luring Spirit)
en_body: A small leaf of boat with light sail furled, moored a while on the southern bank of the Chu River. From the lone city an evening horn draws forth the lament of the Tartar flute. Waters stretch vast, on level sands the geese,
soon startled into flight. Mist gathers in cold forest clusters; a painted screen unfolds. At heaven's edge distant mountains small, like pale painted brows.

Old pleasures lightly cast aside, here I have become a traveling official. Feeling the road's fatigue, years fading into twilight. In a strange land's wind and things, I bear the desolation, before my grieving eyes.

The imperial city is far, the Qin Tower blocked; the traveler's soul in disarray. Sweet grass stretches to the vast horizon, the setting sun fills all. The fair one sends no word; broken clouds drift far.
baihua_lines: 一叶小舟卷起轻帆，暂时停泊在楚江南岸。孤城中传来暮角声，引出胡笳的哀怨。江水茫茫，平沙上落着大雁，
雁群又忽地被惊散。烟霭聚拢，寒林簇拥，如画屏般展开。天际远山显得小巧，如淡淡描画的黛眉。
往日的赏心乐事轻易抛弃，来到这里做了一个宦游之人。只觉客途劳顿，年岁已晚。异乡风物，凄凉萧索，实在让人愁苦不堪。
京城遥远，秦楼阻隔，旅思纷乱。芳草绵延至天边，残阳洒满大地。佳人杳无音信，正如断云般遥远。
