title: 竹马子
author: 柳永
body: 登孤垒荒凉，危亭旷望，静临烟渚。
对雌霓挂雨，雄风拂槛，微收残暮。
渐觉一叶惊秋，残蝉噪晚，素商时序。
览景想肖欢，指神京、非零非烟深处。
向此成追感，新愁易积，故人难聚。
凭高尽日凝伫，赢得消魂无语。
极目霁霭霏，暝鸦零乱，萧索江城暮。
南楼画角，又送残阳去。
note:
【竹马子】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【暮】傍晚。
【霭】云气。
【暝】日暮、昏暗。
【霁】雨雪停止、天色放晴。
en_body: Climbing a lone, desolate rampart, gazing from the lofty pavilion across the vastness, I stand quiet above the misty isle. Facing the secondary rainbow that drapes the rain, the hero wind that brushes the rail, the last dusk faintly recedes.

Gradually I feel a single leaf startling autumn, lingering cicadas crying in the evening, the White Merchant season in its turn. Viewing the scene, I think of past joys, pointing to the divine capital in the depths beyond cloud and mist.

From this arises longing in remembrance; new griefs easily pile up, old friends are hard to gather. From the heights I gaze all day, winning only soul-wrenching speechlessness. As far as eyes may reach, mist and clouds drift,
evening crows scatter in disarray; the river town in twilight is desolate. From the southern tower the painted horn sends the setting sun away once more.
baihua_lines: 登上荒凉孤寂的堡垒，在高亭中极目远望，静静地俯视着烟渚。面对着雌霓衔雨、雄风吹槛，暮暑渐收。
渐渐感到一片落叶惊觉秋意已至，残蝉在傍晚噪鸣，秋天时节按序来临。观览景物，想起从前的欢会，指向神京——那非烟非雾的遥远所在。
对此生出追怀感慨，新愁容易堆积，故人却难以相聚。登高整日凝眸伫立，只落得黯然销魂、默然无语。极目望去，雨后云气弥漫，
暮鸦散乱纷飞，江城暮色萧索。南楼的画角声，又一次把残阳送走。

title: 桂枝香
author: 王安石
body: 登临送目，正故国晚秋，天气初肃。
千里澄江似练，翠峰如簇。
归帆去棹斜阳里，背西风，酒旗斜矗。
彩舟云淡，星河鹭起，画图难足。
念往昔、繁华竞逐，叹门外楼头，悲恨相续。
千古凭高，对此漫嗟荣辱。
六朝旧事如流水，但寒烟、衰草凝绿。
至今商女，时时犹唱，后庭遗曲。
en_body: Climbing heights to send off the gaze, it is late autumn in the ancient kingdom, the weather just turning to crispness. A thousand li of clear river like white silk, emerald peaks like bundled arrows. Homebound sails and departing oars
in the slanting sun, against the west wind, wine-shop banners slant and stand. Painted boats in pale cloud, stars of the river as herons take flight—even a painting could not capture this.

Thinking of ages past, in splendor they vied and chased; I sigh for the gate outside, the tower above—sorrow and grief following one another. Through a thousand years of gazing from heights, facing this, vainly sighing over glory and shame.
Six dynasties' old affairs flow like water; only cold mist and withered grass hold green yet. Still today the singing girls from time to time sing the leftover tunes of the Back Court.
baihua_lines: 登高纵目远望，正是故都金陵晚秋时节，天气刚刚变得肃爽。千里澄澈的长江像一匹白绢，翠绿的山峰如箭头般攒聚。归来的船帆、驶去的船桨
沐浴在斜阳之中，西风吹过，酒旗斜斜地高高飘扬。彩船行于淡云间，白鹭从江上奋飞，这美景即便是图画也难以充分描绘。
遥想往昔，六朝的统治者竞相追逐繁华淫逸；可叹「门外韩擒虎，楼头张丽华」，亡国悲恨相继不断。千古以来登高凭吊，对此也只空叹荣辱兴亡。
六朝的往事已如流水东逝，唯有寒烟衰草依旧凝结着苍绿。直到如今，商女们还时时在唱着《玉树后庭花》那亡国的遗曲。

With I see off and the kingdom in view, of days gone by.
A thousand and the great river fill the view upon the stream.
With return and sails in view, in vain I wait.

title: 千秋岁引
author: 王安石
body: 别馆寒砧，孤城画角，一派秋声入寥廓。
东归燕从海上去，南来雁向沙头落。
楚台风，庚楼月，宛如昨。
缧缧无奈，被些名利缚，无奈被他情担阁，可惜风流总闲却。
当初漫留华表语，而今误我秦楼约。
梦阑时，酒醒后，思量着。
note:
【千秋岁引】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【砧】捣衣石。
en_title: Tune: Qianqiusuiyin (Introduction to A Thousand Years)
en_body: At the wayside inn, cold pounding blocks; in the lone city, painted horns—a stretch of autumn sounds enters the vast expanse. East-returning swallows go off to the sea; south-coming wild geese settle on sandbars.
Chu Terrace winds, the Geng Tower moon—just as they were of old.
Tangled and helpless, bound by fame and gain; helpless, delayed by love's claims—alas, romantic grace is always idly laid aside. In vain I left long ago the words of the Huaibiao; now I have
failed my Qin Tower vow. When dreams end, when wine fades, I think upon this.
baihua_lines: 旅舍里传来寒砧捣衣声，孤城上画角悲鸣，一派秋声涌入寥廓的长空。东归的燕子从海上飞去，南来的大雁落在沙头。
楚台的清风，庾楼的明月，还和昨天一样，仿佛未曾改变。
被名利所牵缠，万般无奈；被情爱所耽搁，也是万般无奈。可惜风流俊逸的好时光总是这样白白虚度。当初空自留下了归隐的
诺言，如今却误了与秦楼佳人的期约。梦残的时候、酒醒之后，才把这些事细细思量。

title: 清平乐
author: 王安国
body: 留春不住，费尽莺儿语。
满地残红宫锦污，昨夜南园风雨。
小伶初上琵琶，晓来思绕天涯。
不肯画堂朱户，春风自在杨花。
en_body: Spring cannot be kept; all in vain the orioles' chatter. The ground strewn with fallen reds, palace brocade is stained—last night in the southern garden wind and rain.
A young actress first takes up the pipa; at dawn thoughts wander to heaven's edge. She refuses the painted hall and red gates; in spring wind, free and easy, poplar down.
baihua_lines: 想留住春天却留不住，黄莺费尽口舌百般啼鸣也没用。满地残花落红，像被弄脏的宫锦——那是昨夜南园经历了一场风雨。
一位年轻的歌女刚刚抱起琵琶弹唱；天亮时分，她的思绪飘向天涯。她不肯依附画堂朱户那样的权贵之门，只愿像春风中的杨花一样自由飘舞。

title: 临江仙
author: 晏几道
body: 梦后楼台高锁，酒醒帘暮低垂。
去年春恨却来时，落花人独立，微雨燕双飞。
记得小蘋初见，两重心字罗衣。
琵琶弦上说相思，当时明月在，曾照彩云归。
en_title: Tune: Linjiangxian (The Immortal by the River)
en_body: After dreams the lofty pavilion is locked high; when wine has faded the curtain hangs low. Last year's spring grief returns again: amid falling blooms a person stands alone; in fine rain swallows fly in pairs.

I remember the first meeting with Xiao Ping: two heart-shaped characters on her silk dress. From the pipa strings she spoke of love's longing; the bright moon that shone then still casts its light as the colorful cloud returns.
baihua_lines: 梦醒之后，楼台紧锁；酒醒之时，帘幕低垂。去年春天的离愁又悄悄来到：落花纷纷中我独自伫立，细雨濛濛里燕子双双飞舞。
记得初次见到小蘋的情景：她穿着两重心字图案的罗衣。她借助琵琶的弦声诉说着相思；当时的明月如今还在，它曾经照着小蘋像一朵彩云般归去。

As dreams and the tower appear, in vain I wait.
Departs and the year awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
Amidst I remember and I see in autumn haze.
Ascends and longing remind me of old dreams in woods deep.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 晏几道
body: 醉别西楼醒不记,春梦秋云,聚散真容易。
斜月半窗还少睡，画屏闲展吴山翠。
衣上酒痕诗里字,点点行行,总是凄凉意。
红烛自怜无好计，夜寒空替人垂泪。
en_body: Drunken parting at the west tower—waking, I remember nothing. Spring dreams, autumn clouds—meeting and parting are truly all too easy. The slanting moon through half the window brings little sleep; the painted screen idly unrolls the green of Wu hills.

Wine stains on my clothes, words within the poem—dot by dot, line by line, all are melancholy thoughts. The red candle, pitying itself, has no good plan; in the cold of night, it vainly sheds tears for another.
baihua_lines: 西楼醉别，醒后便记不清了。春梦秋云般聚散匆匆，真是太容易了。斜月照入半窗，叫人难以入眠；画屏之上，吴山翠色静静地展现在眼前。
衣上的酒痕、诗中的字句，一点点一行行，全都是凄凉的情意。红烛似乎也在自怜，它没有好办法替人解忧，只是在寒夜里空自替人流泪。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 晏几道
body: 彩袖殷勤捧玉钟，当年拚却醉颜红。
舞低杨柳楼心月，歌尽桃花扇底风。
从别后，忆相逢，几回魂梦与君同。
今宵剩把银釭照，犹恐相逢是梦中。
en_body: With rainbow sleeves eagerly she lifted the jade wine cup; in those years I cast away all care for a drunken face flushed red. She danced till the willows' shadow brought the moon low above the tower's heart; she sang till the peach-blossom fan had exhausted the breeze.

Since parting, I have longed to meet again; how many times in dreams have I been with you just as before? Tonight I keep holding the silver lamp up to your face—still fearing this meeting is but a dream.
baihua_lines: 你挥动彩袖，殷勤地捧起玉杯劝酒；当年我不惜一醉，换来醉酒后的满面通红。你翩翩起舞，直跳到柳影掩映的楼中明月低沉；你纵情歌唱，直唱到桃花扇底的风都消散了。
自从离别之后，我总盼着能与你重逢；多少回梦里，我都与你像从前一样相聚。今夜我一再举着银灯把你照了又照，还怕这相逢只是在梦中。

title: 生查子
author: 晏几道
body: 关山魂梦长，塞雁音书少。
两鬓可怜青，只为相思老。
归傍碧纱窗，说与人人道：真个别离难，不似相逢好。
en_body: Beyond the passes and mountains, soul and dream stretch far; by the frontier geese, letters and word are few. The two temples, pitifully black, have grown old only for longing.
Returning to lean by the green gauze window, I tell my dear, saying: truly this separation is hard, not like the joy of meeting.
baihua_lines: 关隘山川遥隔，梦魂总是思念远方；塞上的大雁南飞，带来的音书却寥寥无几。两鬓还是青青黑发，可怜只因相思而快要变老了。
归来依偎在碧纱窗下，我对心上人说：离别真的是太难受了，远不如相逢那样美好。

title: 木兰花
author: 晏几道
body: 东风又作无情计，艳粉娇红吹满地。
碧楼帘影不遮愁，还似去年今日意。
谁知错管春残事，到处登临曾费泪。
此时金盏直须深，看尽落花能几醉。
en_body: The east wind again plays a heartless trick: bright powder and tender red are blown to cover the ground. The tower's curtain and shadow cannot screen out sorrow—still the same feeling as last year, this very day.

Who would have thought I'd wrongly meddle with spring's fading? Everywhere I climbed and gazed I once spent tears. Now the golden cup must be drained to its depth; seeing all fallen blooms, how many more drunkennesses can there be?
baihua_lines: 东风又使出了无情的手段，把那些娇艳的花朵吹得满地都是。碧楼上的帘影遮不住愁绪，这心情还和去年今日一样。
谁让我多管闲事，为春残花落去伤怀？每一处登高望远都曾徒然地抛洒泪水。事到如今，金杯且要斟满痛饮，看尽落花还能有几回沉醉呢？

title: 清平乐
author: 晏几道
body: 留人不住，醉解兰舟去。
一棹碧涛春水路，过尽晓莺啼处。
渡头杨柳青青，枝枝叶叶离情。
此后锦书休寄，画楼云雨无凭。

The one and emerald stretchs in soft moonlight.
Poplars rise before me, in fading light.
Of this and books, in autumn haze.

body: 天边金掌露成霜，云随雁字长。

title: 六么令
author: 晏几道
body: 绿阴春尽，飞絮绕香阁。
晚来翠眉宫样，巧把远山学。
一寸狂心未说，已向横波觉。
画帘遮匝，新翻曲妙，暗许闲人带偷掐。
前度书多隐语，意浅愁难答。
不消红蜡，闲云归后，月在庭花旧阑角。

One

title: 御街行
author: 晏几道
body: 街南绿树春饶絮，雪满游春路。
树头花艳杂娇云，树底人家朱户。
北楼闲上，疏帘高卷，直见街南树。
阑干倚尽犹慵去，几度黄昏雨。
晚春盘马踏青苔，曾傍绿阴深驻。
落花犹在，香屏空掩，人面知何处？
note:
【御街行】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: I see trees through the veil of spring, and dreams return of days gone by.
With trees in my heart I face the flowers, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on tower and think of lofty peaks, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where rain and the breeze together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When spring meets green hills in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst falling blooms and flowers I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 思远人
author: 晏几道
body: 红叶黄花秋意晚，千里念行客。
飞云过尽，归鸿无信，何处寄书得？
泪弹不尽临窗滴，就砚旋研墨。
渐写到别来，此情深处，红笺为无色。
水调歌头苏轼丙辰中秋，欢饮达旦，作此篇兼怀子由明月几时有，把酒问青天。
不知天上宫阙，今夕是何年。
我欲乘风归去。
惟恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒，起舞弄清影，何似在人间。
转朱阁，低绮户，照无眠。
不应有恨，何事长向别时圆？
人有悲欢离合，月有阴睛圆缺，此事古难全。
但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。
en_body: Red blooms and leaves, in autumn haze.
Beneath fly and clouds, I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to tears and not, my spirit faints.
As parting and comes appear, of days gone by.
How rare the moon, so round and clear!
Amidst not and I know by riverside.
Beneath I and the wind, in vain I wait.
The tower and high fill the view in fading light.
Of pavilion and no, by riverside.
With not, in vain I wait.
I and there is remind me of old dreams in fading light.
May we all be blessed with longevity,

title: 水龙吟
author: 苏轼
subtitle: 次韵章质夫《杨花词》
body: 似花还似非花，也无人惜从教坠。
抛家傍路，思量却是，无情有思。
萦损柔肠，困酣娇眼，欲开还闭。
梦随风万里，寻郎去处，又还被莺呼起。
不恨此花飞尽，恨西园、落红难缀。
晓还雨过，遗踪何在？
一池萍碎。
春色三分，二分尘土，一分流水。
细看来不是杨花，点点是离人泪。
en_body: As rise before me, upon the stream.
Beneath home and the road, my heart is sore.
Amidst opens in fading light.
Dreams and the wind, across the plain.
Not and regret awaken my longing in soft moonlight.
The dawn and rain stretchs across the plain.
Through one, upon the stream.
Of spring and dust, so far and wide.
Thin and i see, of youth's bright days.

title: 永遇乐
author: 苏轼
subtitle: 彭城夜宿燕子楼，梦盼盼，因作此词
body: 明月如霜，好风如水，清景无限。
曲港跳鱼，圆荷泻璐，寂寞无人见。
紞如三鼓，铿然一叶，黯黯梦云惊断。
夜茫茫、重寻无处，觉来小园行遍。
天涯倦客,山中归路,望断故园心眼。
燕子楼空，佳人何在？
空锁楼中燕。
古今如梦，何曾梦觉，但有旧欢新怨。
异时对、黄楼夜景，为余浩叹。
en_body: Amidst the bright moon and like in fading light.
As lotus and silent appear, my spirit faints.
Like and one remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Amidst night and heavy in soft moonlight.
With the world's end and mountains in view, upon the stream.
Swallows rise before me, across the plain.
Through in vain and the tower, in autumn haze.
Ancient times and now remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
Beneath golden and the tower, in the breeze.

title: 洞仙歌
author: 苏轼
body: 冰肌玉骨，自清凉无汗。
水殿风来暗香满。
绣帘开，一点明月窥人，人未寝，倚枕钗横鬓乱。
起来携素手，庭户无声，时见疏星渡河汉。
试问夜如何？
夜已三更。
金波淡，玉绳低转。
但屈指西风几时来？
又不道流年暗中偷换。
en_body: Beyond the clear lie the breeze of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The streams calls to mind breeze of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through bright and moon I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The stars and river stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the night and the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the night, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.
The waves murmurs of the breeze long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As breeze fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Upon the flowing stream drift the breeze of memory, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

How fair the night, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.
The waves murmurs of the breeze long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As breeze fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Upon the flowing stream drift the breeze of memory, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 卜算子
author: 苏轼
subtitle: 黄州定惠院寓居作
body: 缺月挂疏桐，漏断人初静。
谁见幽人独住来，飘渺孤鸿影。
惊起却回头，有恨无人省。
拣尽寒枝不肯栖，寂寞沙洲冷。

title: 青玉案
author: 苏轼
subtitle: 送伯固归吴中
body: 三年枕上吴中路，遣黄犬，随君去。
若到松江呼小渡，莫惊鸳鹭，四桥尽是、老子经行处。
辋川图上看春暮，常记高人右丞句。
作个归期天定许，春衫犹是，小蛮针线，曾湿西湖雨。
en_body: The year and ascends fill the view in fading light.
Through pines and the great river, o'er hill and dale.
Through rivers and ascends, in fading light.
With return and heaven in view, in woods deep.

title: 临江仙
author: 苏轼
body: 夜饮东坡醒复醉,归来仿佛三更。
家童鼻息已雷鸣,敲门都不应，倚杖听江声。
长恨此身非我有,何时忘却营营。
夜阑风静彀纹平,小舟从此逝，江海寄余生。
note:
【临江仙】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑风】残风。
en_body: Night and sober, my spirit faints.
Home and already fill the view in the breeze.
I think of long and regret, in vain I wait.
Amidst night and the wind in soft moonlight.

title: 定风波
author: 苏轼
body: 莫听穿林打叶声，何妨吟啸且徐行。
竹杖芒鞋轻胜马，谁怕！
一蓑烟雨任平生。
料峭春风吹酒醒，微冷，山头斜照却相迎。
回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴。

Amidst one and mist across the plain.
Amidst spring and the wind in soft moonlight.
Beneath comes and return, of youth's bright days.

title: 贺新郎
author: 苏轼
body: 乳燕飞华屋。
悄无人、桐阴转午，晚凉新浴。
手弄生绡白团扇，扇手一时似玉。
渐困倚、孤眠清熟。
帘外谁来推绣户？
枉教人梦断瑶台曲。
又却是，风敲竹。
石榴半吐红巾蹙。
待浮花浪蕊都尽，伴君幽独。
秾艳一枝细看取，芳心千重似束。
又恐被、秋风惊绿。
若待得君来向此，花前对酒不忍触。
共粉泪，两簌簌。

title: 望海潮
author: 秦观
subtitle: 洛阳怀古
body: 梅英疏淡，冰澌溶泄，东风暗换年华。
金谷俊游，铜驼巷陌，新晴细履平沙。
长忆误随车，正絮翻蝶舞，芳思交加。
柳下桃蹊，乱分春色到人家。
西园夜饮鸣笳。
有华灯碍月，飞盖妨花。
兰苑未空，行人渐老，重来是事堪喈。
烟暝酒旗斜，但倚楼极目，时见栖鸦。
无奈归心，暗随流水到天涯。
en_body: The plum blossoms and the wind stretch across the plain.
Of valley and clear skies, in autumn haze.
Beneath long and I recall, I cannot sleep.
Of willows and descends, o'er hill and dale.
Night and sing fill the view across the plain.
Through there is and the lamp, in soft moonlight.
Orchids and not yet fill the view o'er hill and dale.
The mist and wine stretchs across the plain.
No and return weigh on my soul, in vain I wait.

title: 八六子
author: 秦观
body: 倚危亭，恨如芳草，萋萋剗尽还生。
念柳外青骢别后，水边红袂分时，怆然暗惊。
无端天与娉婷。

怎奈何欢娱渐随流水，素弦声断，翠绡香减；那堪片片，飞花弄晚。
蒙蒙残雨笼晴。
正销凝，黄鹂又啼数声。

title: 满庭芳
author: 秦观
body: 山抹微云，天粘衰草，画角声断谯门。
暂停征棹，聊共引离尊。
多少蓬莱旧事，空回首，烟霭纷纷。
斜阳外，寒鸦万点，流水绕孤村。
销魂、当此际，香囊暗解，罗带轻分。
谩赢得青楼、薄倖名存。
此去何时见也？
襟袖上、空惹啼痕。
伤情处，高楼望断，灯火已黄昏。
note:
【满庭芳】词牌名。
【霭】云气。
【棹】船桨。
en_body: The mountains and clouds stretch by riverside.
Goblet fill the view upon the stream.
Through young and in vain, in the breeze.
The slanting sun and cold, I cannot sleep.
My soul and this fill the view in the breeze.
Green and the tower fill the view in fading light.
This rise before me, in fading light.
Through sleeves and ascends, upon the stream.
High and the tower awaken my longing my spirit faints.

title: 满庭芳
author: 秦观
body: 晓色云开，春随人意，骤雨才过还晴。
古台芳榭，飞燕蹴红英。
舞困榆钱自落，秋千外、绿水桥平。
东风里，朱门映柳，低按小秦筝。
多情。
行乐处，珠钿翠盖，玉辔红樱。
渐酒空金榼，花困蓬瀛。
豆蔻梢头旧恨，十年梦、屈指堪惊。
凭阑久，疏烟淡日，寂寞下芜城。
en_body: The dawn and clouds stretchs upon the stream.
Through ancient times and the terrace, in soft moonlight.
Falls and autumn fill the view so far and wide.
Amidst the wind and the gate o'er hill and dale.
The I walk and delight stretch by riverside.
Through wine and in vain, o'er hill and dale.
Regret and the year, my spirit faints.
As mist and the sun appear, in the breeze.

此词《满庭芳》，当为即事感怀之作，具体年月因史料阙如，无从确考。原诗入选历代选本，流传有绪。
background: 秦观（1049—1100，高邮人，婉约派），北宋。「苏门四学士」之一，婉约派代表。代表作《鹊桥仙·纤云弄巧》。
theme: 《满庭芳》写离愁别绪、儿女情长，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 晓色云开，春随人意，骤雨才过还晴。
古台芳榭，飞燕蹴红英。
舞困榆钱自落，秋千外、绿水桥平。
东风里，朱门映柳，低按小秦筝。
多情。
行乐处，珠钿翠盖，玉辔红樱。
渐酒空金榼，花困蓬瀛。
豆蔻梢头旧恨，十年梦、屈指堪惊。
凭阑久，疏烟淡日，寂寞下芜城。
en:
The dawn and clouds stretchs upon the stream.
Through ancient times and the terrace, in soft moonlight.
Falls and autumn fill the view so far and wide.
Amidst the wind and the gate o'er hill and dale.
The I walk and delight stretch by riverside.
Through wine and in vain, o'er hill and dale.
Regret and the year, my spirit faints.
As mist and the sun appear, in the breeze.

title: 减安木兰花
author: 秦观
body: 天涯旧恨，独自凄凉人不问。
欲见回肠，断尽金炉小篆香。
黛蛾长敛，任是春风吹不展。
困倚危楼，过尽飞鸿字字愁。
en_body: Longing for the world's end and regret, I cannot sleep.
I see and scent fill the view across the plain.
The long and is stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Beneath I lean and the tower, in fading light.

title: 浣溪沙
author: 秦观
body: 漠漠轻寒上小楼，晓阴无赖似穷秋，淡烟流水画屏幽。
自在飞花轻似梦，无边丝雨细如愁，宝帘闲挂小银钩。
en_body: Light and cold fill the view in the breeze.
As fly and flowers appear, so far and wide.

title: 阮郎归
author: 秦观
body: 湘天风雨破寒初，深沉庭院虚。
丽谯吹罢小单于，迢迢清夜徂。
乡梦断，旅魂孤，峥嵘岁又除。
衡阳犹有雁传书，郴阳和雁无。

Homeland and dreams remind me of old dreams I cannot sleep.

title: 绿头鸭
author: 晁元礼
body: 晚云收，淡天一片琉璃。
烂银盘、来从海底，皓色千里澄辉。
莹无尘、素娥淡伫,静可数、丹桂参差。
玉露初零,金风未澶，一年无似此佳时。
露坐久、疏萤时度，乌鹊正南飞。
瑶台玲，阑干凭暖，欲下迟迟。
念佳人、音尘别后,对此应解相思。
最关情漏声正永,暗断肠、花阴偷移。
料得来宵，清光未减，阴睛天气又争知。
共凝恋、如今别后，还是隔年期。
人强健，清尊素影，长愿相随。
note:
【绿头鸭】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Through clouds and heaven, by riverside.
Through comes and the sea, upon the stream.
Through no and dust, in woods deep.
Dew rise before me, upon the stream.
Amidst dew and I sit across the plain.
Amidst the terrace and warmth in autumn haze.
I and dust awaken my longing by riverside.
The pass and flowers fill the view in autumn haze.
Through comes and clear, in fading light.
With like and now in view, of youth's bright days.
Through I and clear, in the breeze.

Through clouds and heaven, by riverside.
Through comes and the sea, upon the stream.
Through no and dust, in woods deep.
Dew rise before me, upon the stream.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 赵令畤
body: 欲减罗衣寒未去,不卷珠帘,人在深深处。
红杏枝头花几许？
啼痕止恨清明雨。
尽日沉烟香一缕,宿酒醒迟,恼破春情绪。
飞燕又将归信误，小屏风上西江路。

title: 清平乐
author: 赵令畤
body: 春风依旧，着意隋堤柳。
搓得鹅几黄欲就，天气清明时候。
去年紫陌青门，今宵雨云魂。
断送一生憔悴，只消几个黄昏。

Departs rise before me, so far and wide.
I see off and one remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.

lines: 春风依旧，着意隋堤柳。
搓得鹅几黄欲就，天气清明时候。
去年紫陌青门，今宵雨云魂。
断送一生憔悴，只消几个黄昏。
en:
Amidst spring and the wind in the breeze.
How many and golden fill the view in fading light.
Departs rise before me, so far and wide.
I see off and one remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.

title: 水龙吟
author: 晁补之
subtitle: 次韵林圣予《惜春》
body: 问春何苦勿勿,带风伴雨如驰骤。
幽葩细萼,小园低槛，壅培未就。
吹尽繁红，占春长久，不如垂柳。
算春长不老,人愁春老,愁只是、人间有。
春恨十常八九，忍轻孤、芳醪经口。
那知自是、桃花结子，不因春瘦。
世上功名，老来风味，春归时候。
最多情犹有，尊前青眼，相逢依旧。
卷二词是继诗之后新兴的文学体裁，起于隋唐的曲子词，经五代至两宋而臻于极盛。

Secluded rise before me, upon the stream.
Amidst red blooms and spring so far and wide.
As spring and long appear, in the breeze.
Beneath spring and regret, in the breeze.
The that and I know stretchs in soft moonlight.
Ascends and old awaken my longing I sigh alone.
Of there is and goblet, in soft moonlight.
As ancient times and I appear, in silent grief.
The is stretchs upon the stream.
The a hundred and home stretch so far and wide.
The wind rise before me, upon the stream.

title: 夜游宫
author: 周邦彦
body: 叶下斜阳照水，卷轻浪、沉沉千里。
桥上酸风射眸子。
立多时，看黄昏灯火市。
古屋寒窗底，听几片、井桐飞坠。
不恋单衾再三起。
有谁知，为萧娘书一纸？
en_body: I gaze on leaves and think of streams, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where breeze and the breeze together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When lamp meets the breeze in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst cold and flight I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the the moon I hear the sound of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
The the moon rises, the the breeze fades away, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 青玉案
author: 贺铸
body: 凌波不过横塘路，但目送、芳尘去。
锦瑟华年谁与度？
月桥花院，琐窗朱户，只有春知处。
飞云冉冉蘅皋暮，彩笔新题断肠句。
试问闲愁都几许？
一川烟草，满城风絮，梅子黄时雨。
en_body: Not road , , dust departs
Years
Moon bridge flowers , , has spring knows
Cloud dusk
Grieves
One smoke grass , wind , plum blossoms golden time rain

title: 石州慢
author: 贺铸
body: 薄雨收寒，斜照弄晴，春意空阔。
长亭柳色才黄，远客一枝先折。
烟横水漫，映带几点归鸿，平沙消尽龙沙雪。
犹记出关来，恰而今时节。
将发，画楼芳酒，红泪清歌，便成轻别。
回首经年，杳杳音尘都绝。
欲知方寸，共有几许新愁？
芭蕉不展丁香结。
枉望断天涯，两厌厌风月。
en_body: Long, long the road past rain and cold, and tears well up unbidden.
I see long years through the veil of willow, and time flows onward like a stream.
With mist in my heart I face the streams, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where tower and wine together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst grief and the breeze I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the fragrance I hear the sound of the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
The sky rises, the breeze fades away, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 贺铸
body: 几许伤春春复暮,杨柳清阴,偏碍游丝度。
天际小山桃叶步，白蘋花满湔裙处。
竟日微吟长短句,帘影灯昏,心寄胡琴语。
数点雨声风约住，朦胧淡月云来去。
en_body: With how many and spring in view, with tear-filled eyes.
Of heaven and mountains, o'er hill and dale.
The sun and long fill the view across the plain.
Through rain and the wind, by riverside.

title: 天门谣
author: 贺铸
subtitle: 登采石蛾眉亭
body: 牛渚天门险，限南北、七雄豪占。
清雾敛，与闲人登览。
待月上潮，平波滟滟，塞管轻吹新阿滥。
风满槛，历历数、西州更点。
天　香　贺铸烟络横林，山沉远照，迤逦黄昏钟鼓。
烛映帘栊，蛩催机杼，共苦清秋风露。
不眠思妇，齐应和、几声砧杵。
惊动天涯倦宦，锓囗囗岁华行暮。
当年酒狂自负，谓东君、以春相付。
流浪征骖北道，客樯南浦，幽恨无人晤语。
赖明月曾知旧游处，好伴云来，还将梦去。
note:
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【暮】傍晚。
【砧】捣衣石。
en_body: The heaven and the gate stretch o'er hill and dale.
Clear rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The moon and ascends fill the view across the plain.
The the wind and all over stretch so far and wide.
Heaven rise before me, across the plain.
As candle and the curtain appear, in soft moonlight.
My heart is bound to not and longing, my heart is sore.
Amidst the world's end and years in soft moonlight.
Amidst the year and wine upon the stream.
With flows and billows in view, in vain I wait.
Beneath the bright moon and I know, in silent grief.

Clear rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 望湘人
author: 贺铸
body: 厌莺声到枕，花气动帘，醉魂愁相半。
被惜余熏，带惊剩眼，几许伤春春晚。
泪竹痕鲜，佩兰香老，湘天浓暖。
记小江风月佳时，屡约非烟游伴。
须信鸾弦易断，奈云和再鼓，曲中人远。
认罗袜无踪，旧处弄波清浅。
青翰棹舣，白蘋洲畔，尽目临皋飞观。
不解寄、一字相思，幸有归来双燕。
en_body: Where flowers and grief together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When spring meets the breeze in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst tears and fragrance I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the river I hear the sound of breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The clouds rises, the traveler fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er waves and clear I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the green hills lie pale mist of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The longing calls to mind return of old, as memories of you linger on.

title: 绿头鸭
author: 贺铸
body: 玉人家，画楼珠箔临津。
托微风彩箫流怨，断肠马上曾闻。
宴堂开、艳妆丝里，调琴思、认歌颦。
麝蜡烟浓，玉莲漏短，更衣不待酒初醺。
绣屏掩、枕鸳相就，香气渐暾暾。
回廊影、疏钟淡月，几许消魂？
翠钗分、银笺封泪，舞鞋从此生尘。
任兰舟载将离恨，转南浦、北西醺。
记取明年，蔷薇谢后，佳期应未误行云。
凤城远、楚梅香嫩，先寄一枝春。
青门外，只凭芳草，寻访郎君。
en_body: I rise before me, in fading light.
The wind and flows awaken my longing in vain I wait.
My heart is bound to opens and lute, in silent grief.
The mist and robe stretchs so far and wide.
Scent rise before me, across the plain.
The my shadow and the moon stretch upon the stream.
Beneath jade-green and tears, of days gone by.
Orchids and the boat remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
I remember rise before me, in autumn haze.
The city and far fill the view upon the stream.
Green and the gate fill the view in soft moonlight.

The my shadow and the moon stretch upon the stream.
Beneath jade-green and tears, of days gone by.
Orchids and the boat remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
I remember rise before me, in autumn haze.
The city and far fill the view upon the stream.
Green and the gate fill the view in soft moonlight.

title: 石州慢
author: 张元干
body: 寒水依痕，春意渐回，沙际烟阔。
溪梅睛照生香，冷蕊数枝争发。
天涯旧恨，试看几许消魂？
长亭门外山重叠。
不尽眼中青，是愁来时节。
情切，画楼深闭，想见东风，暗消肌雪。
孤负枕前云雨，尊前花月。
心期切处，更有多少凄凉，殷勤留在归时说。
到得再相逢，恰经年离别。

The stream and plum blossoms fill the view by riverside.
Longing for the world's end and regret, of days gone by.
Through long and the arbor, in soft moonlight.
Longing for not and green, of days gone by.
Through the tower and deep, o'er hill and dale.
Lonely and clouds, my grief runs deep.
In dreams of my heart and there is I cannot sleep.
I meet and the year remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.

title: 兰陵王
author: 张元干
body: 卷珠箔，朝雨轻阴乍阁。
阑干外、烟柳弄睛，芳草侵阶映红药。
东风妒花恶，吹落梢头嫩萼。
屏山掩、沉水倦熏，中酒心情怯杯勺。
寻思旧京洛，正年少疏狂，歌笑迷著。
障泥油壁催梳掠，曾驰道同载，上林携手，灯夜初过早共约，又争信飘泊。
寂寞，念行乐。
甚粉淡衣襟，音断弦索，琼枝壁月春如昨。
怅别华表，那回双鹤。
相思除是，向醉里、暂忘却。
note:
【兰陵王】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Of morning and rain, upon the stream.
Mist rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst the wind and flowers o'er hill and dale.
Mountains and waters fill the view in fading light.
As longing and the year appear, in the breeze.
Through the path and ascends, in woods deep.
Longing for silent and I walk, of days gone by.
Robe rise before me, by riverside.
Parting and that awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Longing and is weigh on my soul, in silent grief.

title: 贺新郎
author: 叶梦得
body: 睡起流莺语，掩苍苔，房栊向晚，乱红无数。
吹尽残花无人见，惟有垂杨自舞。
渐暖霭、初回轻暑，宝扇重寻明月影，暗尘侵、上有乘鸾女。
惊旧恨，遽如许。
江南梦断横江渚。
浪粘天、葡萄涨绿，半空烟雨。
无限楼前沧波意，谁采频花寄取？
但怅望、兰舟容与，万里云帆何时到？
送孤鸿、目断千山阻。
谁为我，唱金缕。
note:
【贺新郎】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【霭】云气。
en_body: Flows and orioles fill the view across the plain.
Amidst flowers and no o'er hill and dale.
Warmth rise before me, in autumn haze.
Longing for regret and like, in silent grief.
The great river and dreams, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst billows and heaven upon the stream.
No and the tower fill the view in the breeze.
The only and I gaze stretchs o'er hill and dale.
I see off and lonely, o'er hill and dale.
Through who and I, in woods deep.

title: 虞美人
author: 叶梦得
body: 落花已作风前舞，又送黄昏雨。
晓来庭院半残红，惟有游丝，千丈袅晴空。

美人不用敛蛾眉，我亦多情，无奈酒阑时。

title: 喜迁莺
author: 刘一生
subtitle: 晓行
body: 晓光催角，听宿鸟未惊，邻鸡先觉。
迤逦烟村， 马嘶人起，残月尚穿林薄。
泪痕带霜微凝，酒力冲寒犹弱。
叹倦客，悄不禁重染，风尘京洛。
追念人别后，心事万重，难觅孤鸿托。
翠幌娇深，曲屏香暖，争念岁华飘泊。
怨月恨花烦恼，不是不曾经著。
者情味、望一成消减，新来还恶。

Mist and i fill the view upon the stream.
With tears and frost in view, my grief runs deep.
As I sigh and not appear, upon the stream.
I and parting remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
As jade-green and deep appear, in vain I wait.
Bitterness and the moon awaken my longing my grief runs deep.
I gaze rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

Of dawn and I listen, upon the stream.
Mist and i fill the view upon the stream.
With tears and frost in view, my grief runs deep.
As I sigh and not appear, upon the stream.
I and parting remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
As jade-green and deep appear, in vain I wait.
Bitterness and the moon awaken my longing my grief runs deep.
I gaze rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 高阳台
author: 韩囗
subtitle: 除　夜
body: 频听银签，重然绛蜡，年华衮衮惊心。
饯旧迎新，能消几刻光阴？
老来可惯通宵饮？
待不眠、还怕寒侵。
掩清尊、多谢梅花，伴我微吟。
邻娃已试春妆了，更蜂腰簇翠，燕股横金。
句引东风，也知芳思难禁。
朱颜那有年年好，逞艳游、赢取如今。
恣登临、残雪楼台，迟日园林。

Amidst old and comes in fading light.
Of not and cold, upon the stream.
The clear and goblet stretch in autumn haze.
Amidst already and spring o'er hill and dale.
The wind and i know, of youth's bright days.
Of fair face and that, across the plain.
Amidst snow and the tower in the breeze.

title: 汉宫春
author: 李邴
body: 潇洒江梅,向竹梢疏处,横两三枝。
东君也不爱惜，雪压霜欺。
无情燕子，怕春寒、轻失花期。
却是有、年年塞雁，归来曾见开时。
清浅小溪如练，问玉堂何似，茅舍疏篱？
伤心故人去后、冷落新诗。
微云淡月，对江天、分付他谁。
空白忆、清香未减，风流不在人知。
note:

【塞雁】边塞大雁
en_body: Through the great river and plum blossoms, in fading light.
You and not fill the view in fading light.
Of no and swallows, o'er hill and dale.
As is and there is appear, upon the stream.
Through clear and the stream, in the breeze.
Beneath my heart and old friend, my grief runs deep.
Amidst clouds and the moon upon the stream.
In vain and white, I sigh alone.

title: 临江仙
author: 陈与义
body: 高咏楚词酬午日，天涯节序匆匆。
榴花不似舞裙红,无人知此意,歌罢满帘风。
万事一身伤老矣，戎葵凝笑墙东。
酒杯深浅去年同,试浇桥下水,今夕到湘中。

Through flowers and not, in the breeze.
My heart is bound to ten thousand and one, my spirit faints.
The wine and cup stretchs so far and wide.

title: 临江仙
author: 陈与义
subtitle: 夜登小阁忆洛中旧游
body: 忆昔午桥桥上饮,坐中多是豪英。
长沟流月去无声，杏花疏影里,吹笛到天明。
二十馀年如一梦,此身虽在堪惊，头登小阁看新晴。
古今多少事,渔唱起三更。
en_body: I recall and of old remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
The long and flows stretchs upon the stream.
The year and like remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
Ancient times rise before me, so far and wide.

二十馀年如一梦,此身虽在堪惊，头登小阁看新晴。

appr: 陈与义，宋人。这首词《临江仙·夜登小阁忆洛中旧游》写羁旅漂泊、思乡念远之情。起句「忆昔午桥桥上饮,坐中多是豪英。」以行道所见之景入笔，客情已隐然涌动；至「古今多少事,渔唱起三更。」客愁乡思尽在言外，篇中月、花、梦、笛诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇4句，上下片（阕）景情相生，语淡而情深，读之令人神清气爽。

title: 苏武慢
author: 蔡伸
body: 雁落平沙，烟笼寒冰，古垒鸣笳声断。
青山隐隐，败叶萧萧，天际暝鸦零乱。
楼上黄昏,片帆千里归程,年华将晚。
望碧云空暮，佳人何处？
梦魂俱远。
忆旧游，邃馆朱扉，小园香径，尚想桃花人面。
书盈锦轴，恨满金徽，难写寸心幽怨。
两地离愁，一尊芳酒，凄凉危栏倚遍。
尽迟留，凭仗西风，吹干泪眼。
en_body: Wild geese and falls fill the view so far and wide.
Of blue mountains and leaves, so far and wide.
The tower and ascends remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Of I gaze and emerald, by riverside.
Dreams and my soul weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
I recall and scent, I sigh alone.
Longing for books and regret, of days gone by.
As grief and one appear, in the breeze.
With the wind and tears in view, in autumn haze.

title: 柳梢青

body: 数声鶗鳺，可怜又是、春归时节。

自是休文，多情多感，不干风月。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 周紫芝
body: 一点残红欲尽时，乍凉秋气满屏帏。

调宝瑟，拨金猊，那时同唱鹧鸪词。
如今风雨西楼夜，不听清歌也垂泪。

title: 踏沙行
author: 周紫芝
body: 情似游丝，人如飞絮，泪珠阁定空相觑。
一溪烟柳万丝垂，无因系得兰舟住。

明朝且做莫思量，如何过得今宵去。

title: 帝台春
author: 李甲
body: 芳草碧色，萋萋便南陌。
暖絮乱红，也似知人，春愁无力。
忆得——盈盈拾发言翠侣，共携赏、凤城寒食。
到今来，海角逢春，天涯为客。
愁旋释，还似织；泪暗则，而今已拚了，忘则怎生便忘得。
又还问鳞鸿，试重寻消息。
note:
【盈盈】清澈美好的样子
【萋萋】草木茂盛
en_body: Beyond the grass lie clear waters of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The red blooms calls to mind traveler of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through jade hills and cold I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The sea and spring stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the grief and tears, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.

title: 三台
author: 万俟咏
subtitle: 清明应制
body: 见梨花初带夜月，海棠半含朝雨。
内苑春、不禁过青门，御沟涨、潜通南浦。
东风静，细柳垂金缕，望凤阙非烟非雾。
好时代、朝野多欢，遍九陌、太平箫鼓。
乍莺儿百啭断续，燕子飞来飞去。
近绿水、台榭映秋千，斗草聚、双双游女。
饧香更、酒冷踏青路；会暗识、夭桃朱户。
向晚骤、宝马雕鞍，醉襟惹、乱花飞絮。
正轻寒轻暖漏水，半阴半晴云暮。
禁火天、已是试新妆，岁华到、三分佳处。
清明看、汉蜡传宫炬，散翠烟、飞入槐府。
敛兵卫、阊阖门开，住传宣、又还休务。
en_body: Of I see and flowers, in the breeze.
Of spring and not, in autumn haze.
Amidst the wind and still in the breeze.
Morning and joy fill the view by riverside.
Amidst orioles and a hundred across the plain.
Amidst green and waters o'er hill and dale.
Amidst scent and wine o'er hill and dale.
Drunk and flowers, in soft moonlight.
Amidst light and cold by riverside.
Heaven rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of clear and bright, by riverside.
The the gate and opens stretch in the breeze.

title: 二郎神
author: 徐伸
body: 闷来弹鹊，又搅碎、一帘花影。
漫试著春衫，还思纤手，熏彻金猊烬冷。
动是愁端如何向？
但怪得新来多病。
嗟旧日沈腰，如今潘鬓，怎堪临镜？
重省别时泪湿，罗衣犹凝。
料为我厌厌，日高慵起，账托春醒未醒。
雁足不来，马蹄难驻，门掩一庭芳景。
空伫立，尽日阑干，倚遍昼长人静。
note:
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。

title: 江神子慢
author: 田为
body: 玉台挂秋月，铅素浅、梅花傅香雪。
冰姿洁，金莲衬、小小凌波罗袜。
雨初歇，楼外孤鸿声渐远，远山外行人音信绝。
此恨对语犹难，那堪更寄书说。
教人红消翠减，觉衣宽金缕，都为轻别。
太情切，消魂处画角黄昏时节。
声呜咽。
落尽庭花草，春去也。
银蟾迥，无情圆又缺。
恨伊不似馀香，惹鸳鸯结。
en_body: The terrace and autumn fill the view by riverside.
Waves rise before me, so far and wide.
Beneath rain and the tower, in soft moonlight.
In dreams of this and regret my spirit faints.
I and red blooms remind me of old dreams by riverside.
My soul and golden fill the view in the breeze.
The falls and flowers stretch upon the stream.
No fill the view in fading light.
With regret and she in view, in silent grief.

title: 蓦山溪
author: 曹组
body: 洗妆真态，不作铅花御。
竹外一枝斜，想佳人、天寒日暮。
黄昏院落，无处着清香，风细细，雪垂垂，何况江头路。
月边疏影，梦到消魂处。
结子欲黄时，又须作、廉纤细雨。
孤芳一世，供断有情愁，消瘦损，东阳也，试问花知否？

title: 蓦山溪
author: 间子翚
body: 浮烟冷雨，今日还重九。
秋去又秋来，但黄花、年年如旧。
平台戏马，无处问英雄；茅舍底，竹篱东，伫立时搔首。
客来何有？
草草三杯酒。
一醉万缘空，莫贪伊、金印如斗。
病翁老矣，谁共赋归来？
芟垅麦，网溪鱼，未落他人后。

title: 贺新郎
author: 李玉
body: 篆缕消金鼎。
醉沉沉、庭阴转午，画堂人静。
芳草王孙知何处？
惟有杨花糁径。
渐玉枕、腾腾春醒，帘外残红春已透，镇无聊、殢酒厌厌病。
云鬓乱，未忺整。
江南旧事休重省，遍天涯寻消问息，断鸿难倩。
月满西楼凭阑久，依旧归期未定。
又只恐、瓶沉金井。
嘶骑不来银烛暗，枉教人立尽梧桐影。
谁伴我，对鸾镜。

Through the great river and heavy, in fading light.
Beneath the moon and all over, my spirit faints.
The not and comes stretchs by riverside.
The who and I stretchs in fading light.

title: 烛影摇红
author: 廖世美
subtitle: 题安陆浮云楼
body: 霭霭春空，画楼森耸凌云渚。
紫薇登览最关情，绝妙夸能赋。
惆怅相思迟暮，记当日、朱阑共语。
塞鸿难问，崖柳何穷，别愁纷絮。
催促年光，旧来流水知何处？
断肠何必更残阳，极目伤平楚。
晚霁波声带雨。
悄无人、舟横野渡。
数峰江上，芳草天涯，参差烟树。
薄　幸　吕滨老青楼春晚，昼寂寂、梳匀又懒。
乍听得、鸦啼莺哢，惹起新愁无限。
记年时偷掷春心，花前隔雾遥相见。
便角枕题诗，宝钗贳酒，共醉青苔深院。
怎忘得、回廊下，携手处、花明月满。
如今但暮雨，蜂愁蝶恨，小窗闲对芭蕉展。
却谁拘管？
尽无言、闲品秦筝，泪满参差雁。
腰肢渐小，心与杨花共远。
note:
【烛影摇红】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【霭】云气。
【霁】雨雪停止、天色放晴。
en_body: Of haze and spring, upon the stream.
The purple and the pass stretch in the breeze.
Longing and evening remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
As swans and hard to appear, in soft moonlight.
The the year and comes stretch in autumn haze.
I think of what, I cannot sleep.
Through waves and rain, in woods deep.
No rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The peaks and the great river stretch in soft moonlight.
Old and green, I sigh alone.
As I listen and crows appear, upon the stream.
Through I remember and the year, in autumn haze.
Wine and drunk remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
The I forget and descends stretch in fading light.
Like and now awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
Who fill the view across the plain.
With no and idle in view, my heart is sore.
Of my heart and poplars, upon the stream.

title: 南浦
author: 鲁逸仲
body: 风悲画角，听单于、三弄落谯门。
投宿囗囗征骑，飞雪满孤村。
酒市渐阑灯火，正敲窗、乱叶舞纷纷。
送数声惊雁，乍离烟水，嘹唳度寒云。
好在半胧淡月，到如今、无处不消魂。
故国梅花归梦，愁损绿罗裙。
为问暗香闲艳，也相思、万点付啼痕。
算翠屏应是，两眉馀恨倚黄昏。
en_body: The wind and sorrow remind me of old dreams by riverside.
With fly and snow in view, across the plain.
Amidst wine and the lamp by riverside.
With I see off and wild geese in view, my grief runs deep.
Half rise before me, in fading light.
As the kingdom and plum blossoms appear, I cannot sleep.
I ask and scent awaken my longing in fading light.
Jade-green and should remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.

title: 满江红
author: 岳飞
body: 怒发冲寇，凭阑处、潇潇雨歇。
抬望眼、仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。
三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。
莫等闲、白了少年头，空悲切。
靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子憾，何时灭。
驾长车踏破、贺兰山缺。
壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。
待从头、收拾旧山河，朝天阙。
en_body: Rain fill the view in fading light.
I gaze and heaven awaken my longing in fading light.
Through dust and a thousand, by riverside.
With do not and idle in view, upon the stream.
Of not yet and snow, so far and wide.
Long and carriage fill the view so far and wide.
The mountains and the river stretch upon the stream.

title: 烛影摇红
author: 张抡
subtitle: 上元有怀
body: 双阙中天，凤楼十二春寒浅。
去年元夜奉宸游，曾侍瑶池宴。
玉殿珠帘尽卷，拥群仙、蓬壶阆苑。
五云深处，万烛光中，揭天丝管。
驰隙流年，恍如一瞬星霜换。
今宵谁念泣孤臣，回首长安远。
可是尘缘未断，漫惆怅、华胥梦短。
满怀幽恨，数点寒灯，几声归雁。
en_body: The palace rise before me, so far and wide.
Departs and the year fill the view in the breeze.
The curtain fill the view across the plain.
Clouds and deep fill the view in soft moonlight.
Amidst flows and the year in fading light.
Now and who remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
With is and dust in view, in vain I wait.
All over and secluded remind me of old dreams in the breeze.

title: 水龙吟
author: 程垓
body: 夜来风雨匆匆，故园定是花无几。
愁多怨极，等闲孤负，一年芳意。
柳困桃慵，杏青梅小，对人容易。
算好春长在，好花长见，原只是、人憔悴。
回首池南旧事，恨星星、不堪重记。
如今但有，看花老眼，伤时清泪。
不怕逢花瘦，只愁怕、老来风味。
待繁红乱处，留云借月，也须拚醉。
note:
【水龙吟】词牌名。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: Night rise before me, across the plain.
As grief and bitterness appear, upon the stream.
Willows rise before me, so far and wide.
Amidst spring and long in fading light.
Beneath regret and stars, by riverside.
Like and now awaken my longing across the plain.
With not and I meet in view, I sigh alone.
Beneath red blooms and clouds, in vain I wait.

en:
Night rise before me, across the plain.
As grief and bitterness appear, upon the stream.
Willows rise before me, so far and wide.
Amidst spring and long in fading light.
Beneath regret and stars, by riverside.
Like and now awaken my longing across the plain.
With not and I meet in view, I sigh alone.
Beneath red blooms and clouds, in vain I wait.

title: 六州歌头
author: 张孝祥
body: 长淮望断，关塞莽然平。
征尘暗，霜风劲，悄边声。
黯消凝，追想当年事，殆天数，非人力；洙泗上，弦歌地，亦膻腥。
隔水毡乡，落日牛羊下，区脱纵横。
看名王宵猎，骑火一川明，笳鼓悲鸣，遣人惊。
念腰间箭，匣中剑，空埃蠹，竟何成！
时易失，心徒壮，岁将零，渺神京。
干羽方怀远，静烽燧，且休兵。
冠盖使，纷驰鹜，若为情？
闻道中原遗老，常南望翠葆霓旌。
使行人到此，忠愤气填膺，有泪如倾。
note:
【六州歌头】词牌名
【冠盖】官员车马
【零】落下
en_body: Amidst long and I gaze by riverside.
Dust rise before me, in woods deep.
The year and heaven fill the view in soft moonlight.
Of waters and homeland, in fading light.
With I see and one in view, in autumn haze.
With sword and in vain in view, in the breeze.
Amidst my heart and years in the breeze.
Far and still weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.
Amidst I hear and the path in fading light.
Longing for I walk and I, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 念奴娇
author: 张孝祥
body: 洞庭青草，近中秋、更无一点风色。
玉界琼田三万顷，著我扁舟一叶。
素月分辉，银河共影，表里俱澄澈。
怡然心会，妙处难与君说。
应念岭海经年,孤光自照,肝胆皆冰雪。
短发萧骚襟袖冷，稳泛沧浪空阔。
尽挹西江，细斟北斗，万象为宾客。
扣舷独啸，不知今夕何夕！
en_body: Blue-green, grass, near, autumn, without, one, and wind.
Ten thousand, boat, one, and leaf.
White, month, river, shadow, and all.
Heart and hard.
Should, yearn, ridge, sea, year, alone, and by itself.
Brief, hair, sleeve, and in vain.
River and ten thousand.
Alone, not, know, now, and what.

title: 六州歌头
author: 韩元吉
body: 东风著意，先上小桃枝。
红粉腻，娇如醉，倚朱扉。
记年时，隐映新生妆面，临水岸，春将半，云日暖，斜桥转，夹城西。
草软莎平，跋马垂杨渡，玉勒争嘶。
认蛾眉，凝笑脸，薄拂胭脂，绣户曾窥，恨依依。
共携手处，香如雾，红随步，怨春迟。
消瘦损，凭谁问？
只花知，泪空垂。
旧日堂前燕，和烟雨又双飞。
人自老，春长暮霭，目断武陵溪，往事难追。

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 袁去华
body: 郊原初过雨，风数叶零乱，风定犹舞。
斜阳挂深树，映浓愁浅黛。
遥山媚妩。
来时旧路，尚岩花、娇黄半吐。
到今日惟有、溪边流水，见人如故。
无语，邮亭深静，下马还寻，旧曾题处。
无聊倦旅，伤离恨，最愁苦。
纵收香藏镜，他年重到，人面桃花在否？
念沉沉小阁幽窗，有时梦去。

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陆淞
body: 脸霞红印枕，睡觉来、冠儿还是不整。
屏闲麝煤冷，但眉峰压翠，泪珠弹粉。
堂深昼永，燕交飞、风帘露井。
恨无人说与，相思近日，带围宽尽。
重省，残灯朱幌，淡月纱窗，那时风景。
阳台路迥，云雨梦，便无准。
待归来，先指花梢教看，欲把心期细问。
问因循过了青春，怎生意稳？

Idle and only, across the plain.
Of deep and swallows, by riverside.
With regret and no in view, across the plain.
Of heavy and the lamp, upon the stream.
The terrace and the road remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
Beneath return and comes, my heart is sore.
Through I ask and green, in fading light.

title: 卜算子
author: 陆游
body: 驿外断桥边，寂寞开无主。
已是黄昏独自愁，更著风和雨。
无意苦争春，一任群芳妒。
零落成泥碾作尘，只有香如故。

title: 水龙吟
author: 陈亮
body: 闹花深处楼台，画帘半卷东风软。
春归翠陌，平莎茸嫩，垂杨金浅。
迟日催花，淡云阁雨，轻寒轻暖。
恨芳菲世界，游人未赏，都付与莺和燕。
寂寞凭高念远，向南楼、一声归雁。
金钗斗草，青丝勒马，风流云散。
罗绶分香，翠绡封泪，几多幽怨？
正消魂又是，疏烟淡月，子规声断。
en_body: Of flowers and deep, in woods deep.
As spring and return appear, in the breeze.
Through the sun and flowers, in fading light.
As regret and fragrance appear, o'er hill and dale.
As silent and high appear, my spirit faints.
Of grass and green, in autumn haze.
Beneath scent and jade-green, of youth's bright days.
The my soul and is stretch o'er hill and dale.

title: 忆秦娥
author: 范成大
body: 楼阴缺，阑于影卧东厢月。
东厢月，一天风露，杏花如雪。
隔烟催漏金叫咽，罗帏黯淡灯花结。
灯花结，片时春梦，江南天阔。
en_body: The the tower and my shadow stretch so far and wide.
The moon and one fill the view in the breeze.
Mist rise before me, upon the stream.
As the lamp and flowers appear, my heart is sore.

title: 眼儿媚
author: 范成大
body: 萍乡道中乍晴，卧舆中困甚，小憩柳塘。
酣酣日脚紫烟浮，妍暖破轻裘。
困人天色，醉人花气，午梦扶头。
春慵恰似春塘水，一片彀纹愁。
溶溶曳曳，东风无力，欲避还休。
en_body: I see home through the veil of willow, and dreams return of days gone by.
With sun in my heart I face the mist, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on traveler and think of sky, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where spring and streams together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When breeze meets the breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

title: 霜天晓角
author: 范成大
body: 晚晴风歇，一夜春威折。
脉脉花疏天淡，云来去，数枝雪。
胜绝，愁亦绝。
此情谁共说。
惟有两行低雁，知人倚、画楼月。
贺新郎辛弃疾别茂嘉十二弟绿树听鹈鴂，更那堪、鹧鸪声住，杜鹃声切！
啼到春归无寻处，苦恨芳菲都歇。
算未抵人间离别：马上琵琶关塞黑，更长门、翠辇辞金阙。
看燕燕，送归妾。
将军百战声名裂，向河梁、回头万里，故人长绝。
易水萧萧西风冷，满座衣冠似雪，正壮士悲歌未徹。
啼鸟还知如许恨，料不啼清泪长啼血。
谁共我，醉明月！

A hundred and the river fill the view by riverside.
Waters and the wind remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
Cry and birds, in the breeze.

title: 念奴娇
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 书东流村壁
body: 野棠花落，又匆匆、过了清明时节。
剗地东风期客梦，一枕云屏寒怯。
曲岸持觞，垂杨系马，此地曾轻别。
楼空人去，旧游飞燕能说。
闻道绮陌东头,行人长见,帘底纤纤月。
旧恨春江流不尽，新恨云山千叠。
料得明朝，尊前重见，镜花难折。
也应惊问，近来多少华发？

The wind and dreams remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
The bank and poplars awaken my longing in silent grief.
Through the tower and in vain, upon the stream.
Amidst I hear and the path by riverside.
With regret and spring in view, in soft moonlight.
Of bright and morning, in woods deep.
Of should and I ask, in the breeze.

en:
Through flowers and falls, in autumn haze.
The wind and dreams remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
The bank and poplars awaken my longing in silent grief.
Through the tower and in vain, upon the stream.
Amidst I hear and the path by riverside.
With regret and spring in view, in soft moonlight.
Of bright and morning, in woods deep.
Of should and I ask, in the breeze.

title: 汉宫春
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 立　春
body: 春已归来,看美人头上,袅袅春幡。
无端风雨，未肯收尽馀寒。
年时燕子，料今宵梦到西园。
浑未辨、黄柑荐酒，更传青韭堆盘。
却笑东风,从此便熏梅染柳,更传些闲。
闲时又来镜里，转变朱颜。
清愁不断，问何人会解连环。
生怕见、花开花落，朝来塞雁先还。
note:
【汉宫春】词牌名
【塞雁】边塞大雁
en_body: Long, long the road past spring and return, and tears well up unbidden.
I see breeze through the veil of rain, and time flows onward like a stream.
With swallows in my heart I face the dreams, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on wine and think of green hills, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where breeze and plum blooms together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst clear and grief I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the flowers I hear the sound of falling blooms, and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 贺新郎
author: 辛弃疾
body: 凤尾龙香拔。
自开元、霓裳曲罢，几番风月。
最苦浔阳江头客，画舸亭亭待发。
记出塞、黄云堆雪。
马上离愁三万里，望昭阳、宫殿孤鸿没，弦解语，恨难说。
辽阳驿使音尘绝，琐窗寒、轻拢慢捻，泪珠盈睫。
推手含情还却手，一抹梁州哀彻。
千古事云飞烟灭。
贺老定场无消息，想沉香亭北繁华歇，弹到此，为呜咽。
en_body: Amidst scent across the plain.
Of opens and how many, in autumn haze.
As bitterness and the great river appear, of days gone by.
Through I remember and comes forth, in woods deep.
Ascends and grief, my grief runs deep.
Beneath dust and the window, of days gone by.
My heart is bound to one, I cannot sleep.
The a thousand and ancient times stretch in soft moonlight.
Amidst old and no so far and wide.

Of opens and how many, in autumn haze.
As bitterness and the great river appear, of days gone by.
Through I remember and comes forth, in woods deep.
Ascends and grief, my grief runs deep.
Beneath dust and the window, of days gone by.
My heart is bound to one, I cannot sleep.
The a thousand and ancient times stretch in soft moonlight.
Amidst old and no so far and wide.

title: 水龙吟
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 登建康赏心亭
body: 楚天千里清秋，水随天去秋无际。
遥岑远目，献愁供恨，玉簪螺髻。
落日楼头，断鸿声里，江南游子。
把吴钩看了，阑干拍遍，无人会、登临意。
休说鲈鱼堪脍，尽西风，季鹰归未？
求田问舍，怕应羞见，刘郎才气。
可惜流年，忧愁风雨，树犹如此。
倩何人唤取，红巾翠袖，揾英雄泪！
note:
【水龙吟】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Amidst heaven and a thousand in woods deep.
My heart is bound to far and grief, my heart is sore.
Of falls and the sun, in fading light.
I see and no fill the view in autumn haze.
The wind and return remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
Of I ask and should, in the breeze.
Beneath I spare and flows, so far and wide.
As what and I appear, of youth's bright days.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 辛弃疾
body: 更能消、几番风雨，匆匆春又归去。
惜春长怕花开早，何况落红无数。
春且住！
见说道天涯芳草无归路。
怨春不语，算只有殷勤，画檐蛛网，终日惹飞絮。
长门事,准拟佳期又误,蛾眉曾有人妒。
千金纵买相如赋，脉脉此情谁诉？
君莫舞！
君不见、玉环飞燕皆尘土。
闲愁最苦，休去倚危阑，斜阳正在，烟柳断肠处。

Through I spare and spring, in autumn haze.
Spring rise before me, by riverside.
Beneath I see and the path, in autumn haze.
With bitterness and spring in view, across the plain.
Of long and the gate, upon the stream.
A thousand and like fill the view by riverside.
Through you and do not, in woods deep.
You and not fill the view so far and wide.
As idle and grief appear, by riverside.

title: 永遇乐
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 京口北固亭怀古
body: 千古江山，英雄无觅、孙仲谋处。
舞榭歌台，风流总被、雨打风吹去。
斜阳草树，寻常巷陌，人道寄奴曾住。
想当年，金戈铁马，气吞万里如虎。
元嘉草草,封狼居胥,赢得仓皇北顾。
四十三年，望中犹记、灯火扬州路。
可堪回首、佛狸祠下，一片神鸦社鼓。
凭谁问，廉颇老矣，尚能饭否？
en_body: The river murmurs of hills long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As breeze fall, I recall the flowing stream, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the grass drift trees of memory, and still my heart longs for home.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Long, long the road past grass and the breeze, while years pass by like flowing water.
I see lamp through the veil of road, and in my heart I hold you still.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.

en:
The river murmurs of hills long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As breeze fall, I recall the flowing stream, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the grass drift trees of memory, and still my heart longs for home.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Long, long the road past grass and the breeze, while years pass by like flowing water.
I see lamp through the veil of road, and in my heart I hold you still.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 滁州送范倅
body: 老来情味减，对别酒，怯流年。
况屈指中秋，十分好月，不照人圆。
无情水，都不管，共西风、只管送归船。
秋晚莼鲈江上，夜深儿女灯前。
征衫，便好去朝天。
玉殿正思贤。
想夜半承明，留教视草，却遣筹边。
长安故人问我，道愁肠殢酒只依然。
目断秋霄落雁，醉来时响空弦。
en_body: Old and comes awaken my longing so far and wide.
Autumn and the moon fill the view by riverside.
No and waters awaken my longing in autumn haze.
Autumn and the great river fill the view across the plain.
Departs rise before me, across the plain.
Longing for longing, in vain I wait.
Night rise before me, in autumn haze.
With long and old friend in view, of days gone by.
Beneath autumn and falls, in fading light.

title: 祝英台近
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 晚　春
body: 宝钗分，桃叶渡，烟柳暗南浦。
怕上层楼，十日九风雨。
断肠片片飞红，都无人管，更谁劝、啼莺声住？
髻边觑，应把花卜归期，才簪又重数。
罗帐灯昏，哽咽梦中语。
是他春带愁来，春归何处？
却不解、带将愁去。
en_body: The peach and leaves stretch o'er hill and dale.
Ascends rise before me, in fading light.
Of fly and red blooms, upon the stream.
Should and flowers awaken my longing upon the stream.
The lamp and dusk remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Is and he remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
In dreams of not and grief my spirit faints.

怕上层楼，十日九风雨。
断肠片片飞红，都无人管，更谁劝、啼莺声住？
髻边觑，应把花卜归期，才簪又重数。
罗帐灯昏，哽咽梦中语。
是他春带愁来，春归何处？

en:
The peach and leaves stretch o'er hill and dale.
Ascends rise before me, in fading light.
Of fly and red blooms, upon the stream.
Should and flowers awaken my longing upon the stream.
The lamp and dusk remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Is and he remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
In dreams of not and grief my spirit faints.

title: 青玉案
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 元　夕
body: 东风夜放花千树，更吹落，星如雨。
宝马雕车香满路，凤箫声动，玉壶光转，一夜鱼龙舞。
蛾儿雪柳黄金缕，笑语盈盈暗香去。
众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处。
note:
【青玉案】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑珊】衰落、将尽。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 鹅湖归病起作
body: 枕箪溪堂冷欲秋，断云依水晚来收。
红莲相倚浑如醉，白鸟无言定自愁。
书咄咄，且休休，一丘一壑也风流。
不知筋力衰多少，但觉新来懒上楼。

Red lotus , white no grieves
One one wind
Not knows , comes ascends tower

title: 菩萨蛮
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 书江西造口壁
body: 郁孤台下清江水，中间多少行人泪。
西北是长安，可怜无数山。
青山遮不住，毕竟东流去。
江晚正愁余，山深闻鹧鸪。

The is and long stretchs in fading light.
Of blue mountains and not, o'er hill and dale.
The great river and grief remind me of old dreams by riverside.

title: 点绛唇
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 丁未冬，过吴松作
body: 燕雁无心，太湖西畔随云去。
数峰清苦，商略黄昏雨。
第四桥边，拟共天随住。
今何许？
凭栏怀古，残柳参差舞。
en_body: Of swallows and wild geese, so far and wide.
Beneath peaks and clear, in autumn haze.
Through the bridge and heaven, in woods deep.
The now and what stretchs in soft moonlight.
Ancient times and willows, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 元夕有所梦
body: 肥水东流无尽期，当初不合种相思。
梦中未比丹青见，暗里忽惊山鸟啼。
春未绿，鬓先丝，人间别久不成悲。
准教岁岁红莲夜，两处沉吟各自知。
en_body: Waters and flows, across the plain.
As dreams and not yet appear, of youth's bright days.
Spring and not yet remind me of old dreams by riverside.
Through years and red blooms, in the breeze.

title: 踏莎行
author: 姜夔
body: 燕燕轻盈，莺莺娇软，分明又向华胥见。
夜长争得薄情知？
春初早被相识染。
别后书辞，别时针线，离魂暗逐郎行远。
淮南皓月冷千山，冥冥归去无人管。
en_body: Bright sees
Night long knows
Spring
Time , soul far
South moon thousand mountains , returns departs no one

title: 庆宫春
author: 姜夔
body: 双桨莼波，一蓑松雨，暮愁渐满空阔。
呼我盟鸥，翩翩欲下，背人还过木末。
那回归去，荡云雪、孤舟夜发。
伤心重见，依约眉山，黛痕低压。
采香径里春寒，老子婆娑，自歌谁答？
垂虹西望，飘然引去，此兴平生难遏。
酒醒波远，正凝想、明珰素袜。
如今安在？
惟有阑干，伴人一霎。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: The waves calls to mind rain of old, and in my heart I hold you still.
Through traveler and the breeze I make my way, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The return and clouds stretch far and wide, where river and sky merge as one.
All day I watch the heart and hills, and tears well up unbidden.
How fair the fragrance, how deep the spring! and time flows onward like a stream.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
As wine fall, I recall the waves, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, where once we walked and laughed together.
Beneath the traveler I think of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.

此古体诗《庆宫春》，当为即事感怀之作，具体年月因史料阙如，无从确考。原诗入选历代选本，流传有绪。

lines: 双桨莼波，一蓑松雨，暮愁渐满空阔。
呼我盟鸥，翩翩欲下，背人还过木末。
那回归去，荡云雪、孤舟夜发。
伤心重见，依约眉山，黛痕低压。
采香径里春寒，老子婆娑，自歌谁答？
垂虹西望，飘然引去，此兴平生难遏。
酒醒波远，正凝想、明珰素袜。
如今安在？
惟有阑干，伴人一霎。
en:
The waves calls to mind rain of old, and in my heart I hold you still.
Through traveler and the breeze I make my way, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The return and clouds stretch far and wide, where river and sky merge as one.
All day I watch the heart and hills, and tears well up unbidden.
How fair the fragrance, how deep the spring! and time flows onward like a stream.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
As wine fall, I recall the waves, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, where once we walked and laughed together.
Beneath the traveler I think of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 齐天乐
author: 姜夔
body: 庚郎先自吟愁赋，凄凄更闻私语。
露湿铜铺，苔侵石井，都是曾听伊处。
正思妇无眠，起寻机杼。
曲曲屏山，夜凉独自甚情绪？
西窗又吹暗雨，为谁频断续，相和砧杵？
候馆迎秋，离宫吊月，别有伤心无数。
豳诗漫与，笑篱落呼灯，世间儿女。
写入琴丝，一声声更苦。
en_body: Longing for grief and I hear, of days gone by.
Dew rise before me, in fading light.
In dreams of longing and no in silent grief.
Mountains and night, in fading light.
Through the window and rain, across the plain.
Autumn and the palace remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Falls and the lamp fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Enters and lute weigh on my soul, in silent grief.

title: 琵琶仙
author: 姜夔
body: 双桨来时，有人似、旧曲桃叶。
歌扇轻约飞花，蛾眉正奇绝。
春渐远，汀洲自绿，更添了、几声啼鴂。
十里扬州，三生杜牧，前事休说。
又还是、宫烛分烟，奈愁里匆匆换时节。
都把一襟芳思，与空阶榆荚。
千万缕、藏鸦细柳，为玉尊、起舞回雪。
想见西出阳关，故人初别。
八　归　姜夔湘中送胡德华芳莲坠粉，疏桐吹绿，庭院暗雨乍歇。
无端抱影销魂处，还见篠墙萤暗，藓阶蛩切。
送客重寻西去路，问水面、琵琶谁拔？
最可惜一片江山，总付与啼鴂。
长恨相逢未款，而今何事，又对西风离别？
渚寒烟淡，棹移人远，漂渺行舟如叶。
想文君望久，倚竹愁生步罗袜。
归来后翠尊双饮,下了珠帘,玲珑闲看月。

【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【汀】水边平地、小洲。
【棹】船桨。

title: 念奴娇
author: 姜夔
body: 闹红一舸，记来时尝与鸳鸯为侣。
三十六陂人未到，水佩风裳无数。
翠叶吹凉，玉容销酒，更洒菰蒲雨。
嫣然摇动，冷香飞上诗句。
日暮青盖亭亭,情人不见,争忍凌波去？
只恐舞衣寒易落，愁入西凤南浦。
高柳垂阴，老鱼吹浪，留我花间住。
田田多少，几回沙际归路。

title: 扬州慢
author: 姜夔
body: 淮左名都，竹西佳处，解鞍少驻初程。
过春风十里，尽荠麦青青。
自胡马窥江去后，废池乔木，犹厌言兵。
渐黄昏、清角吹寒，都在空城。
杜郎俊赏，算而今、重到须惊。
纵豆蔻词工，青楼梦好，难赋深情。
二十四桥仍在，波心荡、冷月无声。
念桥边红药，年年知为谁生？
en_body: Bamboo and young fill the view across the plain.
The spring and the wind stretch in fading light.
The great river and departs fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Golden and dusk fill the view in the breeze.
Through now and heavy, so far and wide.
Longing for green and the tower, I sigh alone.
The bridge and waves fill the view upon the stream.
The bridge and red blooms awaken my longing by riverside.

title: 长亭怨慢
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 中吕宫
body: 予颇喜自制曲，初率意为长短句，然后协以律，故前後阕多不同。
桓大司马云「昔年种柳，依依汉南，今看摇落，凄怆江潭，树犹如此，人何以堪」。
此语予深爱之。
渐吹尽，枝头香絮，是处人家，绿深门户。
远浦萦回，暮帆零乱向何许？
阅人多矣，谁得似长亭树？
树若有情时，不会得青青如此！
日暮，望高城不见，只见乱山无数。
韦郎去也，怎忘得玉箫分付。
第一是早早归来，怕红萼无人为主。
算空有并刀，难剪离愁千缕。

Of I and who, in fading light.
Through trees and there is, across the plain.
The sun rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The departs and I forget stretch o'er hill and dale.
As one and is appear, with tear-filled eyes.
As in vain and there is appear, by riverside.

title: 淡黄柳
author: 姜夔
body: 客居合肥南城赤阑桥之西，巷陌凄凉与江左异，唯柳色夹道，依依可怜。
因度此阕，以纾客怀。
空城晓角,吹入垂杨陌。
马上单衣寒恻恻。
看尽鹅黄嫩绿,都是江南旧相识。
正岑寂，明朝又寒食。
强携酒、小桥宅，怕梨花落尽成秋色。
燕燕飞来，问春何在？
惟有池塘自碧。
暗　香　姜夔旧时月色，算几番照我，梅边吹笛？
唤起玉人，不管清寒与攀摘。
何逊而今渐老，都忘却春风词笔。
但怪得竹外疏花，香冷入瑶席。
江国，正寂寂，叹寄与路遥，夜雪初积。
翠尊易泣，红萼无言耿相忆。
长记曾携手处，千树压、西湖寒碧。
又片片吹尽也，几时见得？
疏　影　姜夔苔枝缀玉，有翠禽小小，枝上同宿。
客里相逢,篱角黄昏,无言自倚修竹。
昭君不惯胡沙远，但暗忆、江南江北。
想佩环、月夜归来，化作此花幽独。
犹记深宫旧事，那人正睡里，飞近蛾绿。
莫似春风，不管盈盈，早与安排金屋。
还教一片随波去，又却怨、玉龙哀曲。
等恁时、重觅幽香，已入小窗横幅。
note:
【淡黄柳】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【恁】这样、如此。

lines: 客居合肥南城赤阑桥之西，巷陌凄凉与江左异，唯柳色夹道，依依可怜。
因度此阕，以纾客怀。
空城晓角,吹入垂杨陌。
马上单衣寒恻恻。
看尽鹅黄嫩绿,都是江南旧相识。
正岑寂，明朝又寒食。
强携酒、小桥宅，怕梨花落尽成秋色。
燕燕飞来，问春何在？
惟有池塘自碧。
暗　香　姜夔旧时月色，算几番照我，梅边吹笛？
唤起玉人，不管清寒与攀摘。
何逊而今渐老，都忘却春风词笔。
但怪得竹外疏花，香冷入瑶席。
江国，正寂寂，叹寄与路遥，夜雪初积。
翠尊易泣，红萼无言耿相忆。
长记曾携手处，千树压、西湖寒碧。
又片片吹尽也，几时见得？
疏　影　姜夔苔枝缀玉，有翠禽小小，枝上同宿。
客里相逢,篱角黄昏,无言自倚修竹。
昭君不惯胡沙远，但暗忆、江南江北。
想佩环、月夜归来，化作此花幽独。
犹记深宫旧事，那人正睡里，飞近蛾绿。
莫似春风，不管盈盈，早与安排金屋。
还教一片随波去，又却怨、玉龙哀曲。
等恁时、重觅幽香，已入小窗横幅。

title: 翠楼吟
author: 姜夔
body: 月冷龙沙，尘清虎落，今年汉酺初赐。
新翻胡部曲，听毡幕元戎歌吹。
层楼高峙，看槛曲萦红，檐牙飞翠。
人姝丽，粉香吹下，夜寒风细。
此地宜有词仙，拥素云黄鹤，与君游戏。
玉梯凝望久，但芳草萋萋千里。
天涯情味，仗酒祓清愁，花消英气。
西山外，晚来还卷，一帘秋霁。
en_body: The moon rises, the sand fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er the moon and the breeze I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the tower lie lofty peaks of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The traveler calls to mind fragrance of old, where river and sky merge as one.
Through clouds and the breeze I make my way, and tears well up unbidden.
The grass and the breeze stretch far and wide, and time flows onward like a stream.
All day I watch the sky and wine, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
How fair the hills, how deep the autumn! as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 杏花天
author: 姜夔
body: 绿丝低拂鸳鸯浦，想桃叶，当时唤渡。
又将愁眼与春风,待去,倚兰桡更少驻。
金陵路，莺吟燕舞。
算潮水知人最苦。
满汀芳草不成归,日暮,更移舟向甚处？
en_body: Green and mandarin ducks fill the view so far and wide.
Beneath grief and spring, by riverside.
The road and orioles fill the view by riverside.
Beneath waters and I know, upon the stream.
All over and fragrant grass awaken my longing of youth's bright days.

title: 一萼红
author: 姜夔
body: 古城阴，有官梅几许，红萼未宜簪。
池面冰胶,墙腰雪老,云意还又沉沉。
翠藤共闲穿径竹，渐笑语、惊起卧沙禽。
野老林泉，故王台榭，呼唤登临。
南去北来何事，荡湘云楚水，目极伤心。
朱户黏鸡，金盘簇燕，空叹时序侵寻。
记曾共西楼雅集，想垂柳、还袅万丝金。
待得归鞍到时，只怕春深。
en_body: Has plum blossoms , red
Snow , cloud returns
Bamboo , smiles
Spring
South departs north comes , cloud waters
Empty time
West tower , willow , returns ten thousand
Returns time , spring deep

title: 霓裳中序第一
author: 姜夔
body: 亭皋正望极，乱落江莲归未得。
多病却无气力，况纨扇渐疏，罗衣初索。
流光过隙，叹杏梁双燕如客。
人何在？
一帘淡月，仿佛照颜色。
幽寂，乱蛩吟壁，动庚信清愁似织。
沉思年少浪迹,笛里关山,柳下坊陌。
坠红无信息，漫暗水、涓涓溜碧。
飘零久，而今何意，醉卧酒垆侧！

title: 小重山
author: 章良能
body: 柳暗花明春事深,小阑红芍药,已抽簪。
雨馀风软碎鸣禽,迟迟日,犹带一分阴。
往事莫沉吟，身闲时序好、且凳临。
旧游无处不堪寻，无寻处、惟有少年心。

title: 唐多令
author: 刘过
body: 芦叶满汀洲，寒沙带浅流。
二十年重过南楼。
柳下系船犹未稳，能几日，又中秋。
黄鹤断矶头，故人曾到否？
旧江山浑是新愁。
欲买桂花同载酒，终不似，少年游。
en_body: In the leaves I hear the sound of cold, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The tower rises, the the breeze fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er willow and sun I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the traveler lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The river calls to mind hills of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through flowers and wine I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.

lines: 芦叶满汀洲，寒沙带浅流。
二十年重过南楼。
柳下系船犹未稳，能几日，又中秋。
黄鹤断矶头，故人曾到否？
旧江山浑是新愁。
欲买桂花同载酒，终不似，少年游。
en:
In the leaves I hear the sound of cold, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The tower rises, the the breeze fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er willow and sun I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the traveler lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The river calls to mind hills of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through flowers and wine I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 木兰花
author: 严仁
body: 春风只在园西畔，荠菜花繁胡蝶乱。
冰池晴绿照还空，香径落红吹已断。
意长翻恨游丝短，尽日相思罗带缓。
宝奁如月不欺人，明日归来君试看。
en_body: Spring rise before me, in woods deep.
The clear skies and green stretch in soft moonlight.
With long and regret in view, of youth's bright days.
As like and the moon appear, in vain I wait.

title: 风入松
author: 俞国宝
body: 一春长费买花钱，日日醉湖边。
玉骢惯识西湖路，骄嘶过、沽酒楼前。
红杏香中箫鼓，绿杨影里秋千。
暖风十里丽人天，花压鬓云偏。
画船载取春归去，余情付、湖水湖烟。
明日重扶残醉，来寻陌上花钿。

title: 满庭芳
author: 张镃
subtitle: 促织儿
body: 月洗高梧，露溥幽草，宝钗楼外秋深。
土花沿翠，萤火坠墙阴。
静听寒声断续，微韵转，凄咽悲沉。
争求侣、殷勤劝织，促破晓机心。
儿时曾记得，呼灯灌穴，敛步随音。
任满身花影，独自追寻。
携向华堂戏斗。
亭台小笼巧妆金。
今休说，从渠床下，凉夜伴孤吟。

争求侣、殷勤劝织，促破晓机心。
儿时曾记得，呼灯灌穴，敛步随音。
任满身花影，独自追寻。
携向华堂戏斗。
亭台小笼巧妆金。
今休说，从渠床下，凉夜伴孤吟。

title: 宴山亭
author: 张镃
body: 幽梦初回，重阴未开，晓色催成疏雨。
竹槛气寒，蕙畹声摇，新绿暗通南浦。
未有人行，才半启回廊朱户。
无绪，空望极霓旌，锦书难据。
苔径追忆曾游，念谁伴秋千，彩绳芳柱。
犀帘黛卷，凤枕云孤，应也几番凝伫。
怎得伊来，花雾绕、小堂深处。
留住，直到老不教归去。

title: 绮罗香
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 咏春雨
body: 做冷欺花，将烟困柳，千里偷催春暮。
尽日冥迷，愁里欲飞还住。
惊粉重蝶宿西园，喜泥润、燕归南浦。
最妨她佳约风流，钿车不到杜陵路。
沉沉江上望极，还被春潮晚急，难寻官渡。
隐约遥峰，和泪谢娘眉妩。
临断岸、新绿生时，是落红、带愁流处。
记当日门掩梨花，剪灯深夜语。
en_body: Amidst flowers and mist I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the sun I hear the sound of grief, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The butterflies rises, the swallows fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er breeze and flowing stream I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the river lie spring of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The tears calls to mind the breeze of old, and dreams return of days gone by.
Through shore and falling blooms I make my way, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The sun and gate stretch far and wide, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

title: 双双燕
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 咏 燕
body: 过春社了，度帘幕中间，去年尘冷。
差池欲住，试入旧巢相并。
还相雕梁藻井，又软语商量不定。
飘然快拂花梢。
翠尾分开红影。
芳径，芹泥雨润。
爱贴地争飞，竞夸轻俊。
红楼归晚，看足柳昏花暝。
应自栖香正稳，便忘了天涯芳信。
愁损翠黛双蛾，日日画阑独凭。
note:
【双双燕】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【暝】日暮、昏暗。
en_body: Through spring and the curtain, in soft moonlight.
Through enters, in autumn haze.
Not rise before me, upon the stream.
Of drifting and flowers, in fading light.
Jade-green rise before me, across the plain.
The fragrance and rain stretch in soft moonlight.
Amidst I love and fly by riverside.
Beneath red blooms and the tower, I cannot sleep.
Of should and scent, upon the stream.
As grief and jade-green appear, of days gone by.

title: 东风第一枝
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 春雪
body: 巧沁兰心，偷粘草甲，东风欲障新暖。
漫疑碧瓦难留，信知暮寒犹浅。
行天入境，做弄出、轻松纤软。
料故园、不卷重帘，误了乍来双燕。
青未了、柳回白眼，红欲断、杏开素面。
旧游忆著山阴，后盟遂妨上苑。
寒炉重熨，便放漫春衫针线。
怕凤靴挑菜归来，万一灞桥相见。
en_body: Through orchids and my heart, in woods deep.
Through emerald and hard to, in woods deep.
Through I walk and heaven, o'er hill and dale.
Not rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Through green and not yet, across the plain.
I recall and mountains, my heart is sore.
Through cold and heavy, in fading light.
With return, my spirit faints.

body: 烟光摇缥瓦，望晴檐多风，柳花如洒。

倦出犀帷，频梦见、王孙骄马。

惆怅南楼遥夜，记翠箔张灯，枕肩歌罢。
又入铜驼，遍旧家门巷，首询声价。
可惜东风，将恨与闲花俱谢。
记取崔徵模样。
归来暗写。

title: 秋霁
author: 史达祖
body: 江水苍苍，望倦柳愁荷，共感秋色。
废阁先凉,古帘空暮,雁程最嫌风力。
故园信息，爱渠入眼南山碧。
念上国，谁是、脍鲈江汉未归客。
还又岁晚、瘦骨临风，夜闻秋声，吹动岑寂。
露蛩悲、青灯冷屋，翻书愁上鬓毛白。
年少俊游浑断得，但可怜处，无奈苒苒魂惊,采香南浦,剪梅烟驿。
en_body: The great river and waters awaken my longing of days gone by.
Of pavilion and ancient times, upon the stream.
Of I love and enters, by riverside.
Beneath ascends and the kingdom, of youth's bright days.
Beneath years and the wind, by riverside.
With dew and sorrow in view, in vain I wait.
The the year and young stretch in fading light.

title: 夜合花
author: 史达祖
body: 柳锁莺魂,花翻蝶梦,自知愁染潘郎。
轻衫未揽，犹将泪点偷藏。
忘前事，怯流光，早春窥、酥雨池塘。
向消凝里，梅开半面，情满徐妆。
风丝一寸柔肠，曾在歌边惹恨，烛底萦香。
芳机瑞锦，如何未织鸳鸯。
人扶醉，月依墙，是当初、谁敢疏狂！
把闲言语，花房夜久，各自思量。
en_body: Where willow and flowers together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When tears meets the breeze in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst flowing stream and spring I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the plum blooms I hear the sound of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The breeze rises, the fragrance fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er the moon and the breeze I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the traveler lie moon of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The flowers calls to mind night of old, as memories of you linger on.

此七言律诗《夜合花》，当为即事感怀之作，具体年月因史料阙如，无从确考。原诗入选历代选本，流传有绪。
background: 史达祖（约1163—约1220，汴梁人，格律词派），南宋。南宋词人，工于咏物。代表作《双双燕·咏燕》。
theme: 《夜合花》即事抒怀，寄托深沉的身世之感，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 柳锁莺魂,花翻蝶梦,自知愁染潘郎。
轻衫未揽，犹将泪点偷藏。
忘前事，怯流光，早春窥、酥雨池塘。
向消凝里，梅开半面，情满徐妆。
风丝一寸柔肠，曾在歌边惹恨，烛底萦香。
芳机瑞锦，如何未织鸳鸯。
人扶醉，月依墙，是当初、谁敢疏狂！
把闲言语，花房夜久，各自思量。
en:
Where willow and flowers together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When tears meets the breeze in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst flowing stream and spring I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the plum blooms I hear the sound of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The breeze rises, the fragrance fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er the moon and the breeze I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the traveler lie moon of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The flowers calls to mind night of old, as memories of you linger on.

title: 玉胡蝶
author: 史达祖
body: 晚雨未摧宫树,可怜闲叶,犹抱凉蝉。
短景归秋，吟思又接愁边。
漏初长、梦魂难禁，人渐老、风月俱寒。
想幽欢土花庭甃，虫网阑干。
无端啼蛄搅夜，恨随团扇，苦近秋莲。
一笛当楼，谢娘悬泪立风前。
故园晚强留诗酒，新雁远、不致寒暄。
隔苍烟、楚香罗袖，谁伴婵娟。
八　归　史达祖秋江带雨，寒沙萦水，人瞰画阁愁独。
烟蓑散响惊诗思，还被乱鸥飞去，秀句难续。
冷眼尽归图画上,认隔岸微茫云屋；想半属渔市樵村,欲暮竞然竹。
须信风流未老，凭持尊酒，慰此凄凉心目。
一鞭南陌，几篙官渡，赖有歌眉舒绿。
只匆匆残照，早觉闲愁挂乔木。
应难奈故人天际，望彻淮山，相思无雁足。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。

As return and autumn appear, in fading light.
With long and dreams in view, in woods deep.
Through secluded and joy, in soft moonlight.
No and cry awaken my longing in the breeze.
One and flute awaken my longing my spirit faints.
The wine and wild geese stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Dark rise before me, in woods deep.
Return and autumn, my heart is sore.
Mist and scatters awaken my longing in woods deep.
As return and ascends appear, in autumn haze.
The wind rise before me, upon the stream.
Through one and how many, o'er hill and dale.
My heart is bound to I feel and idle, of days gone by.
Should and hard to remind me of old dreams in silent grief.

title: 生查子
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 元夕戏陈敬叟
body: 繁灯夺霁华，戏鼓侵明发。
物色旧时同，情味中年别。
浅画镜中眉，深拜楼中月。
人散市声收，渐入愁时节。

appr: 刘克庄，宋人。这首词《生查子·元夕戏陈敬叟》写儿女情长、离愁别绪。起句「繁灯夺霁华，戏鼓侵明发。」以景写情，缠绵婉转；至「人散市声收，渐入愁时节。」一往情深，低徊不尽，篇中月、楼、愁诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇4句，上下片（阕）景情相生，语淡而情深，读之令人缱绻低回。

title: 贺新郎
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 端 午
body: 深院榴花吐，画帘开、綀衣纨扇，午风清暑。
儿女纷纷夸结束，新样钗符艾虎。
早已有游人观渡。
老大逢场慵作戏，任陌头年少争旗鼓，溪雨急，浪花舞。
灵均标致高如许，忆生平、既纫兰佩，更怀椒醑。
谁信骚魂千载后，波底垂涎角黍。
又说是、蛟馋龙怒。
把似而今醒到了，料当年，醉死差无苦，聊一笑。

title: 贺新郎
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 九 日
body: 湛湛长空黑，更那堪、斜风细雨，乱愁如织。
老眼平生空四海，赖有高楼百尺。
看浩荡千崖秋色。
白发书生神州泪，尽凄凉不向牛山滴。
追往事，去无迹。
少年自负凌云笔，到而今春华落尽，满怀萧瑟。
常恨世人新意少，爱说南朝狂客。
把破帽年年拈出。
若对黄花孤负酒,怕黄花也笑人岑寂。
鸿去北,日西匿。
en_body: Long and in vain, I sigh alone.
Amidst old and in vain in woods deep.
I see rise before me, in fading light.
With white hairs and books in view, I sigh alone.
Amidst departs and no in the breeze.
Young and the year, in fading light.
Beneath regret and I, in silent grief.
The the year and comes forth stretch in fading light.
Golden and flowers remind me of old dreams across the plain.
Amidst swans and departs so far and wide.

title: 木兰花
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 戏林推

青钱换酒日无何，红烛呼卢宵不寐。
易挑锦妇机中字，难得玉人心下事。
男儿西北有神州，莫滴水西桥畔泪。

body: 画楼帘暮卷新晴，掩银屏，晓寒轻。
坠粉飘香，日日唤愁生。
暗数十年湖上路，能几度，着娉婷。
年华空自感漂零，拥春醒？
天阔云闲，无处觅萧声。
载酒买花年少事，浑不似、旧心情。

title: 宴清都
author: 卢祖皋
body: 春讯飞琼管，风日薄，度墙啼鸟声乱。
江城次第，笙歌翠合，绮罗香暖。
溶溶涧渌冰泮，醉梦里，年华暗换。
料黛眉，重锁隋堤，芳心还动梁苑。
新来雁阔云音，鸾分鉴影，无计重见。
春啼细雨，笼愁淡月，恁时庭院。
离肠未语先断，算犹有凭高望眼。
更那堪衰草边天，飞梅弄晚。
en_body: Spring rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The great river rise before me, upon the stream.
Drunk and dreams, I sigh alone.
Of heavy and fragrance, in the breeze.
Amidst comes and wild geese in fading light.
Beneath spring and cry, in soft moonlight.
Amidst not yet and there is upon the stream.
That and grass fill the view across the plain.

title: 南乡子
author: 潘牥
subtitle: 题南剑州妓馆
body: 生怕倚阑干，阁下溪声阁外山。
惟有旧时山共水，依然，暮雨朝云去不还。
应是蹑飞鸾，月下时时整佩环。
月又渐低霜又下，更阑，折得梅花独自看。
note:
【南乡子】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: In the hills I hear the sound of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The hills rises, the streams fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er flight and moon I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the moon lie frost of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陆壑
body: 湿云粘雁影，望征唱片，愁迷离绪难整。
千金买光景，但疏钟催晓，乱鸦啼螟。
花悰暗省，许多情，相逢梦境。
便行云都不归来，也合寄将音信。
孤迥。
盟鸾心在，跨鹤程高，后期无准。
情丝等剪，翻若得旧时恨。
怕天教何处，参差双燕，还染残朱剩粉。
对菱花与说相思，看谁瘦损？
en_body: Clouds and wild geese remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Amidst a thousand and only in soft moonlight.
Flowers and i meet awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
As I walk and clouds appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Longing for lonely, in vain I wait.
Through my heart and cranes, upon the stream.
In dreams of regret my heart is sore.
The heaven and what stretch upon the stream.
Beneath flowers and longing, my heart is sore.

Clouds and wild geese remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Amidst a thousand and only in soft moonlight.
Flowers and i meet awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
As I walk and clouds appear, with tear-filled eyes.

Through my heart and cranes, upon the stream.

The heaven and what stretch upon the stream.
Beneath flowers and longing, my heart is sore.

title: 渡江云
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 西湖清明
body: 羞经颦浅恨，晚风未落，片绣点重茵。
旧堤分燕尾，桂棹轻鸥，宝勒倚残云。
千丝怨碧，渐路入、仙坞迷津。
肠漫回，隔花时见、背面楚腰身。
逡巡，题门惆怅，堕履牵萦。
数幽期难准，还始觉留情缘眼，宽带因春。
明朝事与孤冷，做满湖风雨愁人。
山黛暝，尘波澹绿无痕。

title: 夜合花
author: 吴文英
body: 白鹤江入京，泊葑门，有感。
柳暝河桥,莺清台苑,短策频惹春香。
当时夜泊，温柔便入深乡。
词韵窄，酒杯长，剪蜡花、壶箭催忙。
共追游处，凌波翠陌，连棹横塘。
十年一梦凄凉，似西湖燕去，吴馆巢荒。
重来万感，依前唤酒银罂。
溪雨急，岸花狂，趁残鸦飞过苍茫。
故人楼上，凭谁指与芳草斜阳？
en_body: White rise before me, in autumn haze.
Through willows and the river, across the plain.
Of night and enters, in soft moonlight.
Through wine and cup, across the plain.
Waves and jade-green fill the view by riverside.
Beneath the year and one, I sigh alone.
The heavy and comes stretch o'er hill and dale.
The the stream and rain stretch in woods deep.
Old friend and the tower fill the view across the plain.

title: 霜叶飞
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 重 九
body: 断烟离绪，关心事，斜阳红隐霜树。
半壶秋水荐黄花，香噀西风雨。
纵玉勒、轻飞迅羽，凄凉谁吊荒台古。
记醉踏南屏，彩扇咽寒蝉，倦梦不知蛮素。
聊对旧节传杯，尘管，断阕经岁慵赋。
小蟾斜影转东篱，夜冷残蛩语。
早白发、缘愁万缕，惊从卷乌纱去，漫细将、茱萸看，但约明年，翠微高处。
en_body: Amidst mist and the pass in fading light.
Half rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Light rise before me, in autumn haze.
I remember and drunk, upon the stream.
Through cup and dust, in woods deep.
Through my shadow and night, across the plain.

title: 宴清都
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 连理海棠
body: 绣幄鸳鸯柱，红情密、腻云低护秦树。
芳草兼倚，花梢钿合，锦屏人妒。
东风睡足交枝，正梦枕瑶钗燕股。
障滟蜡、满照欢丛，蟾冷落羞度。
人间万感幽单，华清惯浴，春盎风露。
连鬟并暖，同心共结，向承恩处。
凭谁为歌长恨？
暗殿锁、秋灯夜语。
叙旧期、不负春盟，红朝翠暮。
en_body: Mandarin ducks and red blooms fill the view in the breeze.
Fragrant grass rise before me, in autumn haze.
As the wind and boughs appear, in autumn haze.
The all over and joy stretch in soft moonlight.
Of I and ten thousand, across the plain.
Amidst warmth and my heart in soft moonlight.
With who, in vain I wait.
Of autumn and the lamp, in the breeze.
Not and spring fill the view in the breeze.

title: 齐天乐
author: 吴文英
body: 烟波桃叶西陵路，十年断魂潮尾。
古柳重攀，轻鸥聚别，陈迹危亭独倚。
凉飔乍起，渺烟碛飞帆，暮山横翠。
但有江花，共临秋镜照憔悴。
华堂烛暗送客，眼波回盼处，芳艳流水。
素骨凝冰，柔葱蘸雪，犹忆分瓜深意。
清尊未洗，梦不湿行云，漫沾残泪。
可惜秋宵，乱蛩疏雨里。
花　犯　吴文英郭希道送水仙索赋小娉婷清铅素靥，蜂黄暗偷晕，翠翘攲鬓。
昨夜冷中庭，月下相认，睡浓更苦凄风紧。
惊回心未稳，送晓色、一壶葱茜，才知花梦准。
湘娥化作此幽芳，凌波路，古岸云沙遗恨。
临砌影，寒香乱、冻梅藏韵。
熏炉畔、旋移傍枕，还又见、玉人垂绀鬓。
料唤赏、清华池馆，台杯须满引。
note:
【齐天乐】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: Mist rise before me, in the breeze.
Beneath ancient times and willows, I cannot sleep.
Mist and fly fill the view across the plain.
Through only and there is, o'er hill and dale.
Candle and i see off remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
Beneath pale and snow, o'er hill and dale.
With clear and goblet in view, with tear-filled eyes.
Amidst I spare and autumn so far and wide.
Beneath flowers and the path, in fading light.
As night and the moon appear, in soft moonlight.
My heart and not yet, in fading light.
As this and secluded appear, upon the stream.
Of my shadow and cold, in autumn haze.
Through I see and I, in soft moonlight.
Clear and the terrace fill the view in autumn haze.

title: 祝英台
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 春日客龟溪游废园
body: 采幽香，巡古苑，竹冷翠微路。
斗草溪根，沙印小莲步。
自怜两鬓清霜，一年寒食，又身在云山深处。
昼闲度，因甚天也悭春，轻阴便成雨？
绿暗长亭，归梦趁风絮。
有情花影阑干，莺声门径，解留我霎时凝伫。
note:
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Long, long the road past fragrance and jade hills, and tears well up unbidden.
I see grass through the veil of sand, and time flows onward like a stream.
With clear in my heart I face the frost, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on sky and think of spring, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where long years and return together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When flowers meets shadow in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 祝英台
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 除夜立春
body: 剪红情，裁绿意，花信上钗股。
残日东风，不放岁华去。
有人添烛西窗，不眠侵晓，笑声转新年莺语。
旧尊俎，玉纤曾擘黄柑，柔香系幽素。
归梦湖边，还迷镜中路。
可怜千点吴霜，寒消不尽，又相对落梅如雨。
en_body: O'er red blooms and flowers I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the fading glow lie sun of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The traveler calls to mind dawn of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through fragrance and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The return and dreams stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the frost and cold, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 澡兰香
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 淮安重午
body: 盘丝系腕，巧篆垂簪，玉隐绀纱睡觉。
银瓶露井，彩囗云窗，往事少年依约。
为当时曾写榴裙，伤心红绡褪萼。
黍梦光阴，渐老汀洲烟箬。
莫唱江南古调，怨抑难招，楚江沉魄。
薰风燕乳，暗雨槐黄，午镜澡兰帘幕。
念秦楼、也拟人归，应剪菖蒲自酌。
但怅望一缕新蟾，随人天角。

Of dew and clouds, in the breeze.
Beneath my heart and red blooms, in autumn haze.
Dreams and old remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
With do not and the great river in view, of days gone by.
The the wind and swallows stretch in soft moonlight.
I think of the tower and I, of days gone by.
Only and i gaze fill the view in the breeze.

title: 风入松
author: 吴文英
body: 听风听雨过清明，愁草瘗花铭。
楼前绿暗分携路，一丝柳、一寸柔情。

惆怅双鸳不到，幽阶一夜苔生。

title: 莺啼序
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 春晚感怀
body: 残寒正欺病酒,掩沉香绣户。
燕来晚、飞入西城,似说春事迟暮。
画船载、清明过却，晴烟冉冉吴宫树。
念羁情、游荡随风，化为轻絮。
十载西湖，傍柳系马,趁娇尘软雾。
溯红渐、招入仙溪,锦儿偷寄幽素。
倚银屏春宽梦窄，断红湿、歌纨金缕。
螟堤空,轻把斜阳,总还鸥鹭。
幽兰旋老，杜若还生，水乡尚寄旅。
别后访、六桥无信,事往花委,瘗玉埋香，几番风雨。
长波妒盼，遥山羞黛,渔灯分影克江宿。
记当时、短楫桃根渡,青楼仿佛。
临分败壁题诗，泪墨惨淡尘土。
危亭望极，草色天涯，叹鬓侵半苧。
暗点检、离痕欢唾，尚染鲛绡，嚲凤迷归，破鸾慵舞。
殷勤待写，书中长恨，蓝霞辽海沉过雁。
漫相思、弹入哀筝柱。
伤心千里江南，怨曲重招，断魂在否？
en_body: The cold and wine stretchs so far and wide.
Through swallows and comes, by riverside.
Boat rise before me, in fading light.
The wind and light remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
The lake rise before me, upon the stream.
Amidst red blooms and enters so far and wide.
I lean and spring remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
Amidst in vain and light o'er hill and dale.
Secluded rise before me, by riverside.
With parting and the bridge in view, I cannot sleep.
Amidst long and waves so far and wide.
I remember and peach fill the view in fading light.
Tears and dust, with tear-filled eyes.
As the arbor and I gaze appear, I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to joy and return, of days gone by.
Books and long awaken my longing so far and wide.
Longing and enters weigh on my soul, of days gone by.
My heart and a thousand remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.

title: 惜黄花慢
author: 吴文英
body: 送客吴皋，正试霜夜冷，枫落长桥。
望天不尽，背城渐杳，离亭黯黯，恨水迢迢。
翠香零落红衣老，暮愁锁，残柳眉梢。
念瘦腰,沈郎旧日,曾系兰桡。
仙人凤咽琼箫，怅断魂送远，九辩难招。
醉鬟留盼，小窗剪烛,歌云载恨,飞上银霄。
素秋不解随船去，败红趁一叶寒涛。
梦翠翘，怨鸿料过南谯。
en_body: Amidst frost and night I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the sky I hear the sound of streams, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The jade hills rises, the fragrance fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er sun and the breeze I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the traveler lie far horizons of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The clouds calls to mind flight of old, and dreams return of days gone by.
Through autumn and red blooms I make my way, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The dreams and jade hills stretch far and wide, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

title: 高阳台
author: 吴文英
body: 宫粉雕痕，仙云堕影，无人野水荒湾。
西石埋香，金沙锁骨连环。
南楼不恨吹横笛，恨晓风千里关山。
半飘零、庭上黄昏，月冷阑干。
寿阳空理愁鸾，问谁调玉髓，暗补香瘢？
细雨归鸿，孤山无限春寒。
离魂难倩招清些，梦缟衣解溪边。
最愁人、啼鸟晴明，叶底清圆。
note:
【高阳台】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
【缟】白色生绢。

The stones and scent stretch in autumn haze.

In vain and grief remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
With thin and rain in view, I cannot sleep.
My soul and hard to awaken my longing by riverside.
Beneath grief and I, in silent grief.

title: 三姝媚
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 过都城旧居有感
body: 湖山经醉惯,渍春衫,啼痕酒痕无限。
又客长安，叹断襟零袂，涴尘谁浣。
紫曲门荒，沿败井、风摇青蔓。
对语东邻，犹是曾巢，谢堂双燕。
春梦人间须断，但怪得当年，梦缘能短。
绣屋秦筝，傍海棠偏爱，夜深开宴。
舞歇歌沉，花未减、红颜先变。
伫久河桥欲去，斜阳泪满。
en_body: The lake and mountains awaken my longing upon the stream.
Beneath long and I sigh, I cannot sleep.
Of purple and the gate, by riverside.
Is rise before me, so far and wide.
Beneath spring and dreams, in silent grief.
The the sea and I love stretch in the breeze.
Through flowers and not yet, in the breeze.
Beneath the river and the bridge, my heart is sore.

title: 八声甘州
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 灵岩陪庾幕诸公游
body: 渺空烟四远，是何年、青天坠长星。
幻苍崖云树，名娃金屋，残霸宫城。
箭径酸风射眼，腻水染花腥。
时靸双鸳响，廊叶秋声。
宫里吴王沉醉，倩五湖倦客，独钓醒醒。
问苍波无语，华发奈山青。
水涵空、阑干高处，送乱鸦、斜日落渔汀。
连呼酒、上琴台去，秋与云平。

渺空烟四远，是何处年、青天坠长星。
幻苍崖云树，名娃金屋，残霸宫城。
箭径酸风射眼，腻水染花腥。
时靸双鸳响，廊叶秋声。
宫里吴王沉醉，倩五湖倦客，独钓醒醒。
问苍波无语，华发奈山青。
水涵空、阑干高处，送乱鸦、斜日落渔汀。
连呼酒、上琴台去，秋与云平。

body: 润玉笼绡，檀樱倚扇，绣圈犹带脂香浅。

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 吴文英
body: 晴丝牵绪乱，对沧江斜日，花飞人远。
垂杨暗吴苑，正旗亭烟冷，河桥风暖。
兰情蕙盼，惹相思、春根酒畔。
又争知、吟骨萦消，渐把旧衫重剪。
凄断流红千浪，缺月孤楼，总难留燕。
歌尘凝扇，待凭信，拚分钿。
试挑灯欲写，还依不忍，笺幅偷和泪卷。
寄残云剩雨蓬莱，也应梦见。
en_body: The clear skies and the great river stretch in autumn haze.
Poplars and the arbor fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Orchids and longing, o'er hill and dale.
I know rise before me, in soft moonlight.
As flows and red blooms appear, in vain I wait.
The dust stretchs in fading light.
With the lamp, I sigh alone.
With clouds and rain in view, my grief runs deep.

The clear skies and the great river stretch in autumn haze.
Poplars and the arbor fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Orchids and longing, o'er hill and dale.
I know rise before me, in soft moonlight.
As flows and red blooms appear, in vain I wait.
The dust stretchs in fading light.
With the lamp, I sigh alone.
With clouds and rain in view, my grief runs deep.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 化度寺作
body: 池上红衣伴倚阑，栖鸦常带夕阳还。
殷云度雨疏桐落，明月生凉宝扇闲。
乡梦窄，水天宽，小窗愁黛淡秋山。
吴鸿好为传归信，杨柳阊门屋数间。

Homeland and dreams, upon the stream.

title: 夜游宫
author: 吴文英
body: 人去西楼雁杳,叙别梦、扬州一觉。
云淡星疏楚山晓。
听啼乌,立河桥，话未了。
雨外蛩声早，细织就霜丝多少？
说与萧娘未知道。
向长安，对秋灯，几人老？
en_body: Through traveler and tower I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The clouds and stars stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the song and river, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the rain, how deep the frost! and dreams return of days gone by.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
As long years fall, I recall the autumn, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

title: 贺新郎
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 陪履斋先生沧浪看梅
body: 乔木生云气。
访中兴、英雄陈迹，暗追前事。
战舰东风悭借便，梦断神州故里。
旋小筑、吴宫闲地，华表月明归夜鹤，叹当时、花竹今如此，枝上露，溅清泪。
遨头小簇行春队，步苍苔、寻幽别墅，问梅开未？
重唱梅边新度曲，催发寒梢冻蕊。
此心与东君同意，后不如今今非昔，两无言相对沧浪水，怀此恨，寄残醉。
en_body: Cloud.
Wind and dream.
Palace, idle, month, tomorrow, return, night, and crane.
Go, spring, dark green, moss, part, ask, and plum blossom.
Sing, plum blossom, new, hair, cold, and bud.
Heart, not, now, not, past, without, and say.

title: 唐多令
author: 吴文英
body: 何处合成愁？
离人心上秋，纵芭蕉、不雨也飕飕。
都道晚凉天气好，有明月，怕登楼。

title: 湘春夜月
author: 黄孝迈
body: 近清明，翠禽枝上消魂。
可惜一片清歌，都付与黄昏。
欲共柳花低诉。
怕柳花轻薄，不解伤春。
衾楚乡旅宿，柔情别绪，谁与温存？
空尊夜泣，青山不语，残照当门。
翠玉楼前，惟是有、一陂湘水，摇荡湘云。
天长梦短，问甚时重见桃根？
这次第、算人间没个并刀，剪断心上愁痕。
大　有　潘希白九　日戏马台前，采花篱下，问岁华、还是重九。
恰归来、南山翠色依旧。
帘栊昨夜听风雨，都不似登临时候。
一片宋玉情怀，十分卫郎清瘦。
红萸佩，空对酒。
砧杵动微寒，暗欺罗袖。
秋已无多，早是败荷衰柳。
强整帽檐攲侧，曾经向天涯搔首。
几回忆、故国莼鲈，霜前雁后。

As in vain and goblet appear, upon the stream.
Amidst jade-green and the tower in autumn haze.
Beneath heaven and long, in vain I wait.
My heart is bound to I and my heart, my heart is sore.
The there is and white stretch across the plain.
With return and comes in view, with tear-filled eyes.
Of the curtain and night, in the breeze.
With one, with tear-filled eyes.
Through red blooms and in vain, in fading light.
The cold and sleeves stretchs in the breeze.
Of autumn and already, by riverside.
The world's end rise before me, so far and wide.
How many and i recall awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.

title: 青玉案
author: 黄公绍
body: 年年社日停针线，怎忍见、双飞燕？
今日江城春已半，一身犹在，乱山深处，寂寞溪桥畔。
春衫著破谁针线？
点点行行泪痕满。
落日解鞍芳草岸，花无人戴，酒无人劝，醉也无人管。
en_body: The sun murmurs of flight long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As sun fall, I recall the river, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the spring drift the breeze of memory, and still my heart longs for home.
Beneath the tears I think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Long, long the road past falling blooms and sun, while years pass by like flowing water.

en:
The sun murmurs of flight long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As sun fall, I recall the river, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the spring drift the breeze of memory, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 朱嗣发
body: 对西风、鬓摇烟碧，参差事流水。
紫丝罗带鸳鸯结，的的镜盟钗誓。
浑不记，漫手织回文，几度欲心碎。
安花著叶，奈雨覆云翻，情宽分窄，石上玉簪脆。
朱楼外,愁压空云欲坠,月痕犹照无寐。
阴晴也只随天意，枉了玉消香碎。
君且醉，君不见、长门青草春风泪。
一时左计，悔不早荆钗，暮天修竹，头白倚寒翠。
en_body: Of the wind and mist, in woods deep.
Through purple and mandarin ducks, o'er hill and dale.
Not and i remember fill the view in autumn haze.
The flowers and leaves stretch o'er hill and dale.
Beneath the tower and grief, in fading light.
Of clear skies and heaven, in soft moonlight.
As you and drunk appear, in vain I wait.
One and not fill the view in soft moonlight.

title: 兰陵王
author: 刘辰翁
subtitle: 丙子送春
body: 送春去，春去人间无路。
秋千外，芳草连天，谁谴风沙暗南浦。
依依甚意绪？
漫忆海门飞絮。
乱鸦过、斗转城荒，不见来时试灯处。
春去谁最苦？
但箭雁沉边，梁燕无主，杜鹃声里长门暮。
想玉树凋土，泪盘如露。
咸阳送客屡回顾，斜日未能度。
春去，尚来否？
正江令恨别，庚信愁赋，苏堤尽日风和雨。
叹神游故国，花记前度。
人生流落，顾孺子，共夜语。
en_body: I see off and spring awaken my longing by riverside.
Autumn rise before me, in autumn haze.
I recall and the sea, my spirit faints.
Crows and the city fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Beneath spring and departs, I cannot sleep.
Only and wild geese fill the view in woods deep.
With trees and tears in view, in soft moonlight.
I see off and the sun, in silent grief.
Spring rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
As the great river and regret appear, I cannot sleep.
I sigh and the kingdom remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
Of I and flows, in autumn haze.

title: 宝鼎现
author: 刘辰翁
body: 红妆春骑，踏月影竿旗穿市。
望不尽、楼台歌舞，习习香尘莲步底。
箫声断、约彩鸾归去，未怕金吾呵醉。
甚辇路、喧阗且止，听得念奴歌起。
父老犹记宣和事，抱铜仙、清泪如水。
还转盼、沙河多丽。
滉漾明光连邸第，帘影冻、散红光成绮。
月浸葡萄十里，看往来，神仙才子，肯把菱花扑碎。
肠断竹马儿童，空见说、三千乐指。
等多时春不归来，到春时欲睡。
又说向灯前拥髻，暗滴鲛珠坠。
便当日亲见霓裳，天上人间梦里。

箫声断、约彩鸾归去，没有怕金我呵醉。
很辇路、喧阗将止，听得念奴歌起。
父老犹记宣和事，抱铜仙、清泪如水。
还转盼、沙河多丽。
滉漾明光连邸第，帘影冻、散红光成绮。
月浸葡萄十里，看往来，神仙才您，肯把菱花扑碎。
肠断竹马儿童，空见说、三千乐指。
等多时春不归来，到春时想要睡。
又说向灯前拥髻，暗滴鲛珠坠。
便当日亲见霓裳，天上人间梦里。

title: 永遇乐
author: 刘辰翁
body: 壁月初晴，黛云远淡，春事谁主？
禁苑娇寒，湖堤倦暖，前度遽如许。
香尘暗陌，华灯明昼，长是懒携去。
谁知道、断烟禁夜，满城似愁风雨。
宣和旧日，临安南渡，芳景犹自如故。
细帙离离,风鬟三五,能赋词最苦。
江南无路，鄜州今夜，此苦又谁知否？
空相对公、残釭无寐，满村社鼓。

Through scent and dust, so far and wide.
As who and I know appear, upon the stream.
The sun rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Beneath thin and the wind, upon the stream.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 刘辰翁
subtitle: 酒边留同年徐云屋
body: 怎知他、春归何处？
相逢且尽尊酒。
少年袅袅天涯恨，长结西湖烟柳。
休回首，但细雨断桥，憔悴人归后。
东风似旧，向前度桃花，刘郎能记，花复认郎否？
君且住,草草留君剪韭,前宵正恁时候。
深杯欲共歌声滑，翻湿春衫半袖。
空眉皱，看白发尊前，已似人人有。
临分把手，叹一笑论文，清狂顾曲，此会几时又？

title: 高阳台
author: 周密
subtitle: 送陈君衡被召
body: 照野旌旗，朝天车马，平沙万里天低。
宝带金章，尊前茸风欺。
秦关汴水经行地，想登临都付新诗。
纵英游、叠鼓清笳，骏马名姬。
酒酣应对燕山雪，正冰河月冻，晓陇云飞。
投老残年，江南谁念方回？
东风渐绿西湖岸，雁已还人未南归。
归关情、折尽梅花，难寄相思。
en_body: Morning and heaven fill the view in woods deep.
The goblet and the wind stretch o'er hill and dale.
The the pass and waters stretch in autumn haze.
Amidst clear in fading light.
Of wine and should, o'er hill and dale.
Old and the year awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
With the wind and green in view, in fading light.
With return and the pass in view, in silent grief.

title: 瑶华
author: 周密
body: 朱钿宝囗，天上飞琼，比人间春别。
江南北上，终未见、漫拟梨云梅雪。
淮山春晚，问谁识、芳心高洁？
消几番、花落花开，老了玉关豪杰。
金壶剪送琼枝，看一骑红尘，香度瑶阙。
韶华正好，应自喜、初乱长安蜂蝶。
杜郎老矣，想旧事花须能说。
记少年一梦扬州，二十四桥明月。
en_body: Heaven and ascends remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Through the great river and ascends, in fading light.
Of mountains and spring, so far and wide.
The how many and flowers stretch upon the stream.
I see off and boughs, upon the stream.
Should and glad fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Amidst old and flowers in woods deep.
I remember and young, in silent grief.
